jobs.title: Koordinator/systemadministratör Mottagningsgruppen för introduktionsprogram
jobs.description:
Tjänsten är placerad inom Utbildningsförvaltningen som är en av åtta förvaltningar i Linköpings kommun. Vi arbetar för att erbjuda en utbildning med hög kvalitet, från förskola till vuxenutbildning, som ger Linköpingsborna de bästa förutsättningarna att växa, utveckla sina kunskaper och nå sin fulla potential.

Vill du förgylla vardagen och förbättra livskvaliteten för Linköpingsborna? Hos oss kan du göra en viktig skillnad och bidra till att göra Linköping till en bättre plats. Välkommen till oss!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu en koordinator till Mottagningsgruppen för introduktionsprogram (IM) som dels kommer arbeta med vägledning och mottagning av elever till icke sökbara introduktionsprogram och dels med att vara systemadministratör för vårt system Prorenata (den icke medicinska delen). Arbetet innebär en blandning av mötet med individen och att skapa och utveckla hållbara arbetssätt kring användandet av Prorenata.

I rollen som koordinator där du möter och vägleder elever kommer du även att ha andra arbetsuppgifter, exempelvis att teckna avtal för interkommunal ersättning samt teckna överenskommelser för SIS-placerade ungdomar. Du kommer ha ett nära samarbete med det Kommunala aktivitetsansvaret.

Rollen som systemadministratör innebär bland annat att skapa och justera behörigheter för rektorer och icke-medicinsk personal i grund- och gymnasieskolans elevhälsoteam. Du kommer även att ansvara för introduktion och fortbildning samt support i systemet för skolornas användare. Rollen innebär också ett kontinuerligt samarbete med IT och systemleverantör samt att delta på förvaltningsmöten. I uppdraget ingår att ta fram, sammanställa och analysera rapporter, uppdatera handboken och systemets mallar. Du kommer jobba nära systemadministratören för elevhälsans medicinska insats.

I arbetet i Mottagningsgruppen kommer du följa ett fastlagt årshjul och framarbetade rutiner. Du har frihet att planera och genomföra arbetet självständigt men i nära samarbete med övriga koordinatorer inom såväl Mottagningsgruppen som det Kommunala aktivitetsansvaret. Arbetet innebär en hel del administrativa arbetsuppgifter och systematiskt utvecklingsarbete pågår kontinuerligt.

Din arbetsplats

Centrala elevhälsan är en förvaltningsövergripande tvärprofessionell enhet som stödjer, utvecklar och samordnar verksamheterna i förskolor och skolor utifrån barn- och elevhälsouppdraget.

Mottagningsgruppen för introduktionsprogram (IM) består av fyra medarbetare som främst arbetar med placering/mottagande av elever till gymnasieskolans introduktionsprogram. Organisatoriskt hör mottagningsgruppen till Centrala elevhälsan med Utbildningskontoret som arbetsplats. I det vardagliga arbetet jobbar Mottagningsgruppen för introduktionsprogram och det Kommunala aktivitetsansvaret nära varandra för att på bästa sätt ta tillvara på allas kompetenser.

Du som söker

Vi söker dig med lärarexamen och har du en vidareutbildning till specialpedagog ser vi det som meriterande. Vi vill att du har erfarenhet av elevhälsoarbete och att ha arbetat i ett elevhälsoteam. Vi vill också att du har erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i Prorenata eller liknande system. Har du erfarenhet av arbete med elever i högstadiet eller gymnasiet och har kunskap om gymnasiets introduktionsprogram är det meriterande.

intellektuelt og psykisk

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. NOVUS revolutioniert die Welt der klassischen Motorräder und hat das Ziel die gesamte Industrie zu einer Transformation hin zu stärker nachhaltigen Produkten zu inspirieren.

Unser erstes Produkt NOVUS One denkt urbane Mobilität komplett neu und kombiniert auf inspirierende Weise die Vorteile von eBikes – Leichtigkeit, Agilität, Simplicity – mit der Performance großer Motorräder.

Aufgaben

Im Fokus steht die Begleitung des Serienanlaufs sowie die zielgerichtete Lösung technischer Themen, die dabei entstehen – zum Beispiel rund um den Antrieb, CFK-Bauteile, die Batterie oder andere Fahrzeugbereiche.   • Eigenständige Übernahme laufender Themen im Rahmen des Serienanlaufs – z.B. Antrieb, CFK-Struktur, Batterie oder andere Bereiche
  • Analyse technischer Zusammenhänge und Ableitung zielführender Lösungswege, auch bei unvollständiger Informationslage
  • Enger Austausch mit Werkstatt und Prototypenbau vor Ort, um technische Probleme direkt am Bauteil zu identifizieren, zu verstehen und abzustellen

  • Je nach zugewiesener technischer Baustelle optional: Unterstützung beim Aufbau passender neuer Lieferantenbeziehungen, insbesondere im Hinblick auf Beschaffung in China

Qualifikation

  • Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation (Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Fahrzeugtechnik o.ä.)
  • Erfahrung in technischer Analyse und Lösungsfindung, idealerweise im Automotive-/Fahrzeugumfeld oder in Serienanlaufprojekten
  • Fähigkeit, sich schnell und selbstständig in neue technische Themen einzuarbeiten
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (Muss)

  • Pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise – passend zu unserem Startup-Umfeld

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung in der Beschaffung/Lieferantenentwicklung, insbesondere im asiatischen Raum (China)
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Composite-/CFK-Bauteile oder elektrische Antriebssysteme
  • Erfahrung im Startup- oder Kleinserienumfeld

Benefits

Deine Vorteile bei NOVUS:

Freiheit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit auf hybrides Arbeiten

Mission: Eine spannende Herausforderung in einem dynamischen Startup-Umfeld, das die Zukunft der urbanen Mobilität gestaltet.

Impact: Du hast die einmalige Chance, Teil von etwas Großem zu sein. Du arbeitest in einem Start up an einem einzigartigen High-Tech Produkt.

Hohes Entwicklungspotential: Wir wachsen mit dir und du mit uns. Du hast Freiraum für deine eigenen Ideen und direkten Einfluss auf die Fahrzeugentwicklung.

Opportunities: Dir stehen unzählige Möglichkeiten offen, deine Projekte umzusetzen. Wir gehen unbeschrittene Wege und sind immer bereit, ungewöhnliche Dinge zu tun.

Passionate Team: Wir sind Macher*innen mit einer gemeinsamen Vision. Unser motiviertes Team unterstützt sich gegenseitig und freut sich jetzt schon auf dich.

Diese Position bietet dir nicht nur die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für unsere Produktion zu übernehmen, sondern auch, dich langfristig für weiterführende Verantwortung auf C-Level zu entwickeln.

Wer unternehmerisch denkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und mit seiner Leistung überzeugt, bekommt bei uns die Chance, sich Schritt für Schritt für eine Position in der Geschäftsleitung zu qualifizieren.

jobs.title: Director of Practice & Clinical Services - Small Animal
jobs.description:
Salary up to £90,000 DOE | Welcome Bonus up to £10,000 | Relocation Allowance up to £5,000

 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Veterinary Surgeon ready to take the next step into leadership. We are seeking a Director of Practice & Clinical Services to join Sheriffs Highway Vets in Gateshead on a fixed-term basis for 8–9 months to cover maternity leave. This unique role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on clinical work with strategic leadership, influencing clinical standards, governance, service development and team performance while continuing to deliver outstanding patient and client care. Working closely with the leadership team, you will help shape the future direction of the practice, mentor and support colleagues, champion clinical excellence, and foster a positive, collaborative culture across the team.

 

Following the maternity cover period, the successful candidate will transition into a permanent Clinical Lead Veterinary Surgeon position within the practice. As Clinical Lead, you will continue to drive high clinical standards, support complex case management, lead clinical governance initiatives, mentor and develop veterinary colleagues, and work alongside the wider leadership team to deliver continuous improvement and exceptional outcomes for patients and clients. This is an ideal opportunity for a confident clinician with strong leadership skills who is passionate about developing people, influencing practice standards, and building a rewarding long-term career.

 

Practice Highlights

 
* Established four-site small animal practice (Gateshead, Sunderland, Ryton, Whickham)
* Large clinical team of 14 Veterinary Surgeons supported by experienced nursing and support staff
* Strong collaborative culture with a focus on mentoring and knowledge sharing
* Modern diagnostic and surgical facilities including Doppler ultrasound, ECG, digital radiography, dental x-ray, endoscopy, laparoscopy, orthopaedic surgery suite, and in-house laboratory
* Wide and varied first opinion caseload across multiple branches
* Strong support for certificate development and clinical interests across the team
 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you will play a key role in both clinical delivery and supporting the wider team.

 

You’ll continue to develop your clinical skills and interests while sharing your knowledge and experience with colleagues, contributing positively to the clinical culture of the practice. You’ll be an integral member of the clinical team, delivering excellent care and supporting the ongoing development of those around you.

 

* Deliver high-quality small animal veterinary care across consultations, surgery, and diagnostics
* Support, mentor, and guide less experienced veterinary surgeons
* Contribute to clinical leadership and help maintain high clinical standards across the practice
* Work closely with the leadership team to support clinical direction and development
* Participate in a 1 in 3 Saturday rota across main and branch sites
* Work across multiple branches, including Gateshead, Sunderland, Ryton, and Whickham
 

Working Pattern

 
* Full-time: approximately 40 hours per week
* Typically 38 hours across four weekdays with a set day off
* 1 in 3 Saturday rota (alternating full-day and branch morning shifts)
* Flexible working discussions welcomed
 

Life in Tyne and Wear

 

Based in Gateshead, the practice is ideally located to enjoy everything the North East has to offer. From Newcastle’s vibrant city life and cultural scene to the stunning Northumberland coastline and nearby countryside, the area offers an excellent balance of urban and outdoor living.

 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a confident and motivated veterinary surgeon who enjoys working as part of a team and is committed to delivering high-quality patient and client care. You’ll bring:

 
* A Veterinary degree and registration (or eligibility to register) with the RCVS
* Strong experience in small animal first opinion practice
* Confidence in clinical decision-making across medicine and surgery
* Experience or interest in mentoring and supporting colleagues
* Strong communication and leadership skills
* A collaborative and proactive approach to team working
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and well-being. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership, and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development, including CPD allowance and access to IVC academy training centres & role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches, and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks’ holiday, including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets

jobs.title: Tunnel Worker
jobs.description:
About K-Boringen:

With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.

Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.

Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.

To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

Basic Requirements:

  • Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.
  • A solid understanding of electricity is a must.
  • Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.
  • Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.
  • Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).
  • No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).
  • Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.
  • Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.

Additional Information:

  • You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).
  • You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).
  • You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.
  • A driver’s license is not required.

jobs.title: Gjør en forskjell - bli en viktig del av min hverdag
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en fleksibel jobb der du virkelig betyr noe for et annet menneske? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg. Vi søker nå etter folk til deltidsstillinger og tilkallingsvikarer. 

Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) handler om frihet, selvstendighet og muligheten til å leve livet slik man ønsker. Som assistent blir du ikke en "hjelper", men en viktig samarbeidspartner som gjør det mulig for meg å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv.



Litt om meg

Jeg er en voksen, sosial og livsglad dame som ønsker å fortsette å gjøre mest mulig av det jeg liker i hverdagen.

Et hjerneslag har gjort at jeg har fått lammelser på høyre side og afasi. Jeg klarer en del selv, men er avhengig av bistand for å kunne komme meg ut, være aktiv og ha en god og innholdsrik hverdag.

Jeg bruker elektrisk rullestol og trenger blant annet hjelp ved turer ut av huset, trening, forflytning, personlig hygiene og praktiske oppgaver hjemme.

Afasi gjør at kommunikasjonen noen ganger kan ta litt ekstra tid. Derfor er det en stor fordel om du er tålmodig, rolig, nysgjerrig og positiv i kommunikasjonen. Det viktigste er at du ser personen bak utfordringene og møter meg med respekt, godt humør og trygghet.

Hva innebærer jobben?

Som BPA-assistent vil du blant annet kunne hjelpe til med:

  • Praktisk og personlig bistand i hverdagen
  • Tilrettelegging og hjelp ved måltider
  • Matlaging
  • Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet
  • Forflytning
  • Bistand ved personlig hygiene
  • Følge til avtaler, trening og aktiviteter
  • Kaféturer, turer og andre sosiale aktiviteter
  • Bistå slik at jeg kan komme meg ut og delta i det jeg ønsker
  • Ta initiativ til aktiviteter og gjøremål som gjør hverdagen enklere, hyggeligere og mer innholdsrik

Dagene kan derfor være ganske forskjellige. Noen ganger trenger jeg praktisk hjelp, andre ganger kan det være en tur på kafé, trening, en aktivitet eller bare godt selskap og en hyggelig prat.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg ser etter deg som:

  • Er pålitelig, rolig og trygg i møte med andre mennesker
  • Har godt humør og en positiv innstilling
  • Er tålmodig og respektfull
  • Kommuniserer godt og er komfortabel med at kommunikasjon noen ganger kan ta litt ekstra tid
  • Er nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert
  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke redd for å ta i et tak
  • Liker å være sosial og bidra til gode opplevelser
  • Kan ta initiativ når det trengs
  • Har forståelse for at BPA handler om å bistå en annen person til å kunne leve sitt eget liv på best mulig måte
  • Du må ha politiattest og plettfri vandel. Beherske norsk muntlig og skriftlig.

Det er en fordel om du har førerkort, men det er absolutt ikke et krav.

Det kreves ingen helsefaglig utdannin, og du trenger heller ikke ha jobbet som BPA tidligere. Personlig egnethet, kjemi og en god innstilling er viktigst. Opplæring vil bli gitt.

Hvorfor søke?

Dette er en jobb som kan passe veldig godt for deg som ønsker fleksibilitet og muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell.

Kanskje ønsker du noen ekstra vakter ved siden av en annen jobb? Kanskje studerer du? Eller kanskje du rett og slett liker en jobb hvor ingen dager er helt like, og hvor du får være med på å gjøre hverdagen litt bedre for et annet menneske?

Som BPA får du en jobb hvor du ikke bare utfører oppgaver, men du bidrar til frihet, aktivitet, mestring og livskvalitet.

Det lille ekstra du gjør kan ha stor betydning. 

Stillingen er som tilkallingsvikar, og vakter avtales etter behov. Det kan derfor være en svært fin jobb å kombinere med annen jobb, studier eller andre forpliktelser.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da håper jeg du tar kontakt! Jeg ønsker å finne en person som kan bli en trygg og positiv del av hverdagen min, en som kan bidra med både praktisk hjelp, godt humør og gode opplevelser.

Arbeidstid og vilkår

Vi tilbyr forutsigbare rammer og gode vilkår, med fokus på både trivsel og kvalitet i tjenestene.

Hos oss får du:

  • Lønn etter tariff, med tillegg for kveld, natt og helg
  • God opplæring ved oppstart
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • En meningsfull og variert arbeidsdag
  • Fleksible løsninger innenfor turnus

Ansettelse skjer fortløpende, så ikke vent med å sende søknaden dersom dette høres interessant ut.


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

Me har om lag 190 årsverk, og saman jobbar me får å gi kommunen sine 1500 innbyggarane gode helse- og velferdstenester, oppvekst- og utdanningsmoglegheitar, kultur- og fritidstilbod og eit godt bygdemiljø.

 

Me er stadig på utkikk etter nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidarar, og hjå oss finns det spennande karrieremoglegheitar innan fleire fagfelt.

 

Attestar, vitnemål og vedlegg må leggast ved søknaden. Me oppfordrar søkarar til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utanfor Norge må vere godkjent av NOKUT, og godkjenninga må dokumenterast.

 

Til informasjon så førast søkarane opp på offentleg søkarliste. Det kan søkast om anonymitet, men då må det ligge føre særskilte grunnar for å få godkjent unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25.

Gyldig politiattest må leggast fram der det er eit krav.

jobs.title: Leg psykolog, Akut- och Bedömnings-mottagning i Umeå
jobs.description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Psykiatriska kliniken vid Norrlands universitetssjukhus i Umeå är Norrlands största psykiatriska klinik med drygt 400 medarbetare. Vi har tre allmänpsykiatriska vårdavdelningar, rättspsykiatrisk verksamhet, ett flertal specialiserade öppenvårdsmottagningar och behandlingsenheter. Psykiatriska kliniken har flyttat till ett nybyggt hus där vårdmiljön präglas av tanken om miljöns betydelse för främjande av hälsa. Vård- och arbetsmiljö stöttas av modern teknik och forskning.

Psykiatriska kliniken arbetar för en jämlik vård och behandling som grundas på forskning och klinisk erfarenhet.

Vi söker leg psykolog till Psykiatriska akut- och bedömningsmottagningen

Psykiatriska akut- och bedömningsmottagningen riktar sig en bred psykiatrisk patientgrupp. Mottagningens uppdrag innefattar psykiatrisk akutsjukvård, diagnostik och behandling. Ett centralt uppdrag är psykiatriska bedömningar av patienter som remitterats från annan vårdgivare/ aktör. I det ingår i vissa fall att hänvisa patienter till rätt vårdnivå inom regionen. Vi erbjuder vård i form av bland annat läkemedel, utredning, kurativa insatser samt psykologisk behandling. Akut- och bedömningsmottagningen har multiprofessionella team där skötare, sjuksköterskor, kuratorer, psykologer och läkare ingår.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som psykolog hos oss bidrar du med kunskap och engagemang som får människor att känna sig trygga.

Som psykolog på psykiatrisk akut- och bedömningsmottagning kommer din huvudsakliga arbetsuppgift vara allmänpsykiatriska basbedömningar med nya patienter till vuxenpsykiatrin. Bedömningarna görs på ett strukturerat sätt med fokus på initial diagnostik och bedömning av vårdnivå. Arbete med neuropsykiatriska utredningar förekommer också, även dessa görs i enlighet med klinikens rutiner. I arbetet har du gott stöd av det professionella teamet på mottagningen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Leg. psykolog med erfarenhet av arbete inom psykiatrisk vård eller annan likvärdig verksamhet. Även erfarenhet av strukturerad diagnostik/utredning är meriterande.

Vi söker dig som tycker om att ta egna initiativ, arbetar strukturerat och vill engagera dig i utvecklings- och förändringsarbeten.

Arbetet förutsätter att du är trygg i din roll som psykolog, att du kan arbeta självständigt och har en god kommunikativ förmåga, både i relation till kollegor såväl som patienter.

jobs.title: Senior Programmer
jobs.description:
Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. 
 
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 

WHAT'S THE ROLE?

We are looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to join our Planet Coaster 2 team and play an important role in delivering quality experiences to our players. Joining an established and diverse team, you will bring experience, expertise, curiosity and energy to the development of our games.  You will program primarily in C++ working with our in-house Cobra engine and cross-platform game code.

As part of our development team, you will have a fantastic opportunity to apply, expand and share your expertise in modern game development techniques, and help push the boundaries of the current generation of gaming platforms. You will be collaborating with a talented team of programmers working on game features alongside specialists across multiple disciplines. You will also collaborate with game designers and QA testers on tuning the player experience.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of the team behind our multi‑million‑selling, cross‑platform titles and help us continue delivering exceptional gaming experiences to our players.    


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Architecting and developing game features and systems.
  • Collaborating effectively with team members and discipline leads.
  • Designing and implementing technology using structured, efficient, maintainable, and well‑documented code. 
  • Considering the impact of systems on other disciplines and projects, ensuring usability, scalability, and support for long-term maintenance.
  • Guiding more junior programmers and providing feedback on their code, documentation and approach to game development.
  • Creating and maintaining project wide documentation for more complex systems, features and workflows. 
  • Participating in, contributing to, and occasionally leading aspects of project reviews and meetings, as required.

    • WHAT YOU'LL BRING
    • A track record in the development of complex game features in released titles.  
    • Excellent problem solving and programming skills using modern C++.
    • Experience working in a large codebase with the ability to adapt to established methods.
    • Proficient profiling and optimisation skills for CPU performance and memory usage.
    • Experience of cross-discipline collaboration with game designers and content creators.
    • A genuine passion for video games.
    • A desire to be part of a world class team and contribute to its continued success.
    • A proactive approach to collaborative learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.
    • A drive to expand your existing expertise in game development, and a passion for continued learning and self-improvement.

    BONUS IF YOU HAVE
    • Experience working with a proprietary game engine.
    • Familiarity providing technical direction to teams for the development of core systems, game features or workstreams.
    • Experience managing or mentoring other programmers to support their growth.
    • Cross-platform development experience on shipped titles, including consoles (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.).
    • Working knowledge of an entity component system.

    WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

    You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

    Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.  

    We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events. 

    We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative.

jobs.title: Fast stilling som psykolog
jobs.description:
Om stillinga

Me søker ein engasjert og fagleg trygg psykolog som vil vere med å styrke arbeidet vårt for barn, unge og familiar. Stillinga er del av ei ny eining der fleire tenester vert samla for å kunne samarbeide tettare, arbeide meir heilskapleg og tilby betre og meir robuste tenester til målgruppa.

I tillegg til psykolog inngår PPT, helsestasjon og skulehelseteneste, barnevern og jordmortenesta i den nye eininga. Saman skal me ha særleg merksemd på tidleg innsats, førebygging og tverrfagleg samarbeid til beste for barn, unge og familiane deira.

Som psykolog i eining for barn, unge og familiar vil du bidra med psykologfagleg kompetanse inn i både førebyggande arbeid, tidleg innsats og tverrfagleg samarbeid. Me ser etter deg som ønsker å gjere ein forskjell for barn, unge og familiar, og som vil vere med å utvikle sterke og samordna tenester med fokus på tidleg innsats. Eininga har og faste treffpunkt på tvers av tenestene og eit etablert samarbeid med BUP-Fana i spesialisthelsetenesta.

Ansvars- og arbeidsoppgåver

  • Klinisk arbeid med oppfølging av barn, unge og familiar
  • Rettleiing og konsultasjon til føresette og fagpersonar
  • Undervisning, rettleiing og deltaking i tverrfaglege møte
  • Bidra i førebyggande og helsefremande arbeid
  • Fagutvikling og kompetansedeling i eininga
  • Samhandling og samarbeid med psykisk helse og rus for vaksne

Kvalifikasjonskrav

Kvalifikasjonskrav

  • Norsk autorisasjon som psykolog
  • Interesse for arbeid med barn, unge og familiar
  • Evne til å arbeide sjølvstendig og i tett samarbeid med andre
  • Utviklingsorientert og ønsker å bidra i oppbygginga av ei ny eining
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne
  • Førarkort klasse B
  • Erfaring frå arbeid med barn og unge og frå tverrfagleg samarbeid er ein fordel, men også andre med relevant bakgrunn kan søke

Personlege eigenskapar

 Vi ønsker oss ein kollega som

  • Har eit sterkt engasjement for barn og unge.
  • Er fagleg trygg, fleksibel og løysingsorientert.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og trivst med å jobbe tverrfagleg
  • Arbeider sjølvstendig, strukturert og målretta.
  • Har gode relasjonelle ferdigheiter og evne til å skape tillit.

Vi tilbyr
  • Ei spennande stilling i ei ny og viktig eining
  • Moglegheit til å vere med og forme tenestene for framtida
  • Tett samarbeid med dyktige kollegaer frå ulike fagområde
  • Varierte og meiningsfulle arbeidsoppgåver
  • Løn og tilsettingsvilkår etter gjeldande avtaleverk

Slik søker du

Send søknad og CV ved å klikke på knappen merka "Søk stilling" på denne sida.

Det er søkar sitt ansvar å sørge for at alle relevante vedlegg er lagt inn innan fristen, som for eksempel attester og vitnemål. Dersom vitnemål, karakterutskrifter eller annan dokumentasjon ikkje er på eit skandinavisk språk eller engelsk, må søkar sjølv laste opp attesterte omsettingar.

Ikkje send søknad på e-post til enkeltpersonar i kommunen.

Vi gjer merksam på at i følge offentleglova § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysningar om søkaren bli offentleggjort sjølv om søkaren har oppmoda om ikkje å bli ført opp på offentleg søkarliste. Søkaren vil alltid bli varsla på førehand dersom søkarlista blir offentleggjort.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Austevoll er ein øykommune sør-vest i Vestland fylke. Austevoll er den største fiskerikommunen i landet med svært høg næringsaktivitet og byr på eit mangfald av spanande jobbar.

Kommunen sitt administrasjonskontor held til på kommunehuset på Storebø, cirka 5 minuttar med bil frå ferje- og snøggbåtkai. Godt eigna for pendlarar.

Kommunen har eit folketal på om lag 5400 og dagleg pendlar omtrent 700 til Austevoll frå nabokommunar.

Vi er rundt 450 fast tilsette som er opptatt av å gi innbyggarane våre gode kommunale tenester.

Vi kan tilby meiningsfylte og utfordrande oppgåver og gode, offentlege pensjons- og forsikringsordningar. Administrasjonsmålet i kommunen er nynorsk. 

Studielånsslett – har du studielån og er busett i Austevoll kommune kan du ha rett til å få sletta 25 000 kroner av studielånet per år via Lånekassen si ordning for distriktskommunar.

Vi ønsker deg velkommen som søkar til stilling i Austevoll kommune!

jobs.title: Bli med og skap små øyeblikk som betyr alt for ei livsglad jente på 4 år
jobs.employer: MEDVIND ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Har du lyst på en meningsfull jobb der du kan gjøre en stor forskjell i hverdagen til ei lita jente? Vi søker trygge, omsorgsfulle og positive BPA-assistenter til ei sosial og livsglad jente på 4 år.

Hun sitter i vogn og trenger assistenter som kan bidra til trygge, gode øyeblikk gjennom lek, aktivitet, omsorg og tilstedeværelse. Hun liker turer i nærmiljøet, svømming og dyr. Jobben passer godt for deg som liker barn, har et varmt og rolig vesen, og møter henne med tålmodighet, respekt og godt humør.

Dette er en mulighet til å

· Gjøre en forskjell i et barns hverdag

· Bidra til trygge, gode og innholdsrike dager

· Skape fine øyeblikk gjennom lek, aktivitet og omsorg

· Få en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag

Hva går jobben ut på?

Du blir en del av et lite og trygt team rundt jenta. Arbeidsdagene kan inneholde hjelp i daglige rutiner, måltider, trening, svømming, turer og andre aktiviteter hun setter pris på. Det vil også være treningsopphold gjennom året, der assistentene kan være en viktig støtte. Vi har ledige faste stillinger og behov for tilkallingsassistenter. Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være ettermiddag, kveld og natt, med mulighet for hverdager, helg og ferier etter avtale. På sikt vil det også bli vurdert mulighet for medleverturnus. Stillingsstørrelse, vakter og arbeidstid avtales nærmere ut fra familiens behov og din tilgjengelighet.

Litt om jenta du skal jobbe med

· Hun er sosial og livsglad

· Hun liker turer, svømming og dyr

· Hun trenger assistenter som følger hennes tempo og dagsform

· Hun har behov for omsorg, forutsigbarhet og godt humør

Hvem ser vi etter?

· Deg som er glad i barn og møter dem med varme og respekt

· Deg som er tålmodig, trygg og har godt humør

· Deg som trives med lek, aktivitet, utetid og svømming

· Deg som er fleksibel, samarbeidsvillig og ansvarsbevisst

· Erfaring fra barn, helse eller omsorg er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Hva får du?

· En meningsfull jobb i et barns hverdag

· Varierte dager med lek, omsorg og aktivitet

· God opplæring og tett oppfølging

· Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø med fokus på trygghet og trivsel

· Mulighet for fleksibilitet rundt stillingsstørrelse og vakter

Klar for en jobb med mening?

Hvis dette høres ut som en jobb for deg, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Dette er en varm, variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag der du får bidra til trygghet, mestring og livsglede. Politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse. Send oss en søknad – vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.



Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Sustainability Strategist
jobs.description:
Are you interested in driving and developing Swedbank’s sustainability agenda and contribute to further integration of sustainability into the bank’s processes? We are looking for a Sustainability Strategist who will contribute to the acceleration of Swedbank’s sustainability transition.

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Develop and contribute to the integration of Swedbank’s climate and other sustainability commitments into the bank’s business and operating model in close cooperation with all relevant units (i.e. business areas, risk units).

• Provide expertise knowledge and guidance to various stakeholders on subject matters.

• Perform analysis and contribute to development of climate-related sector specific tools, methodologies and policies that support business and risk management processes.

• Maintain and develop sustainability targets and metrics in line with Swedbank’s external commitments, strategic priorities, regulatory requirements and other stakeholder expectations.

• Contribute to external communication on Swedbank’s sustainability agenda.

• Assess sustainability aspects of customers and transactions.

• Drive and/or contribute to various projects within Group Sustainability that support and accelerate Swedbank’s sustainability transition.



What is needed in this role:

• Master’s degree in relevant field.

• A minimum of 1-3 years of work experience within the financial sector.

• Understanding of how the sustainability transition affects the banking industry.

• Knowledge and experience of the main carbon accounting and climate target setting frameworks within the financial industry.

• Solid understanding of the sustainability drivers within different sectors.

• Knowledge of both existing and upcoming EU sustainable finance regulations.

• Excellent analytical capability.

jobs.title: B2B-mötesbokare till soliga Málaga i September
jobs.description:
B2B-mötesbokare till soliga Málaga – arbeta med svenska företagsprojekt med start i September.

Är du redo att utveckla dina kommunikationsförmågor och arbeta med professionella B2B-projekt under solen i Málaga?

Vi söker svenska mötesbokare som vill bli en del av vårt växande team i Spanien. Du arbetar med svenska företagsprojekt och hjälper våra samarbetspartners att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter genom kvalitativa möten med rätt beslutsfattare.

Du blir en del av ett mindre och engagerat team där kvalitet, struktur och goda resultat står i fokus. Vi arbetar uteslutande med B2B – inga privatkunder.

Vad gör en B2B-mötesbokare?

Som B2B-mötesbokare kontaktar du svenska företag och bokar möten åt våra samarbetspartners. Du skapar professionella dialoger, identifierar företagens behov och säkerställer att rätt beslutsfattare får möjlighet att träffa en specialist eller rådgivare.

Du får en gedigen introduktion till varje projekt och arbetar med etablerade företag inom flera spännande branscher – bland annat inom HR, lön, HR-administration, IT-lösningar, betalningslösningar och lagerstyrningssystem.

Den perfekta kandidaten

Vi söker dig som är social, nyfiken och tycker om att skapa nya relationer. Du kommunicerar professionellt på svenska och trivs med att prata med företagskunder.

Erfarenhet av mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundkontakt är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, din vilja att utvecklas och din förmåga att skapa förtroende i samtal med svenska företag.

Du blir en del av ett team där kvalitet, struktur, samarbete och personlig utveckling är centralt.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

    Kontakta svenska företag och boka möten för professionella rådgivare och konsulter
    Skapa dialog med beslutsfattare och identifiera relevanta affärsbehov
    Arbeta med flera B2B-projekt inom exempelvis HR, IT, fintech, försäkring, pension och affärssystem
    Säkerställa hög kvalitet i kunddialoger och mötesbokningar
    Bidra till teamets gemensamma mål och resultat
    Utveckla dina kunskaper inom kommunikation, försäljning och affärsförståelse

Dina kvalifikationer

    Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa relationer
    Intresse för B2B-kommunikation och professionell kundkontakt
    Positiv inställning och vilja att lära dig nya färdigheter
    Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och målinriktat
    Erfarenhet inom mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundservice är meriterande men inget krav

Lön och förmåner

    Fast lön med attraktiv bonusmodell
    Fast anställning på kontoret i Málaga
    Grundlig introduktion och utbildning inom alla projekt
    Möjlighet att arbeta med flera olika branscher och målgrupper
    Ett starkt svenskt team med god sammanhållning
    Löpande utvecklingsmöjligheter inom försäljning och rådgivning
    En arbetsmiljö där kvalitet prioriteras framför kvantitet

Vad får du ut av att arbeta hos oss?

    Praktisk erfarenhet av professionell B2B-kommunikation
    Möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter inom försäljning, rådgivning och affärsutveckling
    Inblick i spännande branscher som HR, IT, fintech och företagslösningar
    Möjlighet att arbeta i internationell miljö med svenska företag
    Ett liv och en karriär i soliga Málaga
    Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som är ambitiös och vill växa
    Ett engagerat team med fokus på samarbete, utveckling och resultat

Är du redo för nästa steg i din karriär och vill kombinera professionell utveckling med livet i Spanien? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Behandlingspedagog som vill göra skillnad
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.



SiS LVM-hem Lunden tar emot kvinnor med alkohol-, narkotika- eller blandmissbruk. Vi tar emot klienter som har psykisk ohälsa och klienter som behöver medicinsk omvårdnad. Vi har verksamhet i Lund.





Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de  klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper  inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med aktiviteter, städning, matlagning med mera.Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

Arbetstiden är enligt schema dag - kväll och helg.

Som ny medarbetare kommer du att genomgå SiS grundutbildning på 10 veckor.  I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion och utbildningen rustar dig för behandlarrollen i SiS verksamhet. Du kommer även genomgå en obligatorisk, teoterisk introduktion samt en praktisk konflikthanering, lokalt och nästa tillfälle är den 23-24 september

Vi kommer stärka upp bemaningen för ännu bättre vård- och behandling till våra klienter och anställer därför flera nya medarbetare

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra klienter. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med klienter likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    B- körkort
    God svenska i tal och skrift

Meriterande



    Erfarenhet av arbetet inom SiS
    Erfarenhet av arbete med människor i utsatta livssituationer, t.ex. arbete inom psykiatri eller inom LSS omsorg
    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på Kriminalvården, t.ex. Kriminalvårdare
    Väktarutbildning
    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på Migrationsverket, t.ex. handläggare på Förvaret
    Utbildning inom vård-och omsorg
    Erfarenhet av arbete med vår målgrupp

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsterna är en tillsvidareanställningar på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.



Tester och arbetsprover kan komma att ingå i rekryteringsprocessen.







SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.



För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning.



Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.





OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Autonomous & Electric Mobility
jobs.description:
Have you recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field, or do you have up to 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer? Are you interested in software development, autonomous technology and solving complex technical challenges? Our client is now looking for a Software Engineer to join their Control Tower team in Gothenburg.

Working as a Software Engineer at our client

Our client is a technology company working with digital, electric and autonomous solutions for the future of road freight. You will be joining the Control Tower team, which is responsible for the system used by operators to monitor and assist autonomous vehicles remotely.

As a Software Engineer, you will work closely with the Team Lead and Product Manager, as well as with other teams across the organization. The team works end-to-end, which means that you will be involved in several parts of the development process and have the opportunity to take ownership of what you build. Your work will include software development, testing, system design and data streaming, with a strong focus on safety and reliability.

You will be part of a collaborative team where people are happy to help each other, share knowledge and solve problems together. The company also has a strong social culture, with different activities, happenings and employee-led clubs throughout the year.

The position is hybrid and based in Gothenburg.

Being a consultant at Nexer Tech Talent

Nexer Tech Talent specializes in giving tech talents the opportunity to build their careers at leading technology companies. For this role, you will be employed by Nexer Tech Talent and work as a consultant at our client in Gothenburg.

You will be part of the team from day one and work with real products and technical challenges alongside experienced colleagues. You will also have a consultant manager at Nexer Tech Talent who will support you throughout the assignment.

The intention is that, after the agreed consulting period, you will be offered direct employment with our client, provided that the collaboration works well for both parties.

Desired qualifications:

    

Newly graduated or up to 3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer

    

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field

    

Good foundation in software design, version control, automated software testing, data structures and algorithms

    

Experience working with Linux-based operating systems

    

Understanding of network protocols such as IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, TLS and HTTP

    

Fluent in English, spoken and written

We are looking for someone who is curious, driven and enjoys working with others. You take responsibility for your work and like getting involved in different parts of a solution. Since the team works end-to-end, it is important that you enjoy working broadly and contributing where needed. For a newly graduated candidate, personality and drive are particularly important. You take initiative, want to develop and are comfortable becoming an active part of the team from the start.

It is a plus if you have experience with:

    

Rust and/or Golang

    

Cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform or another cloud provider

    

gRPC or similar RPC frameworks

    

Safety-critical and/or real-time systems

Application

Does this sound like you? We are constantly screening resumes, and applications are considered on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Selection and interviews are held continuously.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Tech Recruiter Jennie Kähäri, jennie.kahari@nexergroup.com

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

About Nexer Tech Talent

Nexer Tech Talent is part of the Nexer Group – a tech company with deep roots in Swedish entrepreneurship and innovation. Together, we are over 2500 employees in 16 countries who, for more than 35 years, have helped our clients stay ahead strategically, technologically, and communicatively. Learn more about Nexer Tech Talent here.

jobs.title: Partner Sales Manager | DACH
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

What will you be doing at DeepL?

We are looking for a Manager, Partner Sales to join the DeepL Partnerships Department and lead the DACH region. As part of our Global Partnerships team, you will be responsible for building and scaling DeepL’s indirect business through Value-Added Resellers (VARs), Distributors, and SI partners.

You will drive DeepL’s next stage of partner-led growth — establishing new partnerships for our AI-powered productivity solutions and delivering strong, measurable impact on sourced pipeline and Closed Won Business.

Your responsibilities

  • In this regional position, you will drive accelerated revenue growth for DeepL through the recruitment and management of partnerships that represent DeepL’s next phase of growth beyond translation - into Voice technology and AI-supported productivity.

  • Win new high-value partnerships through strategic relationship-building and commercial negotiations. Identify, recruit, and onboard partners with the reach and expertise to drive DeepL’s market expansion across the DACH region.

  • Manage partner sales performance, ensuring forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and effective execution of agreed revenue targets.

  • Develop and own the DACH Channel Partner Plan that sets direction for all partner engagement, GTM priorities, and revenue planning, with quarterly business reviews and performance alignment with both partner and internal executives.

  • In collaboration with Partner Marketing and Enablement teams, own, drive and coordinate and scale programs for onboarding, enablement, co-marketing, and incentives that help partners accelerate pipeline creation and close rates.

  • Drive partner enablement in close collaboration with DeepL’s Enablement and Marketing teams to ensure partner sellers and engineers are trained and certified on DeepL solutions.

  • Support partner sellers with opportunity qualification, registration, pricing, contract management, and closing support.

  • Collaborate closely with DeepL’s direct sales and regional leadership to ensure alignment, co-sell readiness, and partner engagement throughout the sales cycle.

  • Proactively identify and resolve channel conflicts to ensure positive outcomes and trust between DeepL and its partners.

  • This role reports to the Head of Partner Growth for EMEA and North America, with a close alignment to the DACH Regional Sales Leadership.

Qualities we look for

  • Circa 3-5 years of experience in channel or partner sales within SaaS, AI, or cloud technology companies, with a proven record of building and scaling reseller and distribution ecosystems across the DACH region.

  • Strong commercial background driving multimillion-euro ARR targets through Reseller, Distributor, System Integrator and Cloud partnerships.

  • Track record of managing strategic partnerships in the region, ideally with established relationships across leading resellers, distributors, or telcos.

  • Deep understanding of partner GTM motions - sell-to, sell-with, sell-through - and ability to operationalise these models.

  • Experience building scalable partner programs and working with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Product).

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience engaging senior executives in complex sales environments.

  • Knowledge of AI, productivity, or enterprise software markets is a plus and will accelerate time to success.

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management tools such as Crossbeam, Tackle.io, and PRM systems.

  • Native or bilingual level German and Business level English

The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! jobs.title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Working Student / IDP: Software Development (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Shape the future of real-world LiDAR applications at a leading high-tech company in Munich.

At Blickfeld, we develop our own innovative LiDAR technology based on a frictionless MEMS mirror. Our sensors create 3D data of the environment in high resolution. These 3D point clouds contain detailed information about the exact size, position and speed of objects which allows us to analyze the shape and movement of people, vehicles and other objects. Blickfeld LiDAR sensors excel in a wide variety of applications, e.g. security, volume measurement and traffic management, and smart cities.

As part of our innovative software team, you will contribute to the integration of our LiDAR sensors into modern security environments. After an onboarding phase, you will work on interoperability testing, system integrations, and the development of device software components with a high degree of autonomy.

Tasks

System Integration: You test the interoperability of our LiDAR devices with various Video Management Systems (VMS) and Video Surveillance (CCTV) platforms to ensure seamless integration into existing security environments.

Testing Environment Maintenance: You maintain and extend the testing environment used for validating device integrations, including installation and configuration of VMS platforms, and troubleshooting of the test infrastructure.

Software Development: You contribute to the development and maintenance of our device integration stack by implementing, integrating, and debugging software components running on the device.

Validation & Documentation: You document integration results, compliance findings, and system behavior to support interoperability improvements and product development.

Requirements

Education: You are currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Programming Skills: You have solid experience with Python and TypeScript. You are familiar with object-oriented design principles and comfortable working in complex development environments.

Automated Testing: You have experience with testing frameworks such as PyTest and understand modern testing practices. You are capable of manually counting points within the 3D point cloud space.

Technical Stack (Plus): Experience with one or more of the following technologies is a plus: GitLab, Docker, CI/CD tools, CMake, Asyncio, Protobuf, gRPC, RTSP, gStreamer, open6d, SOAP, Web Services, ONVIF.

Mindset: You enjoy solving technical problems and contributing to the development of reliable and robust software solutions.

Communication & Languages: You have fluent English skills and are comfortable collaborating in an international team.

Benefits

Purpose & Technology: You work on cutting-edge LiDAR technology that enables safer, smarter, and more efficient environments—from critical infrastructure to smart cities—while contributing directly to real-world impact.

Ownership & Growth: You operate in a dynamic high-tech environment with flat hierarchies, where individual initiative is valued, responsibilities are clear, and your ideas can quickly make a difference.

Agile Ways of Working: You operate in an agile setup with monthly sprints and releases, allowing you to regularly implement new ideas and see tangible results.

Work Model: We value face-to-face interaction within the team, so you will mainly work on-site at the office. In some cases, and by arrangement, you can occasionally work from home.

Team & Culture: You become part of a passionate, technology-driven team where like-minded people inspire each other and share a strong enthusiasm for innovation.

Team Spirit: We value a positive working environment and promote team spirit through regular team events and joint activities.

Health & Fitness: You receive a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, giving you access to a wide range of sports and fitness activities such as yoga, swimming, climbing, and team sports across Munich.

Excellent coffee: For the perfect start to the day and in between, we have extremely good coffee to support and invigorate you.

We, Ivan Smolin (Hiring Manager) und Yves Gendronneau (HR) are looking forward to your application, including your CV, certificates and a motivation letter.

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer – AI & Automation (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you will own the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


This is not a traditional RevOps or analytics role.


We are looking for a builder who can understand a commercial problem in the morning and start shipping a solution in the afternoon. You will combine software engineering, automation, AI, data, and commercial thinking to make our GTM organization faster and more effective.


You will have significant ownership over how autarc builds its GTM infrastructure as we scale across Europe.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Build our GTM operating system

Own and continuously improve the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Deploy AI into real workflows

Move AI beyond prototypes.

Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Own GTM data & analytics

Create a reliable data foundation for our commercial organization.

Connect and structure data across our CRM, calling infrastructure, product, billing, and other GTM systems.

Build dashboards and internal tools that give teams real-time visibility into the metrics that matter: pipeline, activity, conversion, ARR, retention, and individual and team performance.

Make sure we can answer important commercial questions with data rather than assumptions.


Build, don’t just recommend

You will personally implement what you design.

Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

Technology is a means, not the outcome.

Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and can independently ship solutions using Python and/or TypeScript.

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs.

  • You understand modern AI tooling and have already built applications or workflows using LLMs.

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.

  • You understand how modern B2B SaaS companies generate revenue and are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems connecting them.

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification.

  • You prioritize commercial impact over technical perfection.

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have previously worked as a GTM Engineer, Growth Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, RevOps Engineer, or in a similarly hands-on technical role.

  • You have experience with B2B SaaS GTM stacks and tools such as HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms.

  • You have built internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You understand data modeling and have experience building a data warehouse or analytics infrastructure.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

A high-ownership role with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure from the ground up instead of maintaining legacy systems.

Direct collaboration with our founders and GTM leadership.

A fast-moving environment where you can ship and test ideas quickly.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission

Gestalte mit uns den globalen Handel neu – in einem schnell wachsenden Startup!
Wir sind traide AI – ein VC-finanziertes B2B-Deep-Tech-Startup aus Berlin. Mit KI lösen wir eine der am meisten unterschätzten und zugleich kritischsten Herausforderungen im internationalen Handel: die Zollkonformität. Unsere Software automatisiert die Produktklassifizierung, reduziert regulatorische Fehler und hilft Kund:innen, bis zu 83 % ihrer Zeit zu sparen.
Marken wie BMW, Koro und Jack Wolfskin vertrauen uns bereits. In den letzten 12 Monaten sind wir 4x gewachsen – und wir fangen gerade erst an.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Verantworte den kompletten Loop. Bring ein User-Problem von der groben Idee bis zum ausgelieferten Interface: Brief schreiben, Flow designen, prototypen und shippen, mit so wenigen Übergaben wie möglich.
  • Nutze KI als Kraftverstärker. Explore und prototype mit KI-Tools, Figma oder Code, was auch immer am schnellsten zum Ziel führt. Dein Geschmack ist die entscheidende Ebene: Du erkennst, wenn KI-generiertes UI falsch ist, auch wenn es richtig aussieht, und du korrigierst es.
  • Löse vom ersten Prinzip aus. Denk über die richtige Interaktion für das User-Problem nach, statt zur Komponenten-Bibliothek zu greifen.
  • Kümmere dich um die letzten 10 %. Die Details, die andere übersehen, machen ein Compliance-Produkt vertrauenswürdig.
  • Arbeite in kleinen, fokussierten Pods. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen, kein Warten. Du arbeitest eng mit zwei oder drei Leuten, die dasselbe Modell teilen.
  • Sei an Ergebnissen messbar. Kenn die Metrik, die dein Team bewegt. Miss deine Woche daran, was sich für User verändert hat, nicht an gelieferten Screens.
  • Geh über Design hinaus. Lies die API-Spec, sprich direkt mit Usern, bau in Code, wenn das schneller ist als Figma.


Nach wem wir suchen

Handwerkliche Design-Qualität ist hier die Basis, kein Bonus. Was dich auszeichnet, sind Bandbreite und Urteilsvermögen: Du weißt, wie „great" aussieht, du merkst, wenn etwas richtig aussieht, sich aber falsch anfühlt, und du bringst ein Team dorthin.

  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (C1 oder besser) sind Voraussetzung. Deutsch ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Echtes Design-Handwerk mit Track Record: Du hast Interfaces geshippt, die echte User ohne Erklärung bedienen konnten, und du kannst die Metrik nennen, die sich dadurch bewegt hat.
  • Starkes visuelles Gespür, hohe Ansprüche und ein Auge fürs Detail.
  • Bandbreite über Design, Product und Engineering: Du bist von einem User-Problem zum testbaren Prototyp gekommen, ohne auf einen Brief zu warten, und hast mit KI-Coding-Tools etwas Echtes gebaut. Du bist nicht auf eine:n Engineer angewiesen, um deine Vision umzusetzen.
  • Du hast persönliche KI-Workflows aufgebaut, die dich spürbar schneller machen, und weißt, wann du KI-Output vertraust, editierst oder verwirfst.
  • Du fühlst dich in Ambiguität wohl: Du shippst, sammelst Signale und iterierst, statt auf volle Klarheit zu warten.
  • Du kannst deine Arbeit zeigen (Portfolio oder Beispiele).
  • Idealerweise hast du an Produkten gearbeitet, bei denen Fehler echte Konsequenzen haben (Fintech, Healthtech, Logistik, Compliance), das ist aber kein Muss.
  • Du bist in Berlin oder bereit umzuziehen.
Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn…
  • Du willst, dass ein PM das Problem definiert und ein:e Engineer die Lösung baut.
  • Du dich sträubst, mit Code oder KI zu arbeiten.
  • Du polierte Figma-Files übergibst und deinen Job für erledigt hältst.
  • Du dich nur an deinem Geschmack misst, nicht an Ergebnissen.


Warum wir?

Was dich erwartet

  • Abwechslung im Alltag → jedes Problem bringt eigene Anforderungen mit, kein Tag ist wie der andere
  • Sichtbarer Impact → du siehst die direkten Resultate deiner Arbeit, für unsere Kund:innen und für traide AI
  • Direkter Einfluss aufs Produkt → deine Entscheidungen gehen live und prägen, was User täglich nutzen
  • Team-Kultur → ein Team, das transparent kommuniziert, Humor schätzt und sich mit Respekt und Aufrichtigkeit unterstützt
  • Flexibles Arbeiten → wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro am Senefelderplatz in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte. Homeoffice ist an zwei Tagen pro Woche möglich
