jobs.title: Engasjert vernepleier søkes til BPA-ordning (75% stilling)
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert og trygg vernepleier til en fast 75% stilling i en BPA-ordning i Malvik. Her får du følge én bruker tett over tid og bidra til en hverdag med mestring, utvikling og god livskvalitet – i et miljø der relasjon og trygghet står i sentrum.

Om stillingen

Som vernepleier i denne BPA-ordningen blir du en viktig fagperson rundt en voksen person med funksjonsnedsettelse. Du jobber hovedsakelig i brukerens hjem og nærmiljø, sammen med et lite og stabilt team.

Typiske arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Målrettet miljøarbeid og tilrettelegging i hjem, fritid og nærmiljø
  • Praktisk bistand i hverdagslige gjøremål og personlig bistand
  • Oppfølging av helse, struktur, rutiner og tiltak i hverdagen
  • Samarbeid med pårørende, arbeidsgiver og eventuelle andre fagpersoner
  • Dokumentasjon og faglige vurderinger knyttet til tiltak og utvikling
Om arbeidsplassen

Vi er en privat aktør innen helse- og omsorgssektoren, med fokus på personlig assistanse til personer med funksjonsnedsettelser. Vi jobber for selvstendighet, mestring og god livskvalitet gjennom individuelle og tilpassede tjenester.

Hos oss vil du oppleve:

  • Et inkluderende, støttende og positivt arbeidsmiljø
  • Tett samarbeid i et lite team rundt én bruker
  • Fokus på trygghet, stabilitet og gode relasjoner over tid
  • Profesjonelle og ryddige rammer med tydelige forventninger og god oppfølging
Hvem vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en vernepleier som trives med å jobbe tett på én bruker, og som liker å bidra til forutsigbarhet, ro og gode opplevelser i hverdagen.

Vi ønsker at du:

  • Har autorisasjon som vernepleier
  • Har gjerne minimum 1–2 års relevant erfaring (ikke et krav for å søke)
  • Er trygg, rolig, ansvarsbevisst og god på relasjonsbygging
  • Kan jobbe selvstendig og samtidig samarbeide godt i team
  • Behersker norsk godt, både skriftlig og muntlig
Arbeidstid og vilkår

Vi tilbyr forutsigbare rammer og gode vilkår, med fokus på både trivsel og kvalitet i tjenestene.

Hos oss får du:

  • Fast 75% stilling med oversiktlig turnus og lengre friperioder
  • Lønn etter tariff, med tillegg for kveld, natt og helg
  • God og personlig opplæring ved oppstart
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet for tilpasning av turnus der det lar seg gjøre
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Slik søker du

Send inn en kortfattet søknad og CV gjennom søknadsskjemaet knyttet til annonsen. Skriv gjerne litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe i BPA, og hva som motiverer deg til å jobbe tett på én bruker over tid.

Kandidater vurderes fortløpende. Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad.


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Familjerådgivningen i Lund söker nya kollegor
jobs.description:
Är du socionom med steg 1 utbildning samt har erfarenhet från arbete på familjerådgivare/vill arbeta med Familjerådgivning? Då kan vi ha en tjänst för dig.

Om rollen och dina arbetsuppgifter

Familjerådgivningens uppdrag är att genom samtal medverka till att bearbeta samlevnadsproblem och konflikter, främst i par- och familjerelationer. Som familjerådgivare hos oss arbetar du mestadels ensam i samtalen men vid behov kan kollegor utföra samtal tillsammans med par/familjer. Samtalen har varierande inriktning men utgår ifrån det relationella med exempelvis inriktning mot reparation, separation, kommunikation, konflikter, familjeliv samt sex- och samlevnadsfrågor.  Som familjerådgivare utför du ett viktigt arbete utifrån förebyggande betydelse i relation till individers psykiska hälsa och barns uppväxtvillkor. Centralt i samtalen är barnens perspektiv och behov vilket är viktigt att hålla levande i samtalen med de vuxna paren. Det förekommer även en del generationssamtal. Det finns även möjlighet att vara delaktig i våra grupper,  Vi två och Lustkurs.

Vi samverkar med övriga Familjerådgivningar i Skåne samt även nationellt utifrån exempelvis KFR, Kommunernas Familjerådgivning.

Utifrån att två av våra kollegor valt att gå vidare till andra uppdrag söker vi nu två ny kollegor till teamet. Tjänsterna är tillsvidare samt på heltid.  

Vi söker dig

Vi söker dig som har socionomexamen eller examen som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig samt har grundläggande psykoterapiutbildning(Steg 1). Vidare ska du ha minst 3 års erfarenhet av socialt behandlingsarbete med familjer eller samtalsbehandling utifrån relationell problematik. Meriterande är erfarenhet av arbete inom familjerådgivning eller med par/familjer. För tjänsten krävs goda kunskaper i svenska, meriterande är om du kan utföra professionella behandlings samtal på engelska och/eller annat språk. Ytterligare meriterande kunskaper är om du har vidareutbildningar inom metoder som kan anses stärkande för uppdraget exempelvis EFT(Emotionsfokuserad terapi), sexologi, våld i nära relation, psykiatri eller liknande.

Som person vill vi att du är trygg, stabil och relationsskapande. Vi ser gärna att du är uthållig och innovativ men samtidigt självgående och strukturerad. Vidare behöver du vara flexibel, gilla utvecklingsarbete och gärna ha kul på jobbet. Mångfald, bred kompetens och heterogen arbetsgrupp är en viktig strävan för teamet.  

Stämmer ovan in på dig och du vill arbeta i ett team med hög kompetens, där kollegor och ledning sätter värde på din kompetens och utvecklingsinriktning då tycker vi att du ska söka dig till oss.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden. Vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi erbjuder dig

Som familjerådgivare i Lund får du regelbunden kvalificerad handledning i två mindre grupper och som nyanställd ges du en strukturerad introduktion som planeras utifrån individuella behov. Som medarbetare hos oss erbjuds du en rad förmåner med fokus på balans, trygghet och hälsa. Lunds kommun är en stor organisation med många spännande verksamheter och möjligheter för medarbetare till utveckling. Som medarbetare får du även tillgång till vår förmånsportal där du enkelt kan se dina förmåner och administrera dessa.

Det här ger vi dig som medarbetare

Om arbetsplatsen

Familjerådgivningen i Lund är en kommunal familjerådgivning som drivs i samverkan mellan sex kommuner, Burlöv, Lomma, Kävlinge, Höör, Staffanstorp och Lund. Mottagningen ligger centralt i Lund och tillhör organisatoriskt Arbetsmarknads- och Socialförvaltningen i Lund. Teamet på mottagningen består av 9 heltidstjänster som familjerådgivare, just nu fördelat på 10 familjerådgivare. I teamet ingår även enhets administrator samt enhetschef.

Vi är en del av arbetsmarknads- och socialförvaltningen där cirka 600 medarbetare ger stöd till de lundabor som behöver socialtjänstens insatser. Tillsammans ser vi till att barn och unga får en så bra uppväxt som möjligt. Vi utgår från hela familjens situation och att ingen ska fara illa. Det handlar om att ge stöd till vuxna med skadligt bruk och beroende eller psykiska funktionsnedsättningar, till dem som behöver ekonomiskt bistånd, god man, förvaltare eller stöd för att kunna studera eller arbeta, samt till flyktingar.

Här får du plats att växa. Inom Lunds kommun sätter vi kunskapen i centrum och skapar möjligheter att utvecklas i arbetslivet. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande arbetsmiljö, och chans att påverka och göra skillnad. Vill du bli en av oss?

jobs.title: Robot Pilot
jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

Role Description:

Tier 2 Robot Pilots are trusted, high-output robot teleoperators who reliably collect high-quality

manipulation data using VR teleoperation systems. Pilots operate with minimal supervision,

consistently meet data throughput and quality standards, and can troubleshoot routine issues

(such as basic software workflow and lab operating issues). They also support researchers with

executing evaluation protocols and providing clear feedback on robot and model behavior.

 

Primary Duties

● Collect high-quality robot training data by teleoperating robotic systems using VR

equipment and hand controllers; demonstrate manipulation tasks repeatedly and

consistently.

● Meet daily performance expectations for data collection throughput, quality, and

consistency (including correct task setup and complete metadata/notes).

● Follow task specifications and SOPs precisely, maintain discipline around experiment

changes and “what changed” between sessions.

● Maintain a safe work environment and adhere to lab safety procedures at all times.

● Support evaluations by running structured evaluation protocols alongside researchers

and accurately reporting results and issues.

 

Additional Tasks:

● Troubleshoot and report issues with robot hardware/software and teleop tooling, capture

relevant logs/notes and escalate with clear reproduction steps.

● Perform basic operational maintenance per SOP (workspace reset between sessions,

calibration checks, battery swaps or component swaps as required).

● Review/annotate recordings as needed (lightweight review for quality checks, labeling

support, or spot audits).

● Participate in process improvements to increase data collection efficiency, reduce

downtime, and improve data quality.

● Occasional travel to customer/partner sites (domestic & international) to support on-site

robot data collection, including operating in new environments, coordinating with site

contacts, and following site-specific safety and security requirements.

● Occasional weekend overtime data collection (maximum one day per weekend),

balanced with flexible scheduling and time off during the week.

Required Qualifications:

● Strong VR / controller proficiency (VR gaming or similar real-time control experience).

● Ability to maintain focus while operating in VR for extended periods and follow detailed

written/video instructions.

● Comfort working hands-on with robotics equipment in a lab environment; safety-minded

and detail-oriented.

● Comfortable with Linux / command line (running programs with arguments, checking

logs).

● Ability to debug routine issues and distinguish between environment/setup vs software

vs hardware problems.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

  • Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

  • Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

  • Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.






Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

jobs.description:
Leder søges til Liden Stina Naturbørnehave

Vil du stå i spidsen for en lille, Steiner-inspireret naturbørnehave og vuggestue på

Nordbornholm, hvor nærvær, natur og gode relationer er omdrejningspunktet?

Liden Stina søger en pædagogisk uddannet leder til 30-32 timer med tiltrædelse 1.

november eller snarest derefter.

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge hverdagen og udviklingen i et lille, engageret

fællesskab med 20 børn i alderen 0-6 år og fem fastansatte medarbejdere.

Om stillingen

Som leder får du det overordnede ansvar for den daglige drift og den pædagogiske

udvikling i Liden Stina. Du skal sammen med medarbejdere og forældre sikre en tryg,

meningsfuld og velfungerende hverdag for børnene.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

 Varetage den daglige pædagogiske, personalemæssige og administrative ledelse.

 Skabe tydelige rammer, struktur og rytme i hverdagen.

 Understøtte medarbejdernes faglige udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

 Være nærværende og deltage i det daglige pædagogiske arbejde.

 Sikre gode og tillidsfulde relationer til børn, familier, medarbejdere og

forældregruppe.

 Planlægge og følge op på møder, vagtplaner, dokumentation og øvrige

driftsopgaver.

 Bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af Liden Stina med respekt for stedets værdier og

pædagogiske grundlag. Liden Stina fylder 20 år i år.

 Samarbejde konstruktivt med relevante myndigheder og eksterne

samarbejdspartnere.

Om dig

Vi søger en leder, der er fagligt velfunderet, tydelig og omsorgsfuld. Du trives med både

ledelsesopgaver og nærvær i børnenes hverdag.

Vi forventer, at du:

 Er uddannet pædagog.

 Har ledelseserfaring eller lyst og kompetencer til at påtage dig et ledelsesansvar.

 Er initiativrig, lyttende, anerkendende og empatisk.

 Kan skabe overblik, træffe beslutninger og følge op på aftaler.

 Har forståelse for betydningen af en genkendelig struktur og en rolig rytme.

 Prioriterer gode relationer til det enkelte barn og dets familie.

 Kan inspirere medarbejderne og skabe et åbent, tillidsfuldt samarbejde.

 Har interesse for naturpædagogik og gerne kendskab til Steinerpædagogik.

 Kan udvikle pædagogisk relevante aktiviteter med afsæt i naturen, årstiderne og

egne interesser.

Om Liden Stina

Liden Stina ligger ved Olsker på Nordbornholm, omgivet af klipper, skov, marker og å.

Naturen er en levende og naturlig del af børnenes hverdag.

Vi lægger vægt på at skabe en meningsfuld barndom præget af nærvær, ro, efterligning,

gode oplevelser og magi. Vores pædagogiske arbejde er inspireret af

Steinerpædagogikken og dens syn på barnet, naturen, rytmen og årstidernes betydning.

Liden Stina har en engageret forældregruppe, som bidrager aktivt til stedets muligheder og

udvikling. Vi arbejder løsningsorienteret og ønsker i fællesskab at skabe de bedste

rammer for børnene.

Vi tilbyder

 En stilling i en lille naturbørnehave og vuggestue med et tydeligt værdigrundlag.

 En arbejdsplads med kort afstand mellem idé og handling.

 Et tæt samarbejde med engagerede medarbejdere og forældre.

 Mulighed for at sætte retning og præge institutionens fortsatte udvikling.

 En hverdag tæt på børnene og den bornholmske natur.

 Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og principperne for lokal

løndannelse.

Praktiske oplysninger

Liden Stina har åbent mandag-fredag kl. 7.30-16.00. Weekendarbejde kan forekomme i

forbindelse med arrangementer og aktiviteter.

Der indhentes børneattest og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to deepen our ML research capabilities in clinical oncology. This is a senior, research-oriented role for someone who wants to develop novel approaches to medical image analysis, treatment outcome prediction, and multi-modal clinical data integration - and see those methods reach real clinical settings.

You’ll work at the intersection of ML research and clinical application, collaborating closely with physicians, medical physicists, and experienced engineers with deep domain expertise. Together, you’ll develop methods that are scientifically rigorous and clinically meaningful. Your work will directly shape our product capabilities and contribute to peer-reviewed science.

What You’ll Do

Research & Method Development

  • Develop novel ML/DL methods for medical image analysis, including segmentation, lesion detection, longitudinal tracking, treatment response prediction, and outcome modeling

  • Design and conduct experiments to evaluate new approaches against clinical baselines and state-of-the-art methods

  • Stay current with the literature and propose research directions that advance Nucs AI’s product and scientific goals

  • Publish findings in top-tier venues (MICCAI, RSNA, JNM, Medical Image Analysis) and represent Nucs AI at scientific conferences

Clinical Translation

  • Collaborate with clinicians and medical physicists to ensure methods are grounded in clinical reality

  • Produce validated research outputs with documented performance benchmarks and clear handoff specifications for production engineering

  • Contribute to clinical validation studies and evidence generation for regulatory submissions

External Engagement

  • Collaborate with external academic research partners on joint studies

  • Support scientific diligence with pharma and clinical partners

  • Contribute to Nucs AI's scientific credibility in the field


What You Bring

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, medical image analysis, biomedical engineering, or related field

  • Strong publication record in relevant venues (medical imaging, clinical ML, computer vision)

  • Experience structuring and executing research collaborations with academic and clinical institutions

  • Deep expertise in deep learning architectures for image analysis (CNNs, transformers, U-Nets, etc.)

  • Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)

  • Experience working with medical imaging data (PET/CT, MRI, or similar modalities)

  • Strong statistical foundations - experimental design, hypothesis testing, survival analysis, and clinical biostatistics

Bonus Points

  • Experience with nuclear medicine imaging & dosimetry (PSMA-PET, FDG-PET, SPECT)

  • Expertise in treatment outcome prediction, survival analysis, or longitudinal modeling

  • Experience with multi-modal data integration (imaging + clinical + genomic)

  • Familiarity with clinical trial design and regulatory evidence requirements

  • Prior industry experience translating research into deployed products

  • Experience with graph neural networks, molecular representations, or drug-response modeling

  • Experience with Generative AI in medical domain

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact  – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity  – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility  – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside  – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:

· Electrical installations (low-current and high-voltage installations)

· Automation installations

· Testing and troubleshooting of electrical and control systems in prototype equipment

We hope you have:

· Suitable vocational education as an electrical/automation technician

· Experience in electrical and automation installations for mobile machinery and/or electric vehicles

· Fluent collaboration skills

· Knowledge of automation and field bus technology

· Good IT skills

· Language skills: English; Finnish language skills are considered an advantage

What we offer you:

· Comprehensive employee benefits

· Excellent opportunities to develop your expertise

jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Germany
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

As Loft’s first Business Development Director to be based in Germany, you will play a pivotal role in our European growth strategy. You will be responsible for driving customer acquisition and strategic partnerships across the German ecosystem—including government agencies (such as the BND & DLR), defense primes, and commercial space players.
This is a high-impact role for a business development leader who combines a deep understanding of the German space and defense landscape with a passion for shaping new space infrastructure models.

About this Role:
  • Build and grow a pipeline of customers across the German government (civil and defense) and commercial sectors.
  • Cultivate long-term relationships with key stakeholders such as DLR, BAAINBw, Bundeswehr, primes (e.g., Airbus, OHB, HENSOLDT), and commercial tech startups.
  • Identify and negotiate strategic partnerships that accelerate Loft’s ability to deliver space infrastructure-as-a-service
  • Shape Go-to-Market Strategy, collaborating with our EMEA Business Development team to localize Loft’s positioning for the German market.
  • Influence Loft’s product roadmap. Work closely with technical and product teams to ensure customer requirements inform Loft’s platform development.
  • Attend and speak at German and European space industry events and support Loft’s brand presence in-country.

    • Must Haves:
  • 7+ years of sales, business development, or strategic partnerships experience across the commercial space, aerospace, or defense sectors.
  • Demonstrated success in capturing new business across the German space and defense landscape, including customer procurement cycles and key players.
  • Experience selling complex technical solutions (ideally in space, aerospace, or defense applications).
  • Understanding of the operating practices of European Space Agency (ESA) and the European Commission (EC)
  • Experience leading and/or contributing to RFP responses
  • Effective professional communication skills; Fluency in German and English is required (both spoken and written)
  • Passion for the space industry and a desire to be part of a fast-paced, mission-driven team.

    • Nice to haves:
  • Fluency in French, and/or additional European languages
  • Experience winning proposals for spacecraft development programs

    • Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.title: Assistant Workplace lead
jobs.description:
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions is a leading global provider of integrated facilities and corporate real estate management. We are recruiting for an Assistant Workplace Lead to join our team in Stockholm. This is a great opportunity for an experienced and enthusiastic candidate to join a global account team.

As Assistant Workplace Lead you will deputize to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing strategic support and operational leadership across campus. This role drives operational excellence, leads improvement projects, and supports governance and reporting activities to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

Acting as a trusted partner to the Workplace Operations Lead, this role ensures continuity of leadership, drives operational initiatives, and maintains strong relationships with stakeholders and service partners. The Assistant Lead plays a critical role in translating strategic vision into operational execution, supporting the team to deliver consistent, efficient, and customer-focused facilities services across all sites within the geographical scope.

What You'll Do:

Client relationship and stakeholder engagement


    Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across campus and act a senior point of contact

    Represent CBRE interests and teams while aligning with the client's needs and expectations

    Support in client engagement activities and service review meetings with senior stakeholders

    Communicate operational updates, changes, and improvements to stakeholders in both English and Swedish

    Foster collaborative relationships with service providers and suppliers


Finance, governance and reporting


    Be well-versed in CBRE's contractual commitments, including financial, commercial and performance models and ensure operational compliance with contractual obligations

    Collate, prepare and analyse performance and governance reports to enable client sign off

    Collaborate with Workplace operations- lead, managers and Finance teams to prepare accurate forecasts, financial performance reviews and budget drafts

    Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help the team and client to better understand the operational output

    Prepare analysis and presentations on operational performance, key performance indicators, customer satisfaction and trends and make recommendations for improvements and service adjustments


Leadership and team support


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in team leadership and management

    Provide guidance, coaching, and support to Workplace Operations Managers

    Foster a culture focused on service excellence, proactiveness and continuous improvement

    Support performance management activities, succession planning and team development initiatives

    Drive the one team and service first mindset across campus alongside the client

    Review and sign off on annual leave and other resource planning activities


Operational leadership and site management


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in overseeing facilities operations and service delivery

    Good understanding of CBRE's contractual commitments, including statement of work, matrix of responsibility and service level agreements in order to translate these into effective deliverables for the teams in collaboration with the Workplace operations lead

    Act as deputy to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing leadership continuity in their absence

    Monitor service delivery performance and identify areas requiring attention or improvement and coordinate with Workplace operations managers to resolve challenges and implement improvements

    Working closely with QHSE- and operational teams to ensure sites are fully compliant with the client's and CBRE's QHSE standards

    Ensure health and safety policies and observations are logged to minimize risk exposure and enable a safe workplace environment

    Review and sign off all campus applicable risk assessments together with the Workplace Operations Manager


Improvement projects and strategic initiatives


    Lead and manage improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and service quality

    Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions

    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across campus operations

    Be an active participant in our vendor care program, working closely with strategically important service partners across the contract

    Support implementation of transformational change programs, including the Evolve program

    Analyse operational data and trends to inform strategic decision-making

    Program manage key projects, acting as a conduit between the client and CBRE's operational and project teams


Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista, Stockholm. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

jobs.title: Vastaanottovirkailija talvikaudeksi Saariselälle
jobs.description:
Etsimme **vastaanottovirkailijaa Saariselälle talvikaudeksi 2026–2027**.

Tässä työssä olet yksi ensimmäisistä ihmisistä, jonka vieras kohtaa saapuessaan ja usein myös se henkilö, jonka puoleen käännytään loman aikana mitä erilaisimmissa tilanteissa.

Työpäivät eivät koostu pelkästään sisään- ja uloskirjautumisista. Ne sisältävät asiakkaiden neuvontaa, varausten käsittelyä, käytännön asioiden ratkaisemista ja yhteistyötä hotellin muiden työntekijöiden kanssa. Työympäristö on kansainvälinen ja talvisesongin aikana päivät voivat olla hyvinkin vauhdikkaita.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta **hotellin vastaanotosta tai muista vastaavista asiakaspalvelutehtävistä**.

Tärkeää on, että pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja pitämään useamman asian hallinnassa samanaikaisesti. Asiakkaiden kanssa toimit luontevasti ja ammattimaisesti myös silloin, kun eteen tulee yllättäviä tilanteita.

Toivomme sinulta lisäksi:

- hyvää asiakaspalveluasennetta

- oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta

- kykyä ratkaista tilanteita itsenäisesti

- hyviä yhteistyötaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- valmiutta työskennellä kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa

- joustavuutta sesonkityöhön.


**Ajokortti ja oma auto ovat eduksi.**

Mitä työ tarjoaa?

Pääset viettämään kokonaisen talvikauden Saariselällä ja työskentelemään pienemmässä hotellimiljöössä, jossa asiakaspalvelu on henkilökohtaista ja työntekijän oma ote näkyy asiakkaan kokemuksessa.

Työsuhde sijoittuu **talvikaudelle 2026–2027**, marraskuusta maaliskuun loppuun.

**Majoitus voidaan järjestää työn ajaksi**, joten Saariselällä ei tarvitse asua valmiiksi.

Jos haluat viettää talven Lapissa, viihdyt kansainvälisessä ympäristössä ja hotellin vastaanottotyö on sinulle tuttua, lähetä meille hakemuksesi ja CV:si:

**rekrytointi@duunaamo.fi**

jobs.title: Key Account Manager, Powerbox
jobs.description:
About Powerbox

PRBX is a leading manufacturer of high-performance power conversion products. We deliver innovative and reliable custom solutions across diverse industries, from medical technology and railway applications to defense and industrial automation. With a commitment to constant development and a focus on building strong client partnerships, Powerbox offers a dynamic and rewarding work environment.

Job description

We are searching for a highly motivated and driven Key Account Manager to join our team in Stockholm. You will be responsible for developing and managing long term business relationships with our key clients in the Nordics, focusing on power conversion systems and custom solutions.

Responsibility and tasks

    Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients in the assigned territory.

    Identify and pursue sales opportunities, driving revenue growth.

    Lead the entire sales process, from prospecting to closing deals.

    Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.

    Provide technical guidance and tailor solutions to meet client requirements.

    Conduct negotiations and finalize contracts with clients.

    Manage customer forecast, prepare sales reports and territory updates.

    Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to inform sales strategies.

Qualifications

You have:

    Proven experience as a high-performing Key Account Manager or similar sales role, preferably within the power electronics industry.

    A deep understanding of power conversion and its applications.

    Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients at all levels.

    Experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (ideally 6 months or longer).

    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

    Self-motivated and capable of working independently, yet also a collaborative team player.

    Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

    Proficiency in CRM software a plus.

    Willingness to travel within the Nordics for client meetings and industry events.

Personality

To be successful in the role we believe you:

    A highly motivated and results-driven individual with a strong work ethic.

    You possess excellent communication skills and can effectively convey technical information to clients.

    Are a strategic thinker with the ability to identify opportunities and develop innovative solutions.

    Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, adapting quickly to changing circumstances.

    You are resilient and persistent, able to navigate and persevere through long and complex sales cycles.

    Are customer-focused, dedicated to providing exceptional service and building long-term relationships.

What we offer

At Powerbox, we offer a stimulating environment where you'll embark on a journey of professional growth and development. As a Key Account Manager, you'll lead sales efforts in the Swedish market, engage in challenging projects that drive our company's success. We provide competitive compensation packages, including salary, benefits, and incentives, to attract and retain top talent in the industry. With a strong emphasis on work-life balance, we offer flexible arrangements to ensure your well-being both inside and outside of work. Our culture is rooted in excellence, empowering you to excel in your role and contribute to our continuous growth and success. Take this chance to be part of a team dedicated to innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We look forward to hearing from you!

Application process

Addilon is our partner in this recruitment. Please apply (CV and personal letter in English) via the link. We will fill the position immediately after finding the right candidate. Questions about the position are answered on weekdays between 09.00 am -10.00 am, +46 10 207 43 20.

jobs.title: Vil du bidra til at fleire får moglegheit til å delta i arbeidslivet?
jobs.description:
Vi søkjer to engasjerte og løysingsorientert seniorrådgivarar som vil bli med på å styrke arbeidsinkluderinga i Bergensregionen.

Hos oss får du ei sentral rolle i vidareutviklinga av Nav sine tenester retta mot arbeidsgivarar. Gjennom aktiv kontakt med verksemder skal du bygge sterke relasjonar i næringslivet, løyse rekrutteringsoppdrag og bidra til at fleire arbeidssøkarar kjem i jobb. Du vil fungere som eit bindeledd mellom Nav og arbeidslivet og vere ein viktig samarbeidspartnar for både arbeidsgivarar og kollegaer i Nav-kontora i regionen.

I rolla vil du òg representere Nav på ulike møteplassar og arrangement, dele arbeidsmarknadskompetanse internt og bidra til å styrke Nav si rolle som ein synleg og attraktiv samarbeidspartnar for arbeidsgivarar.

I avdeling for arbeidsinkludering og kvalifisering blir du ein del av eit lag med 15 engasjerte og dedikerte fagpersonar. Saman arbeider vi kvar dag for å gi jobbsøkarar nye moglegheiter i arbeidslivet gjennom inkludering, kvalifisering og samarbeid med arbeidsgivarar i tråd med behova i arbeidsmarknaden.

Hos oss får du arbeide både sjølvstendig og i team, med stor fridom til å forme din eigen arbeidskvardag. Framfor alt får du høve til å gjere ein reell forskjell – for enkeltmenneske, arbeidsgivarar og samfunnet.


Kva går jobben ut på?
  • Etablere og styrke relasjonar til arbeidsgivarar og bidra til gode og likeverdige tenester i regionen
  • Skape og utvikle samarbeid med arbeidsgivarar for å fremme inkludering av arbeidssøkarar frå Nav sine prioriterte målgrupper
  • Bistå arbeidsgivarar med å løyse rekrutteringsoppdrag ved å kople aktuelle kandidatar til ledige stillingar
  • Representere Nav i eksterne forum, i møte med næringslivet og mot andre samarbeidspartnarar
  • Planlegge og delta på møteplassar for arbeidsgivarar og arbeidssøkarar, som til dømes rekrutteringstreff og jobbmesser
  • Vere ein ressursperson og bidra til auka arbeidsmarknadskompetanse internt i Nav-kontora
  • Vere pådrivar for å utvikle og styrke arbeidsgivarsamarbeidet saman med Nav-kontora i regionen, kommunen, fylkeskommunen og andre samarbeidspartnarar
  • Samarbeide tett og tverrfagleg med kollegaer i avdelinga for å skape moglegheiter for Nav sine prioriterte målgrupper.

Nav er i stadig utvikling, så variasjon og endringar i arbeidsoppgåvene må påreknast.

Kva kompetanse er viktig i denne rolla?

Du må ha

  • Fullført utdanning på minimum bachelornivå, gjerne innan fagområde som marknadsføring, HR, økonomi og administrasjon eller samfunnsfag. Relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Service Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Wir von der mecom sorgen dafür, dass Menschen in Deutschland im Notfall zu jeder Zeit Warnmeldungen erhalten. Auch im Nachrichtengeschäft gewährleisten wir, dass Fernsehen, Radio und Medienhäuser in Real-Time Texte, Bilder, O-Töne und Videos bekommen.

Unsere in Deutschland einzigartige technische Infrastruktur ermöglicht es, Informationen sekundenschnell und manipulationssicher an die richtigen Empfänger zu versenden. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Sicherheitsbehörden, Bundeseinrichtungen, Nachrichtenagenturen, Medienhäuser und weitere Unternehmen. Wir sind ein Hidden Champion, der mit einem familiären Team jeden Tag Großes bewegt. Anspruchsvolle und sinnstiftende Projekte sowie der Einsatz neuester Technologien gehören für uns zum Alltag.

Ab dem 01. Oktober 2026 suchen wir Verstärkung in Vollzeit (38h/Woche) für unser Team in Hamburg durch einen Senior Technical Service Manager (m/w/d).


Der Job + Die Verantwortung

  • Du übernimmst das Eskalations- und Incident-Management und stellst eine strukturierte Bearbeitung technischer Störungen sicher.
  • Du berätst fachlich und technisch, analysierst komplexe Sachverhalte und entwickelst passende Lösungen.
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit über mehrere Bereiche hinweg und sorgst für eine klare, verlässliche Kommunikation.
  • Du verantwortest das Kunden- und Lösungsmanagement und begleitest Anliegen bis zu ihrer nachhaltigen Klärung.
  • Du stellst die fachliche Qualität sowie eine zuverlässige Unterstützung im Service sicher.
  • Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Services mit.
  • Du priorisierst technische Eskalationen eigenständig und triffst innerhalb deiner Verantwortungsbereiche fundierte Entscheidungen.
  • Du berufst bei Bedarf bereichsübergreifende Incident-Meetings ein und moderierst die weitere Abstimmung.
  • Du leitest innerhalb definierter Supportprozesse technische Sofortmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du empfiehlst geeignete Changes, um die Stabilität und Qualität des Betriebs nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Du überprüfst die Servicequalität und achtest auf die Einhaltung etablierter Serviceprozesse.


Du + Deine Stärken

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT-Service, IT-Betrieb oder in einem kundenorientierten IT-Umfeld.
  • Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für komplexe IT-Systeme mit.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend und verfügst über ausgeprägte Moderationskompetenz.
  • Du kannst technische Sachverhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht vermitteln.
  • Du denkst analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung aus.
  • Du bist bereit, Kunden und Projekte vor Ort zu betreuen und dafür zu reisen.


Wir + Unsere Kultur

  • Unser Antrieb: Professionalität. Jeden Tag bewegen wir verantwortungsvoll große Themen für bekannte Auftraggeber. Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungswege machen uns wendig und schlagkräftig.
  • Wir haben die Zukunft im Blick – auch deine. Mobiles Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein moderner Arbeitsplatz unweit der Alster gehören dazu.
  • Gemeinsam sind wir stark. Mit unserer vertrauensvollen Crew arbeiten wir agil und in selbstorganisierten Teams. Intensive Einarbeitung, zahlreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Firmenevents inklusive.
  • Unser Heimathafen ist Hamburg. In fünf Minuten erreichst du zu Fuß vom Büro die Außenalster. Bus, U-Bahn und S-Bahn liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe. Und für dein leibliches Wohl sorgt unsere hauseigene Kantine.


Klingt gut?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung – einfach und schnell über unser Onlineformular.
Deine HR-Ansprechperson ist Deliah Bargmann.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung

At Impower GmbH, we are shaping the future of property management — simple, fast, and digital. More than 100,000 people manage over 12 million apartments using processes that are still largely manual, complex, and time-consuming. We are changing that with modern technology, clear workflows, and real practical value.


Our Cloud ERP brings complex processes such as accounting, banking, and property management into one intuitive platform. As our product continues to grow, great design plays a key role in turning this complexity into simple and efficient user experiences.


As a Senior Product Designer, you take ownership of key areas of our core product and shape experiences that property managers rely on every day. Working closely with our Head of Design, Product Owners, and Engineers, you turn complex workflows into intuitive solutions and drive design topics hands-on from the initial problem to the shipped feature.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Own and drive product design across key areas of our core platform, from problem discovery to final implementation
  • Translate complex, data-heavy workflows into simple, intuitive, and scalable user experiences
  • Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-quality UI designs that clearly communicate your solutions
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to turn concepts into technically feasible, shippable features
  • Contribute to and continuously improve our design system, including reusable components, patterns, and documentation
  • Use customer insights, product context, and feedback to challenge assumptions and continuously improve existing experiences
  • Support other designers by sharing expertise, providing feedback, and helping strengthen design quality across the team


Dein Profil

  • You bring 7–9 years of hands-on Product Design experience, ideally with SaaS products
  • You have experience designing complex, data-heavy products such as ERP systems, business software, or comparable applications
  • You combine strong UX thinking with excellent UI skills and experience working with scalable design systems
  • You are highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using modern AI and prototyping tools to accelerate your design process
  • You understand front-end development constraints and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers to bring designs into production
  • You take ownership of complex problems and confidently drive them from initial exploration through to a high-quality solution
  • You communicate confidently in both German and English and enjoy working in an international, cross-functional environment


Warum wir?

  • Meaningful impact: Shape a core product that helps thousands of people simplify complex property management processes every day
  • Real ownership: Take responsibility for important product areas and influence how our platform evolves
  • Close collaboration: Work directly with our Head of Design, Product, and Engineering in a highly cross-functional environment
  • Growth opportunities: Develop your expertise while helping shape our design practices and product experience as we scale
  • Modern environment: Work with state-of-the-art tools and choose the hardware that works best for you (Mac or Windows)
  • Hybrid working: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while collaborating regularly with the team in our central Munich office

jobs.title: Barnansvarig socionom till Hemstaden
jobs.description:
Vill du göra verklig skillnad för barn och familjer med skyddsbehov?

På Hemstaden möter vi barn, vuxna och familjer i några av livets mest utsatta situationer. Nu söker vi en engagerad barnansvarig socionom som vill vara med och skapa trygghet, hopp och framtidstro för barn som lever med skyddsbehov.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där kvalitet, professionalism och barnets bästa genomsyrar arbetet.

Tjänsten som barnansvarig socionom är en ny roll hos oss. Det innebär att du får stora möjligheter att tillsammans med verksamhetschef och kollegor vara med och utveckla rollens innehåll, arbetssätt och struktur. Vi söker därför dig som trivs med att ta initiativ, skapa struktur och bidra till utveckling.

Som barnansvarig har du ett särskilt ansvar för att säkerställa att barnens rättigheter, behov och delaktighet uppmärksammas under hela placeringen. Du arbetar nära barnen, deras vårdnadshavare, placerande socialtjänst och övriga aktörer runt familjen.

Rollen är samtidigt bred och varierad. Antalet placerade barn förändras över tid och tjänsten innebär därför inte enbart barnsamtal och barninriktade insatser. Du kommer även att delta i verksamhetens övriga arbete och vid behov ha kontaktmannaskap för placerade vuxna och familjer. Du behöver därför vilja arbeta med såväl barnets individuella behov som den vuxnas och familjens samlade stödbehov.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

    Vara verksamhetens barnansvariga och bidra till att barnperspektivet genomsyrar hela verksamheten.
    Genomföra individuella stöd- och barnsamtal.
    Planera, genomföra och följa upp insatser och aktiviteter utifrån barnens individuella behov.
    Uppmärksamma barnets behov av trygghet, stöd, skydd och delaktighet under placeringen.
    Stödja vårdnadshavare i frågor som rör barnets behov, trygghet och utveckling.
    Fungera som kontaktperson för placerade vuxna och familjer.
    Planera, genomföra och följa upp individuella stödinsatser tillsammans med placerade personer.
    Upprätta och följa upp genomförandeplaner samt ansvara för löpande social dokumentation.
    Ha regelbunden kontakt och samverkan med placerande socialtjänst.
    Samverka med skola, förskola, BUP, hälso- och sjukvård, polis och andra relevanta samhällsaktörer.
    Bidra till risk- och säkerhetsarbete utifrån såväl barnets som den vuxnas och familjens situation.
    Vara ett stöd för kollegor i frågor som rör barn, barns rättigheter och barnperspektivet.
    Delta i övriga arbetsuppgifter som förekommer i den dagliga verksamheten.
    Bidra till verksamhetens kvalitets- och utvecklingsarbete.

Arbetsuppgifterna anpassas efter verksamhetens och de placerades aktuella behov. För att trivas i rollen behöver du uppskatta variationen mellan barninriktat arbete, kontaktmannaskap, praktiskt och psykosocialt stöd, dokumentation och samverkan.

Vi söker dig som

    Har socionomexamen.
    Har erfarenhet av socialt arbete med barn, ungdomar eller familjer.
    Har kunskap om BBIC och kan omsätta ett tydligt barnperspektiv i praktiskt socialt arbete.
    Har mycket god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med både barn och vuxna.
    Kan möta människor med olika kulturella referensramar på ett respektfullt, lyhört och professionellt sätt.
    Är trygg, självständig, flexibel och ansvarstagande.
    Trivs i en ny roll där du får bidra till att utveckla rutiner, arbetssätt och struktur.
    Har god förmåga att dokumentera och uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.
    Kan kommunicera på engelska.
    Har B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av

    Skyddat boende.
    Våld i nära relation.
    Hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck.
    Socialtjänstens myndighetsutövning.
    Familjebehandling.
    HVB eller stödboende.
    Kris- och traumaarbete.
    Barn- och ungdomspsykiatri.
    NPF och psykisk ohälsa hos barn.
    Risk- och säkerhetsarbete.
    Samverkan med polis, socialtjänst och andra samhällsaktörer.

Språkkunskaper utöver svenska och engelska är meriterande. Eftersom vi möter barn och familjer med många olika bakgrunder värdesätter vi också god interkulturell förståelse och förmåga att anpassa kommunikationen efter människors olika erfarenheter och förutsättningar.

Meriterande metodkompetens

Vi ser gärna att du har utbildning eller dokumenterad erfarenhet inom en eller flera av följande metoder och arbetssätt:

    Trappan
    TMO – Traumamedveten omsorg
    Project Support
    BRA – Barns Rätt som Anhöriga
    FREDA
    PATRIARK
    SARA
    MI – Motiverande samtal

Vi erbjuder

Hos Hemstaden får du mer än ett arbete – du blir en del av en verksamhet där du varje dag kan göra konkret skillnad för människor som behöver det som mest.

Vi erbjuder bland annat:

    Ett meningsfullt arbete med stor samhällsnytta.
    En ny roll med stora möjligheter att påverka dess innehåll och utveckling.
    En kvalitetsdriven organisation med korta beslutsvägar.
    Kompetensutveckling och kontinuerlig handledning.
    Engagerade kollegor med hög kompetens.
    Kollektivavtal och goda anställningsvillkor.
    Friskvårdsbidrag.
    Flexibilitet och stort eget ansvar.

Om Hemstaden

Hemstaden är ett IVO-tillståndspliktigt skyddat boende som erbjuder trygga och individanpassade insatser för vuxna, barn och familjer med skyddsbehov. Vårt arbete bygger på hög kvalitet, kunskapsbaserade arbetssätt och ett starkt barnperspektiv.

Vi arbetar bland annat med Trappan, Project Support, TMO och BRA. Vår ambition är att varje barn ska få möjlighet att känna trygghet, bli lyssnat på och vara delaktigt i frågor som berör barnet.

Hemstaden är medlem i Vårdföretagarna och har kollektivavtal, vilket innebär tydliga och trygga villkor för våra medarbetare.

Hos oss har du stor möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens utveckling. Vi tror på tillit, korta beslutsvägar och att medarbetarnas kunskap och idéer är en viktig del i att skapa ett skyddat boende av högsta kvalitet.

jobs.title: Baarimestari / Bartender SkyView Igloo Resort Winterseason 2026-2027 - Rovaniemi
jobs.description:
Career syntyi tarpeesta tuoda markkinoille parempaa työnvälitystä. Olemme lappilaislähtöinen pehmeiden arvojen henkilöstötalo. Me teemme työtä täydellä sydämellä, kunnioittaen arvojamme: välittäminen, kiltteys, rohkeus, ilo, vastuullisuus ja oppiminen. Meille ihmisten kohtaaminen ihmisinä on työmme ydin. Etsimme yhdessä sinulle työn, jota on ilo tehdä!

Arctic Career etsii asiakkaalleen baarimestaria uuteen avautuvaan ravintolaan Ollerovaaraan, SkyView Igloo Resortin yhteyteen.

Tämä ei ole mikä tahansa työpaikka – vaan mahdollisuus olla mukana rakentamassa upeaa kokonaisuutta alusta asti.

Tuleva tiimi rakentaa yhdessä huippukokki Tomi Björckin kanssa kokonaisuuden, joka pohjautuu pohjoisen puhtaisiin raaka-aineisiin sekä harkittuun ja vaikuttavaan elämykseen.

Me uskomme, että laatu ei synny itsestään – se tehdään.
Se tehdään palvelussa, tunnelmassa, juomissa ja jokaisessa kohtaamisessa.

Baarimestarina olet tärkeässä roolissa rakentamassa ravintolan juomakulttuuria ja kokonaisvaltaista asiakaskokemusta. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vahvaa ammattitaitoa, silmää laadulle ja aitoa halua tarjota asiakkaille jotain tavallista enemmän.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta baarimestarin tehtävistä ja À la carte -ravintolaympäristöstä

- Vahvaa juomaosaamista sekä hyvää viini- ja cocktailtuntemusta

- Myynnillistä ja asiakaslähtöistä palveluasennetta

- Kykyä palvella kansainvälisiä asiakkaita sujuvasti englanniksi

- Silmää yksityiskohdille ja halua luoda elämyksellisiä asiakaskohtaamisia

- Oma-aloitteista, ammattimaista ja positiivista työotetta

- Halua olla mukana kehittämässä uuden ravintolan toimintaa ja juomakokonaisuutta

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Mahdollisuuden olla mukana avaamassa täysin uutta ravintolaa

- Mahdollisuuden päästä vaikuttamaan ja rakentamaan ravintolan juomakulttuuria

- Upeat Lapin maisemat ja inspiroivan työympäristön

- Työn osana laadukasta ja kunnianhimoista ravintolakonseptia

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan

- Apua käytännön asioissa, kuten asumisen järjestämisessä

- Arvokasta kokemusta ravintolasta, jossa laatu, elämyksellisyys ja hyvä tekemisen meininki ovat kaiken keskiössä

Tässä työssä sinä saat näkyä – persoona ja ammattitaito ovat osa elämystä.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026 ja kestävät arviolta maaliskuulle 2027 saakka.

jobs.title: Programming and game design club instructor
jobs.description:
**Brief:**

We are looking for game educators whose hearts beat for creativity, game design, and 21st-century skills! In this role, you will act as the mentor and guide for two of our awesome club themes: _My Own Game Studio_ and _Coding and Future Skills_. You will lead children and young people behind the scenes of the digital world, helping them develop logical thinking and breathe life into their own game ideas in a safe and engaging online environment.

**About us:**

School of Gaming (SOG) is a game-based education and digital youth work company that combines education and gaming in a fun and safe way. We provide children and young people with opportunities to develop 21st-century skills such as teamwork, problem-solving, and creativity. Our trained game educators guide kids in inspiring online clubs and courses with a strong social and educational impact.

**Description:**

Have you ever wondered what it feels like to be the one pulling the strings behind the scenes of a game studio? Now is your chance to become the boss of your own game studio and lead the talents of tomorrow from initial idea to final publication. And don't worry, we don't require you to move to Silicon Valley! You can stay right in your gaming chair in Finland or work at your local school. Or both!

Your mission is to guide and mentor groups of 10–15 young, creative gamers. In the _My Own Game Studio_ club, you aren't just coding. You are setting up a whole production team, including scriptwriters, graphic designers, sound designers, and producers. You will help kids identify their strengths and collaborate. In the _Coding and Future Skills_ club, you will step behind the digital curtain using the globally acclaimed Code.org platform.

Rather than spoon-feeding answers or mechanically grinding code syntax, you encourage them to try, fail, and figure things out on their own. Your role is to tickle their gray brain cells, spark their curiosity, and create challenges for them to solve.

**What We Are Looking For:**

- You know which way to hold a mouse and you understand the mechanics and culture of gaming worlds.

- You have a visual eye or a basic understanding of the different aspects of game design (coding, graphics, audio, or storytelling).

- We greatly appreciate it if you have former experience guiding small humanoids on Tellus (e.g., camp counselor, club instructor, or youth work).

- If gaming is your passion and you love stepping into stories and play, you are the Game Educator we want!


We provide plenty of materials, ready-made templates, and infinite support 24/7.

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattisille asiakkaille Hankoon
jobs.description:
**Avustaja sympaattisille asiakkaille**

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattisia asiakkaitamme Hangossa.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

jobs.title: Miljøterapeut i barnevernsinstutusjon
jobs.employer: HUMAN CARE UNG AS KONTOR HAUGESUND
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del av løsningen? Vi søker miljøterapeut i barnevern

Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. I Humana omsorg og assistanse jobber vi etter visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv, ja alle. Nå leter vi etter deg som vil være en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for våre ungdommer.

Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige. For å styrke laget vårt i region vest søker vi nå engasjerte kollegaer til en 100% fast stilling i medleverturnus og nattevakter i 59,15% stillinger. Du vil inngå i en turnusordning på enten 3-7 eller 4-7, der du bor på avdelingen i tre eller fire døgn og har syv døgn fri mellom hver arbeidsperiode. Avdelingene er godkjent for målgruppen akutt, omsorg og behandling. Vi søker etter folk til ny akuttavdeling, men også til eksisterende avdelinger.

En jobb preget av glede, engasjement og ansvar

Ingen dager er like hos oss. Som miljøterapeut spiller du en nøkkelrolle i det daglige miljøarbeidet og behandlingen av ungdommene våre. Du blir en relasjonsbygger som skaper et hjem preget av forutsigbarhet, trygghet, rammer og kjærlighet. I tillegg vil du delta aktivt i planlegging, evaluering og drøfting av tiltak, samt bidra med nødvendig dokumentasjon og rapportering for å sikre god drift.

Dette er en krevende jobb som ikke passer for alle. Vi ser etter deg som allerede har noen års erfaring fra barnevernsinstitusjon og som utstråler trygghet og ro. Du evner å se ungdommenes behov bak følelsesuttrykkene, og du vet at endringsarbeid krever tålmodighet. Hos oss får du bruke ditt faglige engasjement til å se muligheter der andre ser hindringer.

Hva skal til for å lykkes hos oss?

  • Du har treårig høyskoleutdanning innen helse- og sosialfag, fortrinnsvis som barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller vernepleier. Annen relevant bachelorgrad vil også bli vurdert.

  • Du har erfaring fra miljøterapeutisk arbeid i barnevernsinstitusjon, spesielt med ungdom som målgruppe og arbeid med utfordrende atferd.

  • Du har gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Du har gyldig førerkort klasse B.

  • Du har norsk pass eller gyldig arbeidstillatelse.

  • Du må kunne fremlegge godkjent politiattest i henhold til Barnevernloven § 12-11, jf. politiregisterloven § 39, første ledd (attesten skal ikke legges ved selve søknaden).

Bli en del av et sterkt lag

Når du begynner hos oss, blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø med fokus på kontinuerlig kompetanseheving gjennom hyppig opplæring og veiledning. Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige, og vi kombinerer menneskelig nærhet med høy kvalitet.

Vi tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med stedlig ledelse, gode muligheter for personlig utvikling og interne karrieremuligheter. Du får også konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser, gode medlevertillegg, samt solide pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Er du klar for å bli en del av løsningen sammen med oss? Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i våre verdier og ønsker å ta ansvar på et lag som bygger morgendagens omsorg, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

For mer informasjon om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med Institusjonsleder Trond Lien på telefon 992 25 524.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

jobs.title: Lagerarbetare / Orderplockare
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten

Just nu söker vi duktiga och erfarna lagerarbetare för en extra tjänst inom lager och orderplock. Du kommer att få en upplärning och därefter bli tilldelad ett schema varje vecka. Det kan även förekomma att du blir inringd dag för dag för att boka upp dig på lediga pass.

Arbetsuppgifterna består främst av orderplock med truck. Vid plock använder man sig av truck och skanner för att plocka och hantera produkterna enligt kundorder. Arbetet är fysiskt krävande och innebär en hel del gång, lyft och rörelse under arbetsdagen. Det är därför viktigt att du har god fysik och trivs med ett aktivt arbete.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och ser gärna att du är serviceinriktad, flexibel, noggrann och ansvarstagande. Du ska trivas med att arbeta i ett högt tempo och ha lätt för att samarbeta med andra.

För att passa i rollen som lagerarbetare har du tidigare erfarenhet inom lager och trivs med ett fysiskt arbete. Det är viktigt att du utan problem kan läsa och förstå instruktioner, därmed är goda kunskaper i svenska ett krav.

Vi kommer gå igenom alla ansökningar kontinuerligt och kontakta er därefter.

• Strukturerad och noggrann• Mycket god fysik• Glad och positiv samt har lätt att samarbeta med andra människor• Ansvarsfull och flexibel• Trivs med att arbeta i högt tempo• Arbetsvillig och inte rädd för att ta i när det behövs

Krav:

• Tidigare erfarenhet av lagerarbete• Truckkort (A1-4, B1-3)• Erfarenhet av truckkörning• B-körkort• Goda kunskaper i svenska

Fiks skall upplevas som en naturlig samarbetspartner i Sverige när behov av personal uppstår. Genom en nära relation mellan företag och personal arbetar vi tillsammans för att nå våra uppsatta mål. Vi vill skapa nöjda kunder och nöjd personal.

Vi rekryterar kompetent personal, utvecklar och bemannar kundens verksamhet. Vår snabbhet och kompetens är vår styrka och er möjlighet.

Fiks Group är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag i ALMEGA.

jobs.title: Director of Strategy, Communications and Impact
jobs.employer: THE ASSOCIATION FOR THE EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES TRANSPARENCY INITIATIVE (EITI)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Founded on the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) brings together governments, civil society and companies to improve natural resource governance. With over 50 member countries and 60 supporting companies, the EITI promotes transparency, accountability and informed policymaking in the extractive sector. 

Behind this ambitious and impactful organisation is a diverse and dynamic team of experts working together to advance the EITI mission. Based in Oslo, Norway, the EITI International Secretariat comprises a collaborative, multinational and multilingual team of around 50 professionals who value growth and development, strong relationships, open dialogue and inclusive leadership.

Who you are

As a senior leader, the Director of Strategy, Communications and Impact will play an important role in shaping the organisation’s strategic direction, strengthening collaboration across teams and supporting the culture of trust, accountability and high performance.  The role includes leading multiple workstreams and teams across the Secretariat.

This position brings together strategy development, strategic communications, monitoring, evaluation, learning and impact. Reporting to the Executive Director, the role will work closely with the Board Chair and Senior Management Team to strengthen EITI’s external influence and evidence-based impact narrative.

As a member of the Senior Management Team, the successful applicant will contribute to organisational decision-making, planning, delivery and finance.

The EITI International Secretariat’s values are Integrity, Professionalism and Respect for Diversity. The successful applicant will identify with and demonstrate behaviours consistent with these values. Personal suitability for the position, including alignment with the EITI values, will be a decisive factor in the selection process. 


Duties and responsibilities
  • Coordinate strategy development and provide strategic updates to the Board and Senior Management Team.
  • Embed strategic priorities in resourcing, work planning and impact measurement.
  • Coordinate updates to the Secretariat’s risk matrix and mitigating actions.
  • Provide strategic leadership for EITI communications channels and outputs.
  • Oversee implementation of the EITI communications strategy.
  • Lead development of high-level speeches, media engagement, crisis communications and statements.
  • Ensure quality assurance across blogs, news, newsletters and flagship publications.
  • Support effective communication of Board decisions by the Chair and Executive Director.
  • Oversee MEL, KPIs, results frameworks and evidence gathering to demonstrate impact.
  • Identify opportunities to increase visibility of EITI outcomes, through targeted communication materials.  
  • Contribute actively to Senior Management Team discussions on strategy, delivery, finance and organisational priorities.
  • Management and oversight of Communication and MEL work streams.
Qualifications
  • Senior leadership experience in complex international organisations.
  • Proven experience in strategy development, communications and MEL.
  • Ability to translate strategic priorities into organisational action and delivery.
  • Strong judgement in managing competing priorities, complexity and organisational risk.
  • Track record of leading communications in an international organisation.
  • Strong understanding of media networks and strategic use of social media.
  • Experience with engaging senior stakeholders across government, industry, civil society and development partners.
  • Ability to represent an organisation in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong people leadership skills, with a commitment to inclusion, accountability and collaboration.
  • First-hand knowledge and senior-level experience of working in low- and middle-income countries in the non-profit sector. 
  • Strong commitment to the pursuit of transparency, accountability, and good governance in the extractive sector globally. 
  • A first degree in a relevant social science subject or related discipline. A post-graduate qualification is desirable.
  • Fluency in English. Competence in one or more of the official languages of the EITI is desirable.
We can offer

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a multi-stakeholder organisation driving positive global change.

Located in central Oslo, the EITI International Secretariat offers hybrid work options, an attractive benefits and above-market pension and insurance package. See information about the benefits we offer here.

The Secretariat can offer employment in Norway based on the Norwegian salary structure. Indicative gross salary benchmarking suggests an annual range starting at 1,120,000 NOK. Placement within the senior leadership salary range will be determined in accordance with the organisation’s internal salary policy. The final offer will be determined based on factors including the labour market, role requirements, internal equity, budget, work location, and the successful candidate’s experience and skills.

Our preference is for this role to be based in Oslo, alongside other members of the Senior Management Team. Exceptional candidates may also be considered on a remote-working basis, provided that their location does not prevent them from fully engaging in the day-to-day work of the Secretariat and travelling to Oslo when required by organisational needs. Relocation support may be provided in accordance with the Secretariat’s internal relocation policy.

Email applications will not be processed.
