jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

Pomůže Vám, že nás lidi znají a doporučují. Každý rok rozesíláme 250.000 katalogů, fungujeme přes 30 let, zákazníky hýčkáme vlastní dopravou, výnosem kamkoli i montáží na místě v jimi určený čas. A festovním a hezkým nábytkem.
Očekáváme, že budete hlavně otevírat dveře a vytvářet příležitosti. A nebudete na to sami! Za sebou budete mít návrháře interiérů, přípraváře, zkušené znalce nábytku. Pomůžou Vám s technickým řešením a nabídkami. Rádi budete zvát lidi do pardubického showroomu, je fakt povedený a lidé sem rádi jezdí.
Budete mít svobodu koho oslovovat, kam a kdy jezdit a volat. My chceme výsledky, ne Vás komandovat :-)
Hledáme:
Nebojácnou pusu. Mail pošle někdo jiný.
Cestovatele. Budete jezdit za klienty po celém Česku. Je na Vás kdy.
Lidumila. S lidmi budujeme dlouhodobé vztahy. Žádná po nás potopa!
Rozvíječe. Dobrých nápadů, zpětné vazby, i zakázek.
Platíme penězi.. Slušný fix, krásné provize.
Za co jsou u nás lidi rádi:
Volí si cestu. My dáváme cíl. Mikromanagement se u nás nenosí.
Říkají, co si myslí. A ostatní jsou za to rádi.
Koučování. Kdo zná, ten ví. Kdo nezná, může využít.
Zlepšováky vítáme. Stejně jako rozvojové chyby. Narozdíl od těch diletantských.
Peníze. Výplata a vždy včas. I jakékoli době. Protože hypotéka, sunar ani dovolená nepočkají.
Pěkné čisté prostředí, moderní stroje. Retro nevedeme. Kromě Kofoly a Esíček
Dovolená podle sebe. Vy víte nejlépe, kdy chcete odpočívat, my do toho nemluvíme.    
První kontakt e-mailem.

jobs.title: Social Media Support Specialist (NYC, Weekend Shift, Sunday to Thursday)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

As a Social Media Support Specialist, you are at the forefront of helping developers create while managing our social media presence and community interactions. You'll assist developers with complex technical issues, billing inquiries, account management, and product usage questions across multiple channels including X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, Apple/Google Play stores, and other relevant platforms.

You will help bubble up what is important to Replit's engineering and Product teams, and what needs improvement to your own team, while also serving as a key voice in our social media community engagement.

We use tools like Zendesk, Sprout Social, Linear, Slack, Stripe, Orb, Notion, and Replit itself to get the job done, alongside social media management platforms for X, LinkedIn, and Reddit.

You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.

 



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets and social media accounts to solve account, billing, and product issues

 - Manage and respond to customer inquiries and community discussions on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, and Apple/Google Play stores, with the possibility of expanding coverage to additional platforms as we grow

 - Monitor social media channels for product feedback, technical issues, and community sentiment

 - Manage escalations from social media channels and coordinate with appropriate internal teams to ensure timely resolution

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit

 - Work cross-functionally with marketing and community teams to align messaging across channels



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of social media support experience, across platforms including on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, and Apple/Google Play stores

 - Experience with support platforms (Zendesk, Sprout Social), payment systems (Stripe, Orb), and ticketing workflows

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong written communication skills for public-facing social media interactions

 - Comfort operating with autonomy and ambiguity

 - Ability to maintain brand voice and tone all channels

 - Strong understanding of each social platform’s distinct audience and etiquette

 - Understanding of developer communities and technical terminology

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with community management or developer relations

 - Background in B2B SaaS customer success or support

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)

 - Experience with Replit

 


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Zendesk

 - Stripe

 - Slack

 - Orb

 - Linear

 - Sprout Social

 - Notion

 - Replit

 


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You prefer predetermined static processes

 - You need all information laid out

 - You struggle with demanding users

 - You are uncomfortable representing the companies voice publicly



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. The role has an in-office requirement of a hybrid schedule.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Onderhoudsmonteur
Dit kan al binnen twee minuten

Beschrijving
Vind jij het gaaf om te sleutelen aan techniek die de hele stad in beweging houdt? Werk jij graag aan betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid, en haal je voldoening uit zichtbaar resultaat? Dan is dit jouw volgende stap.
Als onderhoudsmonteur bij Techsharks zorg jij dat voertuigen en systemen bedrijfszeker blijven. Je doet gepland onderhoud, voert controles en revisiewerk uit en pakt technische afwijkingen aan voordat het echte storingen worden. Dankzij jou kunnen reizigers elke dag rekenen op vervoer dat blijft rijden.
Wil jij techniek combineren met maatschappelijke impact? Solliciteer en word een Shark. Hier ga jij harder van zwemmen
Als monteur ben je een essentiële schakel in het onderhoud en de optimalisatie van machines en installaties. Jij voorkomt storingen, verhelpt technische problemen en denkt mee over verbeteringen.
Wat jij gaat doen: - Uitvoeren van (preventief) onderhoud aan mechanische installaties zoals brekers, transportbanden, silo's, pompen, tandwielkasten en zeefinstallaties - Preventief onderhoud toepassen om storingen en uitval te minimaliseren. - Storingen lokaliseren (zowel elektrisch als mechanisch) en oplossen om een soepel productieproces te garanderen. - Bijdragen aan procesoptimalisatie en technische upgrades. - Monteren, demonteren en reviseren van machineonderdelen
We denken bij Techsharks trouwens in kansen, dus als jij niet 'voldoet', klim gerust in de digiale pen, we dagen je uit te solliciteren en ons te overtuigen.
Wil jij werken in een technisch uitdagende omgeving met zekerheid en groeikansen? Solliciteer vandaag nog! Hier herken jij jezelf in
Als Monteur bij Techsharks is het van belang dat je beschikt over een bepaald niveau: - Een diploma MBO-3/4 richting Werktuigbouwkunde, MTS, Elektrotechniek of Mechatronica. Heb je ruime en relevante werkervaring, dan kan dat...

jobs.title: Assistent Filiaalleider Kringloopwinkel - Leerdam
jobs.description:
Wij hebben de baan die jij zoekt!

Leuk werk, een fijn team en werk dat ertoe doet. Klinkt goed? Dan is de functie van assistent filiaalleider voor ons filiaal in Leerdam misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

In deze rol ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor je collegas en vorm je samen met de andere assistent filiaalleiders de verbindende schakel tussen het team en de filiaalleider. Organiseren en plannen gaan je van nature goed af. Of het nu gaat om de dagelijkse aansturing of om die comfortabele bank die precies op tijd bij de klant moet worden afgeleverd: jij houdt het overzicht en zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt.

Als assistent filiaalleider maak je écht verschil. Je draagt bij aan een duurzamere wereld én aan de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers uit diverse doelgroepen. Je weet mensen te motiveren en te begeleiden, zonder het organisatiebelang uit het oog te verliezen. Snel schakelen gaat je gemakkelijk af en je ziet kansen waar anderen obstakels zien. Daarbij is er volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, initiatief en aanpak.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gewoon jezelf. Enthousiast, geduldig en communicatief sterk.

Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Stuur dan snel jouw c.v. en motivatie. Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.description:
AI & Supply Chain Analytics Internship
Beschrijving Internship:
Translate data from ERP systems and supplier logistic escalation dashboard to predict parameter optimization, thereby creating an early warning system
Objective
The objective of this assignment is to develop a data-driven early warning system by translating and integrating data from ERP systems and supplier logistics escalation dashboards. This should be done by using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to identify key performance drivers, predict potential disruptions, and trigger early warnings. By applying predictive analytics and optimizing critical parameters, the assignment aims to proactively prevent logistics issues and improve overall supply chain performance and decision-making.
Currently, Frencken is performing a root cause analysis to identify recurring issues in supplier logistics and supply chain performance using ERP data and escalation dashboards (in a dedicated assignment). While this analysis provides insight into historical problems, it remains primarily reactive. This assignment builds on these findings by translating identified patterns and drivers into a proactive, data-driven approach, aiming to predict disruptions and trigger early warnings, possibly using AI for this.

Rijkswaterstaat
Omschrijving opdracht

Organisatieonderdeel
Een goede waterkwaliteit is belangrijk. Omdat water zich weinig aantrekt van landsgrenzen, zijn internationale afspraken nodig. Sinds eind 2000 is daarom de Europese Kaderrichtlijn Water (KRW) van kracht. Deze moet ervoor zorgen dat de kwaliteit van het oppervlakte- en grondwater in Europa op orde is. Om dit te bereiken moeten de landen van de Europese Unie een groot aantal maatregelen nemen. Enerzijds om de kwaliteit van de 'eigen' wateren op peil te brengen, anderzijds om ervoor te zorgen dat andere landen geen last meer hebben van de verontreinigingen die hun buurlanden veroorzaken. Om dat te bereiken hebben de landen met de EU afspraken gemaakt om een groot aantal maatregelen te nemen zodat de waterkwaliteit van alle wateren in 2027 volledig voldoet aan de eisen.
Binnen Oost Nederland zijn veel van de KRW maatregelen die in Nederland gerealiseerd worden gelegen. De afgelopen jaren is er veel werk verzet om de KRW opgave te realiseren. Zo is er bijvoorbeeld een omvangrijk Planstudie proces ingericht om de maatregelen te ontwerpen. Daarnaast zijn er sinds een aantal jaar diverse maatregelen in uitvoering. Doordat de opleverdatum van het KRW programma met rasse schreden dichterbij komt zullen processen verder geoptimaliseerd moeten worden om te borgen dat de opdracht binnen de kaders van tijd en geld en veiligheid kan worden gerealiseerd. De complexiteit van de opgave ligt in de omvang (meer dan 70 projecten), maar ook doordat de projecten zowel geografisch verspreid liggen en allemaal een andere tijdslijn van planstudie tot en met realisatie kennen.

Over Vending@Work
Vending@Work (V@W) is opgericht in 1994 te Groningen en begon destijds met het plaatsen van zogeheten honestyboxen bij bedrijven en instellingen. Het concept was gebaseerd op de eerlijkheid van de mens. Consumenten konden betalen met een gulden voor elk artikel dat zij uit de box haalden, maar konden dit ook niet doen. Vooral bij grotere organisaties hield dit concept niet lang stand, zodat in 1998 werd besloten tot het plaatsen en exploiteren van frisdrank-, snack- en versautomaten. Vandaag de dag bedient V@W vanuit drie distributiecentra (Groningen, Nieuwegein en Nijmegen ) circa 5.000 automaten in Nederland. Daarnaast verzorgt V@W in meerdere school- en bedrijfskantines de catering. Met de inzet van circa 250 medewerkers is V@W daarmee één van de grootste landelijke spelers in de markt van vending.
Voor onze vestiging in Groningen zijn wij op zoek naar een plaatser / medewerker Technische Dienst in de buitendienst.
Over de functie
In deze functie ga je zelfstandig op pad met de bestelbus om storingen te verhelpen aan automaten bij onze opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het (gebruiksklaar) plaatsen en ophalen van de automaten. Ook voer je technisch onderhoud uit zodat de automaten perfect blijven functioneren. About TodayTix Group:
 
TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including  TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment.
 
Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world.
 
In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement.
 
Life at TodayTix Group
We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.
 
New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development.
 
Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. 
 
We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role: 

Powered by TodayTix (PxT) is TodayTix Group's enterprise ticketing and e-commerce division — the technology and tools that help the world's leading cultural organisations, attractions, and live events power their box office and drive online sales. We work with some of the most exciting venues, producers, and event organisers on the planet, and we're building the platform that helps them thrive.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the PxT team — someone who thrives on data, moves fast, and is obsessed with identifying friction and building products that meaningfully improve how people discover, buy, and experience live events.

You'll own product discovery and delivery for a key area of our platform, working directly with producers and event organisers to understand their needs, shape solutions, and bring them to life alongside world-class engineering and design teams.

You instinctively reach for AI to think, prototype, validate ideas, and accelerate learning. You'll often start with ambiguity rather than requirements and enjoy identifying opportunities, forming hypotheses, and turning ideas into action.

This role sits at the intersection of user experience and business strategy. It's ideal for someone who combines strong product instinct with platform thinking — someone who values speed, learning, and measurable outcomes over perfection. You'll also manage or mentor other PMs, contributing to how we grow product craft across the team.

Please note: This is a full-time position. Qualified candidates must be based in the Greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.


What Success Looks Like:

  • Product direction established → Within the first 60–90 days, you've developed a strong understanding of your product area and helped shape a roadmap informed by customer insight, business priorities, and platform goals.

  • Customer obsession in practice → Ongoing discovery is embedded in your workflow, with evidence that customer insights directly influence prioritisation and product decisions.

  • Experimentation velocity → Ideas move quickly from concept to learning through prototypes, pilots, and releases.

  • Features shipped with measurable impact → Platform initiatives launched with measurable outcomes tied to adoption, conversion, GMV, operational efficiency, retention, or partner satisfaction.

  • Commercial contribution → Your work contributes meaningfully to partner and business outcomes through stronger engagement, increased value, or improved performance metrics.

  • AI-native execution → AI is embedded throughout your workflow — helping you synthesise research, generate prototypes, validate assumptions, and accelerate delivery.

  • Team impact → You're contributing to how great product work gets done at TodayTix Group — not just within your own area, through mentorship, management, and raising the bar across the team.


    • What You'll Do:

  • Work directly with event producers and organisers — inside and outside the MARI group — to understand needs, identify opportunities, and help define product direction.

  • Use AI tools to create prototypes, synthesise research, and communicate product ideas clearly and efficiently.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design teams to deliver platform features that solve real customer problems.

  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Contribute to roadmap development and prioritisation across the broader PxT platform.

  • Track and assess product performance using data and measurable outcomes.

  • Manage complex cross-functional initiatives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.

  • Operate across the product lifecycle — from identifying opportunities and validating concepts to delivering and iterating on solutions.


    • We're Looking for Someone With:

  • 5–8 years of building products in high-growth environments — whether at startups, consumer platforms, SaaS companies, or entrepreneurial ventures. Experience managing or mentoring product managers, with a genuine desire to grow PM craft across the team.

  • Demonstrated builder mindset — whether through launching products, founding something, side projects, experimentation, or creating new processes from scratch.

  • Strong experience owning product initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Strong communication and strategic thinking skills — able to articulate ideas, navigate tradeoffs, and influence decisions.

  • Experience in live events, hospitality, marketplace, or premium consumer experiences is a plus.

  • Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow — using them habitually to accelerate research, prototyping, decision-making, and execution.

  • Comfort in fast-paced, cross-functional environments — you know how to collaborate across design, engineering, and commercial teams.

  • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or marketing technology is a plus.

  • Experience with sports ticketing, a plus.

About the Role:

TodayTix Group is on a mission to find a seat for everyone. We connect audiences to live entertainment experiences they'll love, making it easier, faster, and more joyful to discover and buy tickets. We're a diverse, dynamic team united by a shared love for live events. We foster an environment of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, offering unparalleled opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

We're looking for a generalist operator to join the team — someone with sharp judgment, a bias to action, and the instinct to dig into a problem, figure out what to measure, and ship a solution without waiting for instructions. You'll work across e-commerce, customer experience, data, and operations — owning problem spaces end-to-end from identification through delivery and measurement.

This isn't a role where you sit in a lane. You'll move between strategy, analysis, customer insight, and hands-on building depending on what the problem requires — and you like it that way. You might come from analytics, product management, operations, or something else entirely. Over time, the role may specialise based on your strengths and where the business needs you.

You reach for data before forming an opinion, talk to customers before assuming you understand the problem, and use AI tools to move faster than traditional workflows allow.

Please note: This is a full-time position. Qualified candidates must be based in the Greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.



What Success Looks Like:

  • Problems found and solved → You consistently spot problems worth solving and drive them to resolution. Example: you notice our cancellation policy is generating avoidable refund volume, analyse the alternatives and their impact, recommend a change, and lead the implementation through to measurement.

  • Customer signal in the room → Customer feedback, support data, and behavioural signals visibly influence what gets built. You're the person who brings "here's what customers are actually experiencing" into prioritisation, backed by data.

  • Measurement that matters → New capabilities ship with success criteria defined upfront and honest reads after. You tell us what worked, what didn't, and what to do about it.

  • Clarity that moves people → When you frame a problem, write a recommendation, or present a post-launch read, people act on it. Engineers and operators are faster because you made the next steps obvious.

We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join TodayTix Group and own how we scale our data platform — the backbone connecting product, growth, finance, and CX to a single source of truth, plus increasingly the substrate AI tooling across the company queries directly. You'll lead the team that owns the project end-to-end — staging, intermediates, and marts — plus the CI/CD pipeline and Snowflake platform underneath it.

This is a technical leadership role, not a heads-down modelling one — most of your time goes to architecture, review, technical strategy, and cross-functional leadership, with hands-on modelling a deliberate minority. You lead by setting direction, raising the team's bar, and owning delivery, quality, and stakeholder trust across a high-demand roadmap.

The foundation is built — your job is what gets built on top of it as the org scales. TTG is expanding as part of MARI, bringing new portfolio companies' event and ticketing data onto the platform; PxT (our partner-facing product) is growing its surface area; and the business keeps adding markets and brands. You'll design how the platform absorbs that growth — new sources, new consumers, higher stakes — without the architecture buckling.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, measure your impact by the team's, not just your own, and care as much about business impact as technical craft, we'd love to hear from you — especially if, like the rest of the team, you reach for AI by default.

Please note: This full-time position and qualified candidates must be based in the Greater London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.


What Success Looks Like:

  • The platform scales, it doesn't strain → New portfolio events, new surfaces, and new markets onboard onto the existing staging/intermediates/marts pattern without one-off hacks or a rebuild.

  • Data people trust by default → Certified marts stay accurate and documented as volume and source count grow; breaking changes get caught by CI and dbt tests, not discovered by a stakeholder in a dashboard.

  • A faster, more autonomous team → Engineers ship models confidently without you reviewing every line; your reports are visibly levelling up.

  • Architecture that holds → Your design decisions — dynamic tables vs. incremental models, how a new portfolio company's data enters the model, orchestration choices — hold up as sources and consumers multiply, and design flaws get caught in review, not production.

  • Trust through ownership → Stakeholders across product, growth, finance, and CX bring you problems, not tickets, because you communicate early and their reporting hasn't broken under them.


    • What You'll Do:

  • Own the data platform end-to-end — the dbt project (staging → intermediates → marts), CI/CD, and the Snowflake infrastructure it runs on.

  • Design and lead the onboarding of new data sources onto the platform as TTG scales, so growth doesn't mean architectural debt.

  • Partner with data consumers — product, growth, finance, CX, and incoming portfolio teams — to model new sources cleanly rather than bolt them on under deadline pressure.

  • Run intake and prioritisation across a high-demand roadmap where reporting, growth analytics, and AI-tooling initiatives compete for the same team's time — sequence against business objectives, and say no well.

  • Protect data quality systematically — dbt tests, contract-enforced schemas, and CI that catches breaking changes before they reach a dashboard or an AI agent.

  • Set technical direction for the warehouse and give the kind of code review that makes data engineers better — spotting model design flaws before they ship.

  • Lead and grow the team — 1:1s, feedback, and career development.

  • Build the factory, not just the models: keep pushing AI into how the team works, and support the org's growing use of AI agents as direct consumers of the warehouse you build.


    • We're Looking for Someone With:

  • A track record of leading engineers. 8+ years in data engineering (or software engineering with a heavy data bent), including leading a team — formally or informally — and growing the engineers around you. This is the core of the role.

  • Deep SQL and dbt expertise. You've built and scaled a dbt project in production — models, tests, macros, contracts — and reason about warehouse cost and performance, not just correctness.

  • Cloud data warehouse depth. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable MPP warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery).

  • Experience scaling a data platform through growth — onboarding new business units, acquisitions, or data sources onto an existing model without rearchitecting from scratch. (M&A / multi-entity data integration experience is directly relevant given the evolving company structure.)

  • Full-stack data platform judgement. Comfortable across ingestion (CDC/replication from operational databases, event pipelines), transformation (dbt), and consumption (BI tools, reverse ETL, AI/agent access) — even where you're not the one writing every layer.

  • Strong architecture and code review. You set technical direction through sound data-model design and give review that makes engineers better.

  • Stakeholder management. You partner with product, finance, growth, and CX — translating messy source data into models people trust, and setting expectations as priorities shift.

  • A product and business mindset. You measure success by the decisions your data enabled, not rows modelled.

  • AI fluency. You already reach for AI to write and review data models, and you're comfortable with AI agents as first-class consumers of the warehouse you build.

    • You don't need to tick every box. If most of this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.


    Nice to Have:

  • Experience with a customer data platform (CDP) and identity resolution across multiple event sources — directly relevant to unifying data across our portfolio companies.

  • Experience with CDC / replication tools feeding a warehouse from an operational database (MySQL, Postgres)

  • Experience with Looker/LookML or another BI semantic layer.

jobs.title: Director, CRM & Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.description:
About TodayTix Group:
 
TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including  TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment.
 
Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world.
 
In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement.
 
Life at TodayTix Group
We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.
 
New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development.
 
Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. 
 
We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role: 

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Director of CRM and Lifecycle Marketing to own our CRM program, every email, push, and SMS we send to millions of theatre and event-goers, and to lead the team that runs it. CRM is how we turn interest into action across a customer's life with us: getting new customers to their first show, keeping our best customers coming back, and winning back the ones who've drifted. You'll own that messaging end to end and be the person the company trusts on anything CRM.

Our CRM already drives a large share of our business. Now we want to make it one of the smartest, most automated programs out there. We're building toward a Next Best Action model where automation and AI decide the right message, moment, and channel for each customer, at scale. We want someone genuinely energized by that: who sees automation and AI as the core of how a modern CRM program runs, and who will keep pushing what's possible, including piloting new channels and surfaces, like WhatsApp.

This is a role for someone who thrives on full end-to-end ownership. You'll set the strategy, bring the ideas, and run the program without waiting to be told what to do.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are energized by data, automation, and building programs that scale, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note: This is a full-time role and qualified candidates must be based in the greater New York City or London area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week.


What Success Looks Like:

  • Repeat purchase and retention climb among addressable customers.

  • More new customers make a first and second purchase, and make it sooner, as onboarding messaging turns a trial into a habit.

  • Revenue from CRM channels grows as a share of total and is trusted as incremental, not just attributed.

  • A Next Best Action model is live and increasingly automated. The model is choosing the right message, moment, and channel for messages.

  • You've become the company's clear owner of CRM: leadership sets the goals, and the strategy, roadmap, and day-to-day calls are yours.


What You'll Do:

  • Own the CRM program end to end - set the strategy and roadmap for every email, push, and SMS, generate the ideas that move it forward, and be the person the company trusts to make the call.

  • Make AI and automation core - push the program from batch campaigns to an automated, AI-driven Next Best Action model that picks the right message, moment, and channel for each customer.

  • Lead full-lifecycle messaging - from user onboarding through repeat, winback, and loyalty, with repeat purchase as the core goal.

  • Explore new channels and surfaces - pilot opportunities like WhatsApp and in-app messaging in partnership with product, and scale the ones that work.

  • Lead and develop the team - coach the CRM team, prioritize sharply, and raise the bar on both execution and analysis.

  • Make CRM provably incremental - establish holdout testing and reporting so the program’s revenue impact is measurable.

  • Partner closely with product and data - work hand in glove to connect CRM messaging with the wider customer experience.

    • Note: This list represents the highest-priority focus areas for this role. Responsibilities will naturally evolve as the business grows and shifts - candidates should expect the scope to develop over time.


We're Looking For Someone With:

  • 8+ years in CRM, lifecycle, or messaging marketing, including experience leading and developing a team.

  • A track record of driving repeat purchase, retention, and LTV ideally at a marketplace or other high-frequency consumer business.

  • Proven experience moving a program beyond batch-and-blast to triggered, automated, decisioned messaging and the appetite to push further with AI.

  • Hands-on depth with a modern CRM/messaging platform (we use Iterable) and strong customer segmentation.

  • An enthusiasm for leveraging AI and emerging technologies to innovate our CRM strategies and enhance both team and individual productivity.

  • Strong analytical rigor. Comfortable defining success metrics, using modern analytics tools, running experiments and tests, and judging true incremental impact

  • A full-ownership mindset. You set the agenda rather than wait for direction, and you’ve run a program where the strategy was yours to define, not just deliver.

  • Bonus: A genuine interest in theatre, live events, and the performing arts or experience in an environment with constantly evolving inventory, where what customers can buy is always changing.

AEO/GEO/SEO Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Millions of people now start with a question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity, and the answer they get decides which products they try. When someone asks how to build an app, a website, or a tool for their business, Replit needs to be the answer.

We're hiring an AEO/GEO/SEO Lead to own how Replit gets discovered, across AI-generated answers and traditional search. This is a zero-to-one role. You'll define the strategy, then execute it yourself with AI-leveraged production, agency partners, and cross-functional teams behind you. You'll work daily with our Web, Growth, Brand, Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

The fastest-growing AI-native companies have already turned AI answers into a primary acquisition channel. Your mandate is to do the same for Replit: grow AI referral traffic into one of our largest sources of new builders, keep our traditional search presence compounding, and make Replit the platform AI assistants recommend when anyone wants to build software.

Replit moves fast. We ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part operator, part scientist of a channel that changes every month.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AEO/GEO Strategy Define where Replit must show up across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, for which prompts and buyer intents, and build the playbook to win those answers. Set targets, sequence the roadmap, and defend the strategy with data.

 - Win Citations Across the Open Web LLMs cite what they trust: Reddit threads, YouTube videos, high-authority publications, community content, and well-structured owned pages. Build durable programs on each of these surfaces, understand the half-life of an AI citation, and keep Replit ranked as models retrain and retrieval systems shift.

 - Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

 - Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

 - Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

 - Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.
   



YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years in SEO, organic growth, or content-driven acquisition (ideally within SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses), including hands-on AEO/GEO work within the last year

 - Can show real results: AI referral traffic you grew, citations you won, rankings you moved, and how you measured all of it

 - Are technically fluent in SEO: keyword research, crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, and log analysis

 - Understand how LLMs actually retrieve and cite sources, and how that differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

 - Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

 - Are analytical enough to build credible measurement in a messy, fast-changing channel, connecting organic visibility to traffic, signups, product adoption, and revenue

 - Are comfortable partnering with engineering, product, content, and analytics stakeholders to get changes shipped in a fast-moving environment

 - Love building from scratch: frameworks, processes, and strategy

 - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don't wait for someone else to define the playbook

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to dig into the details
   



BONUS POINTS:

 - Made AI answers a primary acquisition channel at a PLG, consumer, or developer-facing software company

 - Deep Reddit fluency: you understand how communities work and how to earn credible presence there

 - Experience running YouTube as an organic discovery channel

 - Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

 - Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

 - You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our builders firsthand

 - Experience directing SEO/AEO agencies and fractional specialists



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.description:
Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. That means every design decision you make has a direct impact on someone’s day-to-day work and quality of life.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.

  • Drive a full end-to-end design process: from user research and journey mapping through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and handoff.

  • Turn real insights into real outcomes: we’ve already secured access to end users — no guessing games or fake personas.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success) and external client teams.

  • Advocate for users and bring clarity to complex workflows in a fast-moving environment.

  • Shape our design culture: collaborate with other designers who care deeply about craft, mentoring, and shipping great work.

 

You should apply if you...

  • Have strong experience designing B2B SaaS platforms, especially ones with complex workflows or enterprise users.

  • Have worked end-to-end, from research to UI.

  • Have a solid craft, creating designs that are well thought through and visually pleasing.

  • Love getting into the messy middle — researching, simplifying, iterating, and polishing.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity: shaping problems, identifying opportunities, and working without a detailed spec.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently, especially when collaborating with engineers or presenting to stakeholders.

  • Enjoy taking initiative, and owning your work.

  • Want to join a team that balances high standards with low ego.

 

This role might not be for you if...

  • You’re just focused on visual design or UI polish, but not the UX or research side.

  • You’ve only worked on incremental improvements and never designed new flows or features.

  • You’ve only worked on marketing sites or mobile apps and haven’t designed complex systems.

  • You prefer working on specs handed to you, rather than leading your own discovery.

  • You’re not comfortable speaking up in cross-functional conversations or with external stakeholders.

 

  • Location: London (hybrid — 3 days/week in-office). Candidates must have the right to work in the UK; we're unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Why Raft?

Supply chain is the last great industry to be transformed by software. We're here to make it happen — and we need people who grab problems, not assignments.

  • We move quickly, and the bar is high. You won't be handed a roadmap. You'll identify what needs solving, build toward it, and own the outcome end-to-end.

  • Impact is the measure. We don't track activity. We care about what actually moves the needle — for our customers, our product, and the industry we're reshaping.

  • The problem is real, and the scale is global. The supply chain industry moves $19 trillion of goods a year. We're building the AI workforce that makes it run smarter. Your work will matter.

  • You'll operate with autonomy. No micromanagement. No waiting for permission. We hire people who are self-directed and trust them to deliver.

  • We're a multicultural team building something unprecedented. We work with the clarity and urgency of a team that knows what's at stake.

If you care about impact and want your work to shape the future of AI supply chain — you'll thrive here.

jobs.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Why this role exists?

Allica is expanding internationally, establishing a regulated entity in its first international market and deploying the proprietary technology platform there.

The platform model is deliberately repeatable, so that further markets can be added if and when the opportunity arises. The purpose of this role is to design and implement a repeatable international platform model, prove it in the first market, and enable each local entity to operate its own identity and local access services within centrally governed technology, security and identity standards.

The role owns the international Azure platform end to end, from design and build through ongoing run. Identity is delivered on a build-and-hand-over basis: the role designs and implements each entity's Entra environment, then transitions day-to-day operation to the local team, remaining involved for enhancement rather than implementation. Both sit within a governance model where technical controls are defined centrally by Allica's UK platform and security functions, and each international entity operates as a consumer of those controls with local attestation.

Accountabilities

Multi-market platform foundations, delivered as code

  • Design and build a parameterised Azure landing zone that can be instantiated per market, covering subscription and management group topology, networking, connectivity, policy assignment, and baseline observability.

  • Deliver the entire estate through Infrastructure as Code with peer review, automated policy compliance checks, and no manual configuration changes. The landing zone is a product, not a project.

  • Make market-specific variation explicit and narrow — a small, documented set of local deltas over a common baseline, rather than a fork.

    Identity and access across multiple entities

  • Work with central Technology, Identity and Security teams to design and implement a repeatable Entra operating model for international entities, including tenant structure, directory topology, privileged-access patterns, joiner–mover– leaver processes and conditional-access baselines.

  • Lead the technical onboarding and initial implementation of each entity’s Entra environment in line with centrally approved architecture and control standards.

  • Ensure each local entity has the capability, documentation, access model, runbooks and evidence processes required to operate its own Entra tenant dayto-day.

  • Establish a clear handover and assurance model: local entity teams operate workforce identity and local access administration; central teams own the architectural standards and control baseline; the International Platform team leads implementation and, following handover, supports oversight and enhancement rather than day-to-day operation.

  • Work with central identity owners on cross-entity access and material design changes. Local regulatory deltas and exceptions must be documented, evidenced and approved through the central governance process.

Regulatory and control assurance

  • Operate the "central controls, local attestation" model: implement Allica's centrally-defined control set in each market, maintain the evidence that demonstrates it, and manage the thin layer of genuine local regulatory delta.

  • Produce and maintain a local-delta attestation template that scales to further markets.

  • Ensure the platform meets DORA and operational resilience obligations — ICT risk management, incident classification and reporting, resilience testing, and third-party ICT arrangements.

Running the platform

  • Own service availability and performance for the international platform, including on-call arrangements, incident management, SLOs, capacity, and change management.

  • Define an operating model that is sustainable for a small team across time zones, and that scales as markets are added rather than multiplying headcount linearly.

  • Feed run experience back into the landing zone templates so each subsequent market starts from a better baseline.

Leading the team

  • Recruit, lead, and develop a small, senior engineering team. Set the technical bar and be an active participant in the work.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Substantial hands-on Azure architecture experience at scale, including landing zone design, management group and subscription topology, networking, and Azure Policy

  • .Deep, practical Infrastructure as Code capability (Terraform) including module design for reuse, and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure.

  • Demonstrable experience designing and operating Microsoft Entra ID in a multientity or multi-tenant context: tenancy models, conditional access, privileged identity management, and identity lifecycle automation.

  • Delivery within a regulated financial services environment, with working knowledge of operational resilience expectations and DORA, and direct experience producing evidence for regulators or auditors.

  • Experience running production platforms, not only building them, incident management, on-call, and service ownership.

  • Track record leading small, senior engineering teams while remaining technically hands-on.

  • Comfort operating within a centrally governed control environment, and the judgement to distinguish a genuine local regulatory requirement from a preference.

  • Work closely with UK platform, security, and product-engineering functions. This role influences the central control set through evidence and horizon scanning, and does not diverge from it unilaterally.

jobs.title: Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the security foundations behind cutting-edge construction technology

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, our technology – and the security environment supporting it – is becoming increasingly sophisticated.

Our stack spans Kubernetes on Azure, mobile and embedded AR, REST APIs, real-time collaboration and AI-powered data pipelines. We already hold SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, but as our product, customers and use of AI continue to evolve, we now need dedicated security expertise within the business.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Security & Compliance Engineer to take ownership of security across XYZ Reality and help build a security capability that can scale with us.

The Role

This is a critical hire and an opportunity to become our first dedicated security specialist, with genuine ownership and influence across the business.

While we already have established compliance activity and SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, security responsibilities currently sit across different teams. We’re now looking for someone who can bring that together, identify where we need to strengthen our approach and provide dedicated technical security leadership as we scale.

This is first and foremost a technical security role. You’ll sit within Engineering and work directly alongside the teams building our technology, participating in architecture discussions, development workflows and technical decision-making rather than operating as a separate security function reviewing work after the fact.

You’ll take ownership of security architecture across our technology stack, embed shift-left security practices into how we build, strengthen our cloud and application security, and ensure we remain ahead of both established and emerging threats.

As our use of AI continues to develop, you’ll also help us understand and respond to new AI-related security risks and attack vectors, ensuring our security approach evolves alongside our technology.

Compliance remains an important part of the role. You’ll help strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 posture and support areas including GDPR, data residency and enterprise customer requirements. However, we’re looking for someone who brings strong hands-on security expertise first, alongside the governance and compliance knowledge needed to operate effectively across both areas.

You won’t simply inherit a security playbook, you’ll have the opportunity to help build one.

The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work closely with our Engineering, Product and wider business teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Take ownership of security architecture and technical security across XYZ Reality’s technology environment.

  • Assess our current security posture, identify vulnerabilities and control gaps, and develop pragmatic remediation plans.

  • Architect and strengthen security across our Azure cloud environment, including Kubernetes clusters, databases and data pipelines.

  • Own and improve areas including IAM, zero-trust networking, secrets management, RBAC, pod security and encryption.

  • Embed shift-left security into engineering workflows, integrating SAST, DAST, dependency scanning and SCA into our CI/CD pipelines.

  • Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams on architectural decisions, technical trade-offs and secure-by-design development.

  • Run threat-modelling exercises and support developers with secure coding practices across Node.js, React Native and C++ environments.

  • Own vulnerability management, including triage, risk prioritisation, remediation tracking and incident response where required.

  • Develop and improve the logging, monitoring and alerting capabilities needed to identify and respond to security threats.

  • Assess emerging threats, including those associated with AI-enabled products, tooling and new attack methodologies, and ensure our security approach continues to evolve.

  • Strengthen our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 controls, identifying gaps and improving implementation where needed.

  • Support compliance cycles including controls testing, evidence gathering and auditor coordination.

  • Support GDPR and data residency requirements across our infrastructure and data pipelines.

  • Engage with enterprise customers and prospects on XYZ Reality’s security posture when required.

  • Automate security controls and processes wherever possible rather than relying on manual intervention.

  • Help establish the standards, tooling and operating model for a security capability that can scale with the business.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrable in-depth hands-on technical security experience, ideally spanning application, cloud and/or infrastructure security.

  • Strong technical security capability and the confidence to own security decisions end-to-end rather than operating purely in an advisory or governance capacity.

  • Strong cloud security experience, ideally Azure, although significant AWS or GCP expertise with the ability to transition quickly to Azure would also be considered.

  • Hands-on experience securing Kubernetes/containerised environments, including IAM, RBAC, network segmentation, secrets management, image scanning and pod security.

  • Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD environments, including SAST, DAST, SCA and dependency scanning.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code security and technologies such as Terraform, Helm or GitOps.

  • Understanding of application and API security, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS and secure development practices.

  • Experience identifying vulnerabilities, assessing technical risk and driving remediation.

  • Comfortable writing automation using Python, Go, Bash or similar to operationalise security controls.

  • Practical experience working with SOC 2 Type II and/or ISO 27001, including identifying gaps and strengthening controls.

  • Current knowledge of the evolving cybersecurity landscape and an interest in emerging threats, particularly those associated with AI.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate security requirements for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach, you understand that great security enables engineering teams rather than creating unnecessary barriers.

Experience building or scaling security capability within a high-growth or Series A/B technology business would be particularly valuable. You’ll understand the balance between addressing today’s risks and building security foundations capable of supporting where the business is heading next.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who is technically strong, curious and proactive, someone engineers want to work with, who can bring credibility to security conversations while remaining pragmatic about how we build and ship great technology.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact across areas including:

  • Azure and Kubernetes security architecture

  • Application and API security

  • Secure software development and shift-left security

  • Vulnerability management and incident response

  • AI-related security and emerging threat management

  • SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 maturity

  • Security automation and CI/CD integration

  • Enterprise customer security requirements

jobs.title: Senior PR Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
