jobs.title: Business Controller
jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Controller

At TRATON Financial Services (TFS) we have started the journey to become the provider of Financial Services to all TRATON brands. Our service includes financing for customers, dealers, and distributors as well as insurance solutions. With a presence in over 65 markets, we are already one of the most global actors in the financial services industry and are rapidly growing. Do you want to be part of this journey?

Role Summary

We are looking for a curious and business-minded Business Controller to join Scania Financial Services at our head office in Södertälje. In this role, you will play a key part in providing financial insights that support strategic decision-making across a global organization. Working closely with business units, finance managers, and key stakeholders across our markets, you will help drive performance, planning, and continuous improvement in an international and dynamic environment.

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

    Prepare monthly analysis of the consolidated financial performance for Scania Financial Services
    Coordinate and drive financial planning processes
    Present financial outcomes, forecasts and plans to management and other key stakeholders
    Contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement of finance processes
    Identify improvement opportunities and contribute to turning them into concrete actions
    Take part in Financial Services projects and cross-functional initiatives
    Support our finance companies around the world in business control matters



You will be part of a global context, working closely with finance managers and colleagues across our markets, as well as with Scania Commercial Operations, the headoffice TRATON Financial Services and other stakeholders within the group.

Who You Are

You bring a combination of strong analytical skills, business acumen, and a genuine curiosity to understand what drives performance. To succeed in this role, you have:

    A master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
    Experience in business control, financial analysis, or a similar finance role.
    The ability to translate financial data into clear insights and recommendations that support decision-making.
    A structured and proactive approach, with a continuous improvement mindset.
    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust across functions and cultures.
    A collaborative attitude and a genuine interest in working in an international environment.
    Advanced Excel skills and fluency in English.

It is also an advantage if you have:

    Experience from the financial services industry.
    Experience working with HFM, Power BI, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
    Knowledge of Swedish or other languages.



This Is Us

We are a team of four colleagues supporting the financial performance of Scania Financial Services across more than 60 markets worldwide. Together with finance managers, business controllers, and senior leaders, we transform financial data into insights that help shape business decisions.

We believe the best results come from collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. In our team, you'll work in an international environment where you can make an impact, contribute to improvements, and grow together with supportive and engaged colleagues.

TRATON Financial Services Offers

We believe great work starts with feeling supported, both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a broad range of employee benefits designed to promote wellbeing, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance. Employees can enjoy flexible working hours and a workplace that supports both collaboration and flexibility. With office Hubs in Södertälje and Stockholm, as well as coworking spaces at Sergels Torg and Kungens Kurva, you will have the best preconditions to pick the best workplace for your activities.

We provide a yearly wellness contribution and you can train at our health center Gröndal, and you will access to occupational health services with doctors, nurses, and ergonomists. Mental health is important to us, therefore we also offer confidential staff support services for guidance related to personal challenges.

In addition, employees benefit from pension plans, profit sharing programs, and extra time off or additional pension contributions. We also support family life through enhanced parental benefits and offer additional perks such as employee car leasing. Together, these benefits help create a workplace where you can thrive both at work and in everyday life.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-03. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Åsa Näselius, Head of Business Control, Scania Financial Services, asa.naselius@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Financial Services

#TFS

jobs.title: Allround Hotellmedarbeider – Klar for alt i Rotsund?
jobs.description:
Vi søker hotellmedarbeider!

Vi søker deg som ønsker en variert arbeidshverdag med housekeeping og frokostservering. Du er nøyaktig, serviceinnstilt og trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team. Erfaring fra hotell er en fordel, men riktig innstilling er viktigst.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er positiv, pålitelig og serviceinnstilt, og som liker å skape gode opplevelser for andre. Du tar ansvar, ser hva som må gjøres og kan arbeide selvstendig, samtidig som du trives som en del av et team.

Du møter både gjester og kollegaer med respekt og et smil, er fleksibel når dagen ikke går helt som planlagt og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra første dag. Erfaring fra hotell, housekeeping eller servering er en fordel, men motivasjon, arbeidsvilje og riktig innstilling er viktigere. Vi ser etter en person som ønsker å lære, utvikle seg og vokse sammen med oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hotellmedarbeider -- Housekeeping & Frokost

Vi søker en positiv og fleksibel hotellmedarbeider som vil være med på å skape gode gjesteopplevelser.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil hovedsakelig være:

  • Rengjøring og klargjøring av hotellrom og fellesarealer

  • Skifte av sengetøy og håndklær

  • Kontroll av rom før gjestenes ankomst

  • Klargjøring og servering av frokost

  • Påfyll og rydding av frokostbuffet

  • Oppvask og rengjøring av kjøkken og frokostområde

  • Møte gjestene på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte

  • Bidra der det er behov i den daglige hotelldriften

Vi ser etter deg som er nøyaktig, effektiv, fleksibel og serviceinnstilt. Du må kunne arbeide både selvstendig og sammen med andre. Arbeidet innebærer vakter på morgener, hverdager og helger.

Krav:
30 sekunders personlig video

Vi vil gjerne bli litt bedre kjent med deg!

Send oss en kort video på maks. 30 sekunder hvor du forteller:

Hvorfor ønsker du å jobbe hos Lyngen North, og hva tror du at du kan bidra med i teamet vårt?

Videoen trenger ikke å være profesjonell -- bruk mobilen og vær deg selv. Vi er først og fremst nysgjerrige på personen bak søknaden.

  • Du må kunne kommunisere godt på engelsk

  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav

Erfaring fra hotell, housekeeping eller servering er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For oss er riktig innstilling, ansvarsfølelse og ønsket om å gi gjestene god service det viktigste.

Vi tilbyr

  • Lønn i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale

  • Mulighet for bolig

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende team

  • Et internasjonalt og spennende arbeidsmiljø

  • En variert arbeidshverdag med ulike oppgaver

  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg og få erfaring fra hotell- og reiselivsbransjen

  • En arbeidsplass der samarbeid, service og gode gjesteopplevelser står i fokus

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lyngen North er en unik reiselivsdestinasjon i Nord-Norge, vakkert plassert ved Lyngenfjorden med spektakulær utsikt mot Lyngsalpene. Vi tilbyr overnatting i eksklusive glassigloer, suiter og hytter, kombinert med restaurant og arktiske aktiviteter.

Våre gjester kommer fra hele verden for å oppleve nordlyset, midnattssolen, naturen, stillheten og ekte nordnorske opplevelser. Hos oss står personlig service og gode gjesteopplevelser i sentrum.

Lyngen North er en internasjonal arbeidsplass med et engasjert team fra flere land. Vi jobber tett sammen på tvers av housekeeping, restaurant, kjøkken, aktiviteter og gjesteservice. Hos oss blir du en del av et miljø med høyt tempo, varierte arbeidsdager og fantastiske omgivelser.

Töitä on tarjolla viikonloppuisin ilta-/yöpainotteisesti. Osaamisesi mukaan vuoroja voi olla silloin tällöin tarjolla myös arkipäivinä. Työsuhde on määräaikainen vuoden loppuun asti.

Tarjoamme työn innovatiivisesta ja menestyksekkäästä yhtiöstä, jossa sekä asiakkaiden, että henkilökunnan viihtyvyys on kunnia-asia. jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelija –liity Valoon tiimiin!
jobs.description:
Nautitko ihmisten auttamisesta ja mutkattoman asiakaspalvelun tarjoamisesta? Haluatko olla osa kasvavaa yritystä, jossa asiakaskokemus on kaiken keskiössä? Etsimme uusia asiakaspalvelijoita tuottamaan erinomaisia kohtaamisia Valoon asiakkaille osana motivoitunutta tiimiä.

Valonnopeudella kasvava Valoo on valokuitumarkkinoiden raikkain ja rohkein toimija, joka tuo laadukkaat, nopeat ja kestävät valokuituyhteydet yhä useampaan suomalaiseen kotiin. Asiakkaille tarjoamme markkinoiden parhaan nettiyhteyden - työntekijöille innostavan, lämpimän ja merkityksellisen työympäristön.

Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu

Asiakaspalvelijana päätehtäväsi on asiakkaiden kontaktoiminen informatiivisella ja ystävällisellä otteella, asiakaspalvelun kasvoina toimiminen eri yhteydenpitokanavissa sekä luonnollisesti Valoon palveluiden myynti. Sinulla on tärkeä rooli Valoon ilosanoman jalkauttamisessa ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamisessa. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti Seinäjoen toimistolta käsin ja työpäiväsi sijoittuvat arkipäivisin klo 9-17 ja lauantaisin klo 10-16 väliselle ajalle.

Mitä toivomme sinulta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista jakirjallista osaamista asiakaspalvelun laadun varmistamiseksi
- Positiivista ja rentoapalveluasennetta - tavoitteenasi on tuottaa mieleenpainuva asiakaskokemus
- Hyvää tilannetajua sekä kiinnostustaasiakasta kohtaan
- Tavoitteellista suhtautumistaasiakaspalveluun
- Kykyä toimia erilaisissavuorovaikutustilanteissa ja kuunnella asiakasta aidosti
- Iloista ja ratkaisukeskeistälähestymistapaa
Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta on eduksesi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme hyvää tyyppiä oikealla asenteella.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

- Paikan kasvavassa yrityksessä ja reippaassa, rempseässä työporukassa
- Joustavan työn, jossa arvostetaan yhdessä tekemisen meininkiä
- Kattavan koulutuksen tehtävään -sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen
- Uudet ja raikkaat toimitilat inspiroivassa työympäristössä Seinäjoen keskustassa
- ICT-alan TES:n mukaisen kuukausipalkan 2 184,90 € / kk (osa-aikaisen tuntipalkka 13,83 €) sekä kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän
- Baronan työterveyspalvelut sekä lounasetu
Tarjoamme tehtävää sekä kokoaikaisena että osa-aikaisena. Etsimme tiimiimme kokoaikaisen (37,5 h/vko) asiakaspalvelijan lisäksi myös osa-aikaista tekijää, jonka työaika on noin 20 tuntia viikossa. Työvuorot sijoittuvat asiakaspalvelumme aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

Rekrytointiin liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaa Baronan henkilöstökonsultti Anni Kivimäki, anni.kivimaki@barona.fi.

jobs.title: Lead Test Automation Developer – Saab Naval
jobs.description:
_Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar._

We are looking for an experienced **Test Automation Developer** to strengthen our 9LV Combat Management System (CMS) testing function in Tampere.

**Your role**

As a **_Lead Test Automation Developer,_** you would be responsible for maintaining and developing Robot Framework adaptation for Saab 9LV CMS in Finland.

As a Lead Developer, you would steer, coach and educate other test automation engineers in developing and maintaining the framework adaptation. You would also educate and coach test engineers in writing high-quality, maintainable test cases and test suites.

Through your contribution, you would enable test engineers and other test automation developers to produce maintainable and understandable automated test cases for 9LV CMS. You could also occasionally contribute to test case development in new areas.

The 9LV CMS test automation framework is a joint global initiative, and you would communicate and exchange ideas with test automation colleagues at other Saab sites. The 9LV CMS department in Tampere is a part of broader international Naval Combat Systems organization, and you would work with international colleagues across other Saab sites. Despite the global organization, this role does not involve recurring travel.

You understand the value of dashboards and real-time reporting, so you would also participate in the design and potentially the development of dashboards and utilities. Together with the teams Technical Product Owner, you would ensure that the test automation backlog is well maintained and in good shape.

**Your profile**

**To be successful in this role, you should have:**

- Strong Python programming skills

- Solid hands-on experience with Robot Framework

- Experience developing and maintaining large-scale test automation frameworks

- Good understanding of test automation architecture, reusable design patterns, and

- maintainable test development

- Experience with Ubuntu Linux, command-line tools, and scripting

- Practical experience with Docker and containerized test environments

- Experience with Grafana or similar reporting and visualization platforms

- Knowledge of dashboard design, test metrics, and real-time reporting

- Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices

- Understanding of test strategy, quality engineering principles, and automation best practices

- Fluent in Finnish and English


**_The following would be considered strong assets:_**

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing

- Experience with test environment orchestration and automation infrastructure

- Knowledge of AI-assisted test automation and modern testing approaches

- Experience working with complex, distributed, or mission-critical systems

- Previous experience leading technical initiatives, driving framework evolution


**If the description above sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!**

In this job, some of your tasks have a connection to defense secrecy. Therefore, a drug test andapproved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance act 726/2014 is required for the selected applicant.

**What you will be part of**

_Behind our innovations stand the people who make them possible. Brave pioneers and curiousminds. Everyday heroes and inventive troubleshooters. Those who share deep knowledge and those who explore sky-high. And everyone in between._

Joining us means making an impact together, contributing in our own unique ways. From craftingcomplex code and building impressive defense and security solutions to simply sharing a coffee with a colleague, every action counts. We encourage you to take on challenges, to create smartinventions and grow in our friendly and tech-savvy workspace. We have a solid mission to keeppeople and society safe.

Teamwork is our strength. In fact, without it, we wouldn't have come this far. Join us and be part of a friendly, sharp and supportive workforce guided by common goals. But for us, it's more than just reaching our destination. It's about how we navigate the path together; with respect, thoughtfulness and always a bit of fun. Welcome to a workplace where your voice will be heard and where you feel safe to be your true self.

Your workplace will be at Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere downtown in newly renovatedpremises.

We highly value work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and the possibility ofpartial remote work.

On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer you a goodbenefit package, including full lunch benefit, exercise & culture benefit, transport related options,and many more.

The salary range for this position is €5 000 – €6 000 per month, depending on experience andqualifications.

We hope to have you as part of our team as soon as possible but preferably not later thanSeptember 2026.

**Interested?**

Take your chance to build your future career at Saab by submitting your CV and application letter viaSaab Careers already now!

jobs.title: Kerroshoidon vuoropäällikkö, Wilderness Hotels, talvikausi 2026-2027
jobs.description:
Wilderness Hotels on perheyritys, jolla on kahdeksan upeaa lomakohdetta pohjoisimmassa Lapissa. Hotellit sijaitsevat luonnon kauneimmissa paikoissa: järvien ja jokien rannoilla, kaukana valosaasteesta ja kiireisestä kaupunkielämästä.

Haemme nyt kerroshoidon vuorovastaavaa talvikaudelle 2026–2027.

Kerroshoidon vuorovastaavana olet kerroshoidon tiimin tärkeä tuki ja huolehdit siitä, että päivittäinen työ sujuu tehokkaasti ja hotellin siisteystaso pysyy korkeana. Johdat vuoroa omalla esimerkilläsi, koordinoit päivittäisiä työtehtäviä ja tuet tiimiäsi onnistumaan myös kiireisimpinä päivinä.

Työ on käytännönläheinen yhdistelmä kerroshoidon päivittäisiä työtehtäviä, laadunvalvontaa ja tiimin tukemista. Teet itse aktiivisesti työtä yhdessä muun kerroshoidon tiimin kanssa, mutta samalla kannat vastuuta siitä, että työtehtävät tulevat hoidetuksi suunnitellusti ja asiakkaiden odotukset täyttyvästi. Wilderness Hotelsin kohteissa työyhteisö on tiivis: hotellikohtaisesti työntekijöitä on noin 30–70, joten eri osastojen yhteistyö näkyy aidosti arjessa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta kerroshoidon tai siivouspalveluiden tehtävistä

- Kokemusta tiimin ohjaamisesta tai vuorovastaavan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Please notice that in this position Finnish language skill is required.

- Reipasta, vastuullista ja motivoitunutta otetta työhön

- Kykyä ottaa vuorossa johtavaa roolia ja toimia esimerkkinä muulle tiimille

- Tarkkaa silmää siisteydelle ja yksityiskohdille

- Kykyä säilyttää rauhallinen ja määrätietoinen ote myös kiireisissä tilanteissa

- Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja joustavuutta

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Määräaikaisen työsuhteen talvikaudelle 2026–2027

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työn kansainvälisessä hotelliyrityksessä

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää esihenkilö- ja kerroshoidonosaamistasi

- Ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen ja perehdytyksen tehtävään

- Kansainvälisen työympäristön, jossa jokaisella työntekijällä on tärkeä rooli asiakaskokemuksen rakentamisessa

- Henkilökuntamajoituksen tarvittaessa

- Mahdollisuuden nauttia Lapin luonnosta ja monipuolisista ulkoilumahdollisuuksista vapaa-ajalla

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos olet kokenut ja vastuullinen kerroshoidon ammattilainen, nautit käytännön tekemisestä ja haluat ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallasi, tässä voi olla sinulle oikea paikka.
Lähetä meille hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi aikaisemmasta kerroshoidon kokemuksestasi sekä mahdollisesta kokemuksestasi tiimin ohjaamisesta tai esihenkilötehtävistä.

Køkkenchef til stort produktionskøkken i Kolding – er du klar til dit næste ledelsesmæssige skridt?
jobs.description:
Du har måske allerede et godt job. Men savner du større ansvar, mere indflydelse og muligheden for virkelig at sætte dit præg på en køkkendrift?

FLAIR søger en erfaren køkkenchef til en veletableret, landsdækkende virksomhed inden for catering og kantinedrift. Du bliver ansvarlig for virksomhedens store site i Kolding og får det samlede daglige ansvar for mennesker, kvalitet, økonomi og drift.

Det her er ikke kun et job for dig, der brænder for god mad. Det er i høj grad en lederstilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe struktur, udvikle mennesker og få en større produktion til at spille – hver eneste dag.

I dag produceres der omkring 1.000 kuverter dagligt, men køkkenet har kapacitet til op mod 4.000 kuverter. Der er derfor både størrelse, ambitioner og masser af udviklingspotentiale i rollen.

Du får et køkken – men først og fremmest et ledelsesansvar

Som køkkenchef får du ansvaret for den daglige drift og bliver den leder, medarbejderne kan mærke i hverdagen.

Du skal skabe retning, overblik og struktur og samtidig sikre, at kvalitet, økonomi, bemanding og produktion hænger sammen.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Daglig ledelse, motivation og udvikling af medarbejderne

  • Planlægning af produktion, bemanding, vagtplaner og arbejdsgange

  • At skabe et effektivt flow gennem hele produktionen

  • Budgetter og opfølgning på blandt andet vare- og personaleforbrug

  • Kvalitetssikring, egenkontrol og ensartede standarder

  • Udvikling og optimering af procedurer og arbejdsprocesser

  • At skabe en stærk kultur med tydelig ledelse, samarbejde og ordentlighed

Du får med andre ord mandat til at lede – og mulighed for at sætte dit eget aftryk på både driften, teamet og den videre udvikling.

Måske sidder du allerede godt – men er klar til mere?

Vi leder ikke kun efter dig, der aktivt søger nyt job.

Måske er du køkkenchef, kantinechef, produktionsleder eller har en anden ledende rolle inden for storkøkken, catering eller fødevareproduktion – og egentlig sidder godt, hvor du er.

Men måske er du også nået til et sted, hvor du er klar til en større udfordring.

Et sted, hvor din erfaring bliver brugt. Hvor du får reel indflydelse. Hvor ledelse fylder lige så meget som det køkkenfaglige. Og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle både mennesker og drift.

Så kan denne mulighed være værd at høre mere om.

Hvem leder vi efter?

Din nuværende titel er ikke det afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaringen og lysten til at stå i spidsen for en større drift.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med personaleledelse og er en tydelig og nærværende leder

  • Har erfaring fra fx frokostproduktion, catering, kantine, storkøkken eller anden større fødevareproduktion

  • Forstår økonomien bag en professionel køkkendrift

  • Kan arbejde med budgetter, nøgletal, vareforbrug og bemanding

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe beslutninger, når tempoet er højt

  • Har blik for både kvalitet, effektivitet og mennesker

  • Motiveres af at udvikle medarbejdere og skabe et stærkt hold omkring dig

Har du lederuddannelse eller relevante lederkurser, er det en fordel – men din praktiske ledelseserfaring vejer tungt.

Et lederjob med plads til et liv ved siden af

En attraktiv del af stillingen er arbejdstiden.

Du får en 37-timers stilling med primært dagarbejde, samtidig med at du får en spændende og ansvarsfuld lederrolle.

Derudover får du:

  • Stor selvstændighed og reel indflydelse

  • Ansvar for en produktion med betydeligt vækstpotentiale

  • Grundig onboarding og sparring med erfarne kolleger

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke

  • Mulighed for bonus og overskudsdeling

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og ledelsesmæssig udvikling

  • En virksomhed, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ordentlighed vægtes højt

Nysgerrig – også selvom du ikke søger nyt?

Du behøver ikke have besluttet dig for at skifte job for at tage en snak med os.

FLAIR varetager rekrutteringen, og vi tager meget gerne en fortrolig og uforpligtende dialog om stillingen og om rollen kunne være det rigtige næste skridt for dig.

Arbejdssted: Kolding
Arbejdstid: 37 timer – primært dagarbejde
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette profil.

jobs.title: Redovisningskonsult – föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder
jobs.description:
Rantalainen är Finlands ledande och snabbväxande expertorganisation inom ekonomi- och löneadministrativa tjänster. Vi finns på över 100 kontor i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Vi erbjuder företag i alla storlekar ett brett utbud av tjänster inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, HR samt företagsbeskattning för att stötta deras affärsverksamhet och framgång. Våra närmare 45 000 kundföretag har tillgång till kompetensen hos över 2 700 experter. Läs mer om oss på vår webbplats här [https://www.rantalainen.fi/sv/].



Vi söker nu en redovisningskonsult för ett föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder i Västra Nyland!



I denna roll arbetar du med ett konsultativt arbetssätt med våra kundföretags bokföring, bokslut och andra uppgifter inom ekonomiförvaltning. Du har regelbunden kontakt med dina kunder och använder din expertis för att omvandla ekonomiska siffror till beslutsunderlag samt bidra till utvecklingen av våra kunders verksamhet ur ett ekonomiskt perspektiv.

Du får planera och genomföra ditt arbete självständigt, men har alltid stöd av ditt eget team och hela vår breda expertorganisation. Som stöd i arbetet har du ett glatt och hjälpsamt team samt din närmaste chef.



Teamets bas finns på Rantalainens kontor på Kimitoön och vi hoppas att du har möjlighet att arbeta där vid behov, särskilt under den inledande introduktionsperioden. I övrigt kan du delvis arbeta på distans enligt dina önskemål. Tjänsten är ett tidsbegränsat föräldraledighetsvikariat med en beräknad anställningstid från 1.10.2026 – 31.10.2027.



Vad erbjuder Rantalainen dig?

På Rantalainen erbjuder vi dig en intressant och ansvarsfull roll på Finlands ledande redovisningsbyrå inom en spännande bransch. Hos oss får du stöd av en kunnig organisation, goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och moderna arbetsverktyg. Som en flexibel arbetsgivare ger vi dig friheten att planera ditt eget arbete, flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete, så att det blir enklare att kombinera arbetet med övriga delar av livet.

Vår ambition är att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, både idag och i framtiden. På Rantalainen värdesätts varje medarbetare för den hen är, och hos oss får du en trivsam arbetsmiljö och en rättvis värdegrund. Vi satsar på ett kvalitativt ledarskap och goda karriärmöjligheter inom företaget.



Läs mer om våra omfattande personalförmåner och om Rantalainen som arbetsgivare på vår webbplats. Du kan också kolla Markus medarbetarberättelse och läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss som redovisningskonsult.



Det här hoppas vi att du har med dig?

Vi hoppas att du har en utbildning inom ekonomiförvaltning och erfarenhet av arbete inom området. Att upprätta bokslut är välbekant för dig, och du behärskar helheten inom ekonomiförvaltning samt arbetar självständigt. Du arbetar smidigt med kunder, och därför förutsätter vi att du kan arbeta på både svenska och finska. Kunskaper i engelska räknas till fördel.



Vi värdesätter erfarenhet av olika programvaror inom ekonomiförvaltning samt en vilja att lära dig nya system. Till dessa erbjuder vi naturligtvis en grundlig introduktion. Hos oss får du möjlighet att upprätthålla och utveckla din kompetens genom mångsidiga och kontinuerliga utbildningar.



Vänligen ansök så snart som möjligt, dock senast 6.9.2026. Vi behandlar ansökningar redan under ansökningstiden och fattar beslut så snart en lämplig person hittas. Vänta alltså inte till sista ansökningsdagen. Vi kontrollerar kreditupplysningar för den person som väljs i slutet av rekryteringsprocessen. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar per e-post.



Om du vill höra mer om tjänsten eller ditt framtida team berättar Business Director Joakim Lindfors gärna mer (010 321 6801).

Le poste :

Au sein de l'équipe Sécurité & Identité (IAM / CIAM), vous serez responsable de la conception, de la personnalisation et de l'intégration de la solution d'authentification et de gestion des accès Keycloak. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'implémentation de parcours d'authentification sécurisés (MFA) et le développement de modules Java sur mesure.

Missions Principales
- Développement & Personnalisation Keycloak : Développement de SPI (Service Provider Interfaces), d'authentificateurs personnalisés, d'évènements et d'extensions en Java / Jakarta EE.
- Authentification & MFA : Configuration, personnalisation et intégration de flux d'authentification forte (MFA, WebAuthn, TOTP, SMS, OTP) et gestion des politiques de sécurité.
- Intégration IAM / CIAM : Configuration des Realms, des clients (OpenID Connect / OAuth2, SAML v2) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, Identity Providers externes).
- Personnalisation UI/UX : Adaptation des thèmes de connexion et du parcours utilisateur (Freemarker, HTML/CSS, JavaScript).

MCO :
- Maintien en condition opérationnelle
- Montées de version Keycloak
- Écriture de tests et intégration dans les pipelines CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm).

Compétences techniques obligatoires :
Java 11+ / Jakarta EE : Développement d'extensions / SPI pour Keycloak.
Keycloak (Core) : Maîtrise des concepts d'Authentication Flows, Execution Steps, SPI (Authenticator, EventListenerProvider, UserStorageProvider).
Sécurité & MFA : Implémentation du MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, OTP personnalisés).

Les plus appréciés : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Operator, Quarkus.

Profil recherché :

Profil Recherché
Expérience : Développeur Java avec au moins 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dédiée sur Keycloak.

jobs.title: Gulvsliber / Floor sanding specialist
jobs.description:
SEE ENGLSIH VERSION BELOW

GulvKanonen ApS arbejder med gulvafslibning og efterbehandling af trægulve. Vi udfører mange forskellige gulvopgaver for privatekunder, og derfor sørger vi nu en ny gulvmand til vores team af dygtige medarbejdere.

Har du erfaring som gulvsliber og ønsker at arbejde i en tempofyldt virksomhed? Så er dette job lige noget for dig!

Om jobbet:

Hos GulvKanonen kommer du til at arbejder med afslibning, polering og efterbehandling af trægulve (normale efterbehandlinger , som lak, lud, olie og sæbe)

Du får stillet firmabil til rådighed og kommer typisk til at køre alene. Alle opgaver er hos private kunder og af forskellige karakter. Derfor kommer du heller ikke til at arbejde med de samme opgaver hver eneste dag.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har minimum 2 års erfaring inden for gulvafslibning

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt

  • Arbejdstiden er i tidsrummet 07.00-15.00

  • Har kørekort B

  • Er serviceminded og pålidelig

  • Sætter en ære i flor og veludført arbejde

Vi tilbyder:

  • God fast løn

  • Frihed under ansvar

  • En god arbejdsplads

  • Firmabil til arbejdsbrug

  • Maskiner og værktøj til arbejdsopgaver

  • Arbejdstøj

Lyder stillingen som gulvsliber interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail info@gulvkanonen.dk

Send din ansøgning og dit cv på mail og skriv "Gulvsliber" i emnefeltet. Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

 

ENGLISH

GulvKanoen ApS works with floor sanding and finishing of wooden floors. We perform many different floor jobs for private customers, and we are now looking for a new floor sanding specialist for our team of skillede employees.

Do you have experience with floor sanding and would like to work in a busy company? Then this is the job for you!

About the job:

At GulvKanonen, you will be working with floor sanding and finishing of wooden floors (standard finishing, such as varnish, lye, oil, and soap).

A company car will be provided for you, and you will typically be driving on your own. Alle jobs take place at privat customers,, and the jobs vary much so you will not be experiencing the same jobs day after day.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least 2 years of experience with floor sanding

  • Can work independently, structured, and efficiently

  • Working hours are from 07.00-15.00

  • Have driving licence B

  • Are service-minded and dependable

  • Take pride in well-performed results

We offer:

  • A good, fixed salary

  • Freedom with reponsibility

  • A good workplace

  • Company car (work-related driving)

  • Machines and tools for all tasks

  • Work clothes

Send you application and your resume via mail and write "Floor sanding specialist" in the subject line. Interviews are conducted regularly with hiring as soon as possible.

jobs.description:

Sotavuoroja eniten lauantaisin klo 10.30-13.00 ja 14.00-16.30 sekä kuplafutiksia näihin sovitellen. Jonkin verran vuoroja perjantaisin etupäässä iltapäivä/ilta sekä lasten synttäreitä pyritään myymään arki-iltoihin. Lisäksi lähinnä syksyllä ja keväällä koululuokkia ja yritysryhmiä koulu-/toimistoaikaan, mutta tarvittaessa muut vetäjät ja yrittäjä hoitavat nämä. Hakemukset ensisijaisesti soittamalla 0505787877 ja sähköpostiin tuure@assapaintball.fi voit halutessasi lähettää etukäteistietoja liittyen esim. koulutus, urheilutausta, työkokemus, harrastukset tms., mutta ymmärrä oikeutesi eli esim. harrastukset, urheilutausta ynnä muu vastaava "henkilökohtainen" eivät ole työnantajan asia elleivät ne sitten lisää hakijan pätevyyttä tai kiinnostavuutta työnantajan näkökulmasta juuri tässä työssä, jossa peluutetaan ja tuomaroidaan ryhmiä joukkuelajin parissa.

jobs.title: We are looking for a new Marketing Performance Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning data into decisions and insights into growth? Do you enjoy uncovering what drives marketing performance and using analytics to optimize results across channels and markets? If so, you might be the Marketing Performance Analyst we are looking for.

We are seeking a curious, analytical, and commercially minded professional who thrives at the intersection of marketing, technology, and data. You are naturally driven by numbers, but you also understand the business stories behind them. You enjoy creating meaningful reports, and helping teams make smarter decisions based on facts rather than assumptions.

In this role, you will become a key contributor to our international marketing team, helping us improve campaign performance, strengthen our digital presence, and maximize the return on our marketing investments. You will work closely with colleagues across marketing and sales with transforming complex data into clear insights that create real business value.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Campaign and communication optimization: Monitor, testing and optimizing daily performance metrics across all marketing channels (organic and paid search, social media, newsletters and other relevant channels)
  • Data management: Clean, organize, and synthesize large marketing datasets from multiple platforms
  • Reporting & dashboards: Design and maintain automated performance dashboards using BI tools. ROI calculations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Translate technical data into clear insights for actionable ideas for growth and improvement
  • Segmentation: Develop target audiences and personalization of customer communications
  • Analysis; Identifying low performance conversions and evaluate A/B tests.
  • Budget allocation: Recommend strategic budget shifts toward high-performing audience segments and assist in finding new growth opportunities.
  • Teamwork & cooperation; Participate in planning and execution of marketing activities, marketing automations and tasks. Always focusing on growth and improving results.

Required qualifications and background

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Statistics, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related work experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in marketing analytics, digital marketing, or business intelligence.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Microsoft Excel, CRM and Google Analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Salesforce Marketing, or similar platforms.
  • Proven ability to build dashboards in Looker Studio, or BI-system.
  • Strong understanding of core metrics like ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversions etc.
  • Experience with advanced data modeling, setting up multi-touch attribution frameworks.
  • Certifications in Google Analytics and major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta).

  • Position in a growing international company, headquartered in Norway.
  • Terms according to experience and competence

jobs.title: Projektipäällikkö
jobs.description:
Oletko kokenut rakennuttamisen ammattilainen, joka haluaa olla mukana kehittämässä erityisryhmien asumista Helsingissä?
Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) hakee nyt projektipäällikköä vakituiseen tehtävään erityisryhmäkiinteistöjen pariin.
Hekalla on yli 55 000 asuntoa sekä yli 3 000 erityisryhmäasuntoa 45 kiinteistössä eri puolilla Helsinkiä. Rakennamme uutta ja peruskorjaamme olemassa olevaa asuntokantaa eri puolilla kaupunkia.
Helsingin kaupungin asuntotuotanto (Att) rakennuttaa Hekalle uudiskohteet ja laajat peruskorjaukset. Tehtävässä toimit tilaajan edustajana ja vastaat erityisryhmäkohteiden uudisrakentamis- ja korjausrakentamishankkeiden toteutuksen ohjauksesta Hekan tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Lisäksi erityisryhmäasumisen hankkeisiin liittyy omia erityispiirteitä ja korjauskokonaisuuksia. Haemme nyt kokenutta projektipäällikköä tähän keskeiseen rooliin.
Projektipäällikkönä vastaat projektiesi etenemisestä suunnitteluvaiheesta toteutukseen sekä hankkeiden valmistumisen seurantaan ja vastaten takuuvaiheen tehtävistä. Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa ja varmistat, että hankkeet etenevät tavoitteiden mukaisesti.
Lähimmät työkaverisi ovat tiimissäsi tällä hetkellä neljä projektipäällikköä sekä rakennuttamispäällikkö, joka toimii esihenkilönäsi. Tehtävä on uusi, joten pääset myös vaikuttamaan sen sisältöön. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä erityisryhmäkiinteistöistä vastaavan yksikönpäällikön ja kiinteistöpäälliköiden sekä Hekan muun henkilöstön ja ulkoisten yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa.
Tyypillisiä tehtäviäsi ovat:
- Projektien suunnittelu, aikataulutus ja koordinointi
- Hankkeiden talouden ja aikataulujen seuranta
- Rakennuttajakumppanin ohjaaminen ja valvonta
- Yhteistyö sisäisten yksiköiden, urakoitsijoiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa
- Projektien raportointi ja dokumentointi
- Toiminnan ja prosessien kehittäminen

Odotamme sinulta:
- Soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa
- Usean vuoden kokemusta projektinhallinnasta (esim. rakennuttaminen, kiinteistöt, julkinen sektori tai kehittämishankkeet)
- Usean vuoden kokemusta rakennuttamisesta, laajoista peruskorjauksista ja erityisryhmien ARA/Varke-tuotannosta
- Kokemusta viranomaisyhteistyöstä sekä ymmärrystä julkisen rakentamisen prosesseista
- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa (muu kielitaito on eduksi)
- Hankekokonaisuuksien hallintaa ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja haastavan työn, jossa on mahdollisuus ammattitaidon kehittämiseen. Meillä on hyvät työsuhde-edut, kuten lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaedut. Työskentelemme hybridityön mallilla ja käytössämme on liukuva työaika.
Palkkaus ja muut työsuhteen ehdot määräytyvät KT:n yrityssektorin yleisen työehtosopimuksen (YTES) mukaan. Tässä tehtävässä aloittavan henkilön vähimmäisperuspalkka on 4012,28 €/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan kokemuslisää, jos työntekijällä on vähintään 5 vuotta kokemuslisään oikeuttavaa työkokemusta. Kokemuslisän suuruus on 5 % / 5 kokemusvuotta ja 10 % / 10 kokemusvuotta. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Lisätietoja antaa rakennuttamispäällikkö Mika Huuhtanen: 14.8 klo 9–11, 20.8. klo 12–14 ja 27.8. klo 15–17 numerossa 09- 5767 4097. Jätä hakemuksesi viimeistään 30.8.2026. Pidämme ensimmäisen kierroksen haastattelut alustavasti viikolla 37 ja 38. Työn aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan, mielellään lokakuussa.
Arvostamme, jos kerrot hakemuksessasi, miksi olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään juuri Hekalla. Täytä sähköinen hakulomake ja tule mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä! Jätä hakemuksesi Hae paikkaa -linkin kautta.

Hekassa työskentelee lähes 700 asumisen ammattilaista. Suurimmat henkilöstöryhmämme ovat kiinteistöhuolto ja siivous. Heka on savuton työpaikka.

Arvostamme työyhteisön monimuotoisuutta, ja edistämme yhdenvertaisuutta suunnitelmallisesti ja tavoitteellisesti. Kannustamme monenlaisista taustoista tulevia hakemaan meille töihin.

jobs.title: Incorporating distribution grids in multiscale stochastic energy system models
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0Background - PhD Candidate at FME SecurEL – Incorporating distribution grids in multiscale stochastic energy system models  

There is a temporary PhD position for 3 years available at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management – Section Health, Safety and Environmental Management. The position is resident at NTNUs campus in Trondheim. This is an educational position, which will provide promising research recruits the opportunity for professional development through studies towards a PhD-degree. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management and the faculty will be your employer.

The PhD position will be part of FME SecurEL. The Centre will facilitate a secure, resilient, and sustainable electricity distribution grid that ensures both the security of electricity supply and a path to a net-zero-emissions society. See https://securel.no/ 


About the centre

The PhD position will be part of FME SecurEL. The Centre will facilitate a secure, resilient, and sustainable electricity distribution grid that ensures both the security of electricity supply and a path to a net-zero-emissions society. See https://securel.no/ 

SecurEL is a Centre for Environment-friendly Energy Research, facilitating a secure, resilient, and sustainable electricity distribution grid that ensures both the security of electricity supply and a path to a net-zero-emissions society. SecurEL aims to develop new knowledge addressing research challenges arising from accelerated electrification and increased use of the existing grid. Reaching these goals requires strong interdisciplinary collaboration among research institutions, user partners, and experts with diverse areas of expertise.

The Centre brings together experts from fields such as electrical engineering, energy systems, information and communication technology, cybersecurity, engineering cybernetics, industrial economics, as well as humanities and social sciences, to develop effective solutions for the power grid. SecurEL is a consortium of 42 partners, including 7 research partners. The centre period is 2025-2032, and the total budget is 398 million Norwegian kroner (NOK). NTNU is represented as a partner mainly by the Department of Electric Energy (IEL) and the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT).

Recruitment and research education is an important part of the mission of SecurEL. The PhD candidates funded by the Centre will contribute with cutting-edge knowledge and research. Overall, the Centre will directly finance 17 PhD and postdoc positions, and also have several associated PhDs from closely related projects. As a SecurEL-funded PhD candidate, you will be employed by NTNU, a university partner in the Centre, and take active part in the research activities. Through the Centre, you will have access to a forum with other PhD candidates affiliated with the Centre, and opportunities for research stays with partners, both nationally and abroad, through its international network.

Read more about the Centre and its research at the website https://www.securel.no/.   


About the position

Energy system models are widely used by researchers and analysts for investigating how policies and technology developments may impact our energy futures. These models often cover large geographical areas, several energy carriers and sometimes also multiple time scales. Therefore, it is unavoidable to make trade-offs between modelling detail and computational efficiency/tractability. Local energy resources and demands are typically aggregated to country-level, while local constraints, such as distribution grids, are usually not considered at all. However, with the changing energy landscape with increasing focus on distributed assets and flexibility, the role of the power grid, and more directly the distribution grid, becomes more critical. To account for the changes seen in the power grid in long-term investment planning, we need to understand how the development of power grid impacts the long-term investments and operation of the whole energy system.    

Therefore, this PhD will contribute to the field by exploring new methods and modelling frameworks for inclusion of power grids, with a focus on distribution grids and distributed resources in multiscale energy system models with a special focus on capturing security of supply aspects of the distribution grid in the energy system modelling. The models may be multiscale in the time dimension including for example investments (years), operations (hours) and balancing (minutes). The models may also be multiscale in the geographical resolution by representing the spatial location as a country (Norway), while other locations are modelled in detail with physical location of distributed generation and grids.  The modeling framework should be stochastic to represent variations in demand and renewable generation.  

Methodologically, the project will be based on novel models and decomposition methods for multiscale stochastic problems. Examples of relevant methods may be Stochastic Dual Dynamic Programming, Alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) composition and similar decomposition approaches. We are searching for candidates that have interest both in energy systems and power system modeling, and that are familiarized with optimization methods.   

The project will be a cooperation between NTNU, SINTEF, IFE as well as the industrial partnership of the FME SecurEL.  

You will report to your supervisor. 


Duties of the position
  • Execute a PhD project within 3 years (including obtaining own data for research, analysis and dissemination). 
  • Plan and execute the empirical work and data collection targeted to address the research objectives. 
  • Complete the necessary doctoral coursework as per NTNU’s guidelines.
  • Attend project meetings and develop a collaboration network with project partners.
  • Disseminate research findings through national/international academic conferences and open access scientific journals that meet the requirements for the PhD position.

Required selection criteria
  • The PhD-position's main objective is to qualify for work in research positions. The qualification requirement is completion of a master’s degree or second degree (equivalent to 120 credits) in operations research and optimization or equivalent education. Applicants should have a strong academic background with a grade of B or better in terms of NTNU’s grading scale. Applicants with no letter grades from previous studies must have an equally good academic foundation.  
  • The position requires excellent English oral and writing skills. 

Preferred selection criteria

In addition, the following qualifications will contribute positively to the evaluation of the applicant:

  • Background and/or experience relevant to the project topic  
  • Scandinavian language skills
  • Documented experience with stochastic optimization
  • Documented experience with energy system analysis 
  • Good knowledge of digital tools like Julia, Python, etc.  

Personal characteristics
  • A high level of personal responsibility and initiative
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in accordance with the project objectives
  • Ability to work in interdisciplinary projects and teams
  • Suitable candidates should have good communication skills, be flexible and solution-oriented

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, in terms of the qualification requirements specified in the advertisement.


We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment 
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • As a public employee, you have favourable benefits as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

You will be employed as a PhD Candidate at NTNU and will have access to employee benefits and discounts. 

Information about Working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: http://www.nyinorge.no/en/Ny-i-Norge-velg-sprak/New-in-Norway/


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

PhD candidates are remunerated in code 1017, at gross NOK 536.200,- per annum before tax. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period. Your work place will be at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)for general criteria for the position.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.
As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

The position is subject to external funding.
For the necessary academic and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.


About the application

The application and supporting documentation to be used as the basis for the assessment must be in English. Publications and other scientific work must follow the application. Please note that your application will be considered based solely on information submitted by the application deadline. You must therefore ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experience fulfil the criteria specified above. Incomplete applications will not be considered. 

1)    Application letter concerning your motivation for completing a PhD
2)    A CV with information on education, previous research experience, together with authorized documentation of certificates and study records. 
3)    Academic work (not master thesis). Joint work will be evaluated. If it is difficult to identify the contributions from individuals in a joint piece of work, applicants should enclose a short descriptive summary of what she/he contributed to the work. 
4)    Name and address of three references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI). 

If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well. 
In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates. 

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

Please submit your application electronically via jobbnorge.no with your CV, diplomas and certificates. Applications submitted elsewhere will not be considered.


General information

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the innovation capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

Questions about the position can be directed to Professor Asgeir Tomasgard email Asgeir.tomasgard@ntnu.no or phone + 47 930 58 771.  If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Hilde Selli Egelie, e-mail: hilde.s.egelie@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 30.08.2026

Our goal is sustainable creation of value within technology-based areas in industry, business and the public sector in Norway. We have academic groups in Trondheim and Gjøvik. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Trustworthy GenAI-assisted Software Engineering
jobs.description:
The Department of Computer science, Electrical engineering and Mathematical sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) has an open position as a post-doctoral researcher within trustworthy GenAI-assisted software engineering.

The position is for a period of up to 3 years and associated with the strategically funded TERSE project.

Workplace is campus Bergen.
 

Project and duties of the position
The TERSE project aims to develop actionable methods, guidelines and software tools for enhancing
software engineering with the application of GenAI; and to explore how profession-oriented education and
curricula in software engineering should be transformed in light the emerging GenAI era. A central element
of the project is collaboration with industry, public sector institutions and international partners aimed to
investigate the real-world effects of GenAI in software engineering.


Software technology and engineering are key enablers in the ongoing digital transformation of society.
GenAI has emerged as a disruptive technology not only within a multitude of sectors profoundly impacting
the way we will work in the future, but also within the profession of software engineering itself where code
is increasingly being automatically produced by GenAI-based coding co-pilots and agents. Considering the
pivotal and increasingly critical role of software in society, the prospect of such a disruptive change raises
fundamental questions on the feasibility and risks associated with the application of GenAI, and on how the
future profession of software engineers will change.


The postdoctoral researcher will work closely with the four work package leaders of the TERSE project on
coordinated industry collaboration enabling longitudinal and empirical studies of GenAI, and on developing
and evaluating methods and software technology to detect, prevent, and mitigate faults in GenAI-generated
software. Key research questions to be addressed include: what measurable productivity and software
quality effects occur when applying GenAI in software engineering processes; how to develop and apply
software engineering tools which make AI-assisted development dependable; what are best practices and
methodology for trustworthy application of GenAI-based software tools and technology; and how to
integrate GenAI in software engineering education.


Research environment

The postdoctoral researcher will be a key researcher in the TERSE project and part of the software engineering research group at HVL https://www.hvl.no/en/research/group/software-engineering/ . The  research group currently include 10 professors and associate professors, 12 postdoctoral  researchers and PhD candidates, and a large number of master students in software engineering and 
in applied computer science. The software engineering research group is conducting high-quality  research presented at international venues, and has broad scientific expertise including empirical  software engineering, model- based software engineering, and formal methods for software  engineering. The research group has a strong track record of externally funded projects with  national and international industry and with academic partners. This includes projects within cloud  computing and services, internet-of-things, business process modelling, AI, machine learning,  collaborative systems, and security spanning domains such as healthcare services, marine  environments, robotics, industrial automation and emergency work. The postdoctoral research fellow will be provided with work expense funding that can be used forconference participation, travel and research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is 
Campus Bergen.
 


Qualifications

The successful applicant must have earned a PhD degree in informatics/computer science/software engineering or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded before the candidate can be offered the position. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within software engineering, and preferably include the application of generative AI and machine learning in software engineering or software engineering for AI. In addition to the required educational background and scientific profile, the following criteria will be assessed in the ranking of qualified candidates:

  • Quality and relevance of the PhD thesis
  • Publication and project acquisition track record, quality and relevance of publications
  • Practical software engineering skills, including experience with generative AI in software development or the engineering of software for AI solutions
  • Research network, industrial work experience and/or experience from industrial collaboration
  • Ability to work in the intersection of theoretical, applied, and empirical research
  • Teaching experience and interest in curriculum development in software engineering education
  • Ability to collaborate, engage in writing funding applications, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research work, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Dissemination capacity, oral and written communication skills in English (or in Norwegian) 

 

The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter, including a statement of motivation, description of relevance of research profile in relation to the position and summary of scientific work and industry experience
  • A CV, including publication list,
  • Up to five selected publications
  • Copies of educational certificates, transcript of academic records
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number) 

Applicants will in addition be assessed in relation to their prospective starting date.

 

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. If the documents submitted are not in English or in a Scandinavian language, the applicants must submit the corresponding certified translations.

 


Application procedure

Submit your application and CV by clicking on the button marked "søk stillingen" on this page.

Please note that applications will be assessed based on the information submitted to www.jobbnorge.no by the application deadline. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all relevant attachments are submitted by the deadline, including: 

Applicants with a degree from a country other than Norway, need to attach a certified translation of the diploma and transcripts of grades to English or a Scandinavian language, in addition to the original documents, if the original is not in any of these languages. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applications will be sent electronically to an expert committee. Based on the committee's recommendation, suitable applicants will be invited for an interview.

Applications cannot be sent by email to individuals at HVL.


We offer

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment
An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues
Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
Employee benefits

The position as  postdoctoral researche is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.
There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must
comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time..


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte”). Organizationalchanges and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.
 

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.
Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. 

The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected. Applicants may be called in for an interview... 


Contact

Assistant Head of Department Pål Ellingsen

E-mail: pal.ellingsen@hvl.no


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. jobs.title: Airport Service Supervisor (Rovaniemi)
jobs.description:
_Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values – Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together–guide us in everything we do._

**We are now looking for an**

**AIRPORT SERVICE SUPERVISOR**

to join our Ground Operations Service Delivery team. Based in Rovaniemi, you will support operations at one of Finnair's most strategically important stations and contribute to the safe and reliable delivery of services across our growing Lapland operation. In addition, the position supports selected North Calotte airports in Northern Finland and Norway when required.

In this role, you will act as Finnair's local representative towards ground handlers, airport operators and other operational stakeholders. You will oversee operational performance, safety, quality and compliance of ground handling services delivered on behalf of Finnair, ensuring adherence to agreed standards, processes and regulatory requirements.

This is a highly visible operational role focused on safety oversight, service quality, compliance and stakeholder cooperation in one of the most strategically significant areas of Finnair's network.

This role is based in Rovaniemi and requires continuous onsite presence at Rovaniemi airport. Work is performed during regular office hours and includes occasional travel.

**Your main responsibilities will focus on operational oversight, performance follow-up and stakeholder collaboration, including:**

- Monitoring ground handler performance, operational quality, safety performance, safety observations and training compliance at Rovaniemi and selected North Calotte airports.

- Following up local operational deviations and supporting corrective actions.

- Conducting regular operational oversight activities with particular focus on safety culture, regulatory compliance, operational risk identification and continuous improvement.

- Supporting the implementation of Finnair operational development initiatives and process improvements, while monitoring their effectiveness and compliance at station level.

- Supporting operational coordination during irregular operations and seasonal peak periods.

- Maintaining effective cooperation with ground handlers, airport operators, authorities and other local stakeholders.

- Performing operational reporting, invoice verification, administrative follow-up and quality monitoring activities.

- At least three years of experience in airline operations, airport operations, airport services or ground handling.

- Experience in operational supervision, coordination, quality monitoring or vendor/stakeholder management.

- Strong understanding of airport and ground handling operations, including both passenger-facing (above-wing) and ramp operations (below-wing), as well as applicable aviation authority requirements.

- Experience working with service providers and operational performance follow-up.

- Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured, independent and proactive approach to work.

- Willingness and ability to travel occasionally.

- Excellent Finnish and English skills, both written and spoken.


**We value:**

- A strong and proactive safety mindset, with the confidence to identify risks, challenge unsafe practices and promote a positive safety culture among operational stakeholders.

- Practical understanding of both passenger and ramp operations and their interfaces.

- Ability to influence and drive improvements without direct authority over the service provider.

- Ability to build effective relationships across organizations and locations.

- Adaptability during disruptions, irregular operations and seasonal peaks.

We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit, Epassi (sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

jobs.title: Liikennemyymälätyöntekijä ABC Tikkulaan Poriin
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Liikennemyymälätyöntekijäksi ABC Tikkulaan Poriin

Haemme liikennemyymälätyöntekijää ABC Tikkulaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan osa-aikaiseen työsuhteeseen (20 h/vko). Työtehtäväsi sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti Hesburgerin keittiön puolelle. ABC Tikkula palvelee asiakkaitaan joka päivä 24h, joten työhön kuuluu aamu-, päivä-, ilta- ja yövuoroja.Työvuorot painottuvat iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin.

Tule mukaan 24h-tiimiimme – tekemään ihan tavallisia töitä, poikkeuksellisen hyvässä porukassa!

Liikennemyymälätyöntekijänä työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia ja usein myös vauhdikkaita. Työskentelet pääasiallisesti Hesburger-keittiön puolella ruokien valmistuksen parissa, mutta tehtäviisi kuuluu myös salityöskentelyä, asiakkaiden palvelua kassalla sekä muita vaihtelevia liikennemyymälän tehtäviä. Vuoroissa varmistetaan aina myös ravintolan siisteys ja jatkuva laadukas asiakaspalvelu on kaiken tekemisen keskiössä.

Katsomme eduksiaiemman kokemuksen Hesburger-työskentelystä ja vastaavanlaisista asiakaspalvelutehtävistä. Tärkeintä meille on kuitenkin tinkimätön palveluasenne, tehokas työote sekä halu oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssä. Teemme työtä yhdessä asiakkaitamme varten – siksi tiimityöskentelytaidot sekä aito halu palvella ja onnistua yhdessä ovatkin meille erityisen tärkeitä arvoja työssä. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta täysi-ikäisyyttä ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä kaikenlaisissa vuoroissa ABC Tikkulan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

Tarjoammeihan tavallisia liikennemyymälätyöntekijän töitä - vaihtelevia ja monipuolisia työpäiviä, mukavaa työarkea ja yhteisiä onnistumisia huipputiimisi kanssa! Saat aloituksen yhteydessä hyvän perehdytyksen tehtävään ja tuemme sinua onnistumisiinpitkin matkaa.

💚 Meillä Satakunnan Osuuskaupalla sinulla on mahdollisuus osoittaa kiinnostustasi myös vastuutehtäviin ja uralla kehittymiseen sekä työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi S-ryhmän ja Satakunnan Osuuskaupan kattavat henkilöstöedut, joista voit lukea lisää täältä.

💰Liikennemyymälätyöntekijän palkka perustuu kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,51-14,08€/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus myös suoritepalkkioon.

Kiinnostuitko? Haethan paikkaa 2.9.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaaliikennemyymäläpäällikköHenna Stenius sähköpostitse henna.stenius@sok.fi tai puhelimitse 044 725 2704.

Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on paikallinen yritys, jonka omistavat satakuntalaiset asiakasomistajat. Tehtävämme on tuottaa asiakasomistajillemme palveluita ja etuja. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Olemme osa valtakunnallista S-ryhmää.

jobs.title: Engasjert Matvert
jobs.description:
Helse Bergen søker ein engasjert og dyktig matvert til teamet vårt!

Vi har ledig ein 15% fast stilling på Nordås ReHabiliteringsklinikken med turnus dag/kveld og fast arbeid kvar tredje helg.

Kandidatar kan bli innkalt til intervju undervegs i prosessen. 

Hospitaldrift leverer ikkje-medisinske tenester og produkt til kjerneverksemda som behandlar pasientar. Avdelinga har 790 engasjerte medarbeidarar, har eit breitt samansett fagmiljø og geografisk spreiing. Forbetrings- og serviceundersøking viser at me har nøgde medarbeidarar og brukarar. 

Helse Bergen har gjennom satsinga si på ernæring vedteke etablering av Spisestua. Dette er eit konsept der kjøkkenfagleg personell slutt-tilverkar maten til pasientane ute i klinikken. Målet er at kjøkkenfagleg personell skal komma i nærare kommunikasjon med pasienten for å tilpassa kvar enkelt ernæringsbehovet sitt. Hospitalsdrift Matforsyning har ansvar for matstovene som finst for fleire avdelingar.

Matstovene er open frå kl. 07.00 - 21.30 alle dagar. Her ønsker vi å tilby pasientane freistande mat i hyggelege omgjevnader. Vi ønsker å bidra til at måltidet blir eit av dagens høgdepunkt for pasientane. Matvertane tar seg av bestilling, slutt-tilverking, anretning av mat, oppvask og rydding. Per i dag er det 22 matstover.


Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Bidra med matomsorg til pasientar
  • Bestilling, tillaging og servering av måltid
  • Reinhald, oppvask og rydding
Kvalifikasjonar

  • Erfaring frå kjøkken/kantine: Tidlegare erfaring i ei liknande rolle. (søkar med fagbrev som kokk blir føretrekt)
  • Kjennskap til IK-mat: Du må ha forståing for internkontroll og kvalitetssikring i matlaging
  • Gode IT-kunnskapar: Du må vere komfortabel med bruk av dataverktøy og programvare
  • Matfagleg interesse: Du har ei sterk interesse for mat og ernæring
  • Fagbrev som kokk er ønskeleg
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Fagleg interesse og engasjement
  • Serviceinnstilt og imøtekommande
  • Trivast med å jobbe både sjølvstendig og i samarbeid med andre
  • Strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Vere fleksibel og kunne arbeide i eit hektisk miljø
  • Ha respekt for kvar enkelt pasient
  • Evne til å arbeide målretta med arbeidsoppgåvene
Vi tilbyr
  • Spennande arbeidsplass der eit av våre satsingsområde er: "MAT SOM MEDISIN"
  • Lønn i samsvar med gjeldande overeinskomst
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
