jobs.title: Kotisiivooja
jobs.description:
Etsitkö itsellesi osa-aikaista työtä? Haluatko tulla osaksi uutta ja innovatiivistä palveluyritystä, jossa helpotat asiakkaidemme arkea ja teet heidän elämästä onnellisemman? Etsitkö itsellesi mielenkiintoista työtä, jossa pystyt itse vaikuttamaan omiin työaikoihin ja yrityksen kehitykseen? Haluatko työn lisäksi myös mukavia työsuhde-etuja ja mahdollisuuden myös päästä suunnittelemaan niitä lisää? Etsimme leppoisaan porukkaamme nyt luotettavaa ja innokasta työntekijää, jolla on halu löytää oikeasti hyvä työpaikka!

Työpäiväsi koostuu pääosin kotisiivouksista tai muista kodinhoidollisista tehtävistä asiakkaidemme luona. Meidän toimintaperiaate on se, että työtä ei tehdä kiireellä ja me annamme asiakkaalle aikaa. Tarjoamme asiakkaille siis monipuolisen ja lämminhenkisen palvelukokemuksen. Yleisimpiä siivouskohteita meillä on tavanomaiset viikkosiivoukset, ikkunanpesut, muuttosiivoukset ja muut kodinhoidolliset työt mihin asiakas tarvitsee apua.

Työpäivät meillä saat itse aikatauluttaa arkisin 8-17 väliselle ajalle. Pääset myös itse suunnittelemaan omia työvuoroja, jolloin pystyt aikatauluttamaan ne paremmin vapaa-aikaasi ajatellen. Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista työntekijää ja jos olet kiinnostunut kokoaikaisesta työstä, niin siihenkin voi olla tulevaisuudessa mahdollisuus.

Perehdytämme sinut hyvin työtehtäviin ja kohteisiin ennen työskentelyn aloittamista, joten sitä ei tarvitse stressata. Olemme saaneet positiivista palautetta työntekijöiltämme meidän kattavasta ja monipuolisesta perehdytyksestä. Perehdytyksen aikana työskentelet työparin kanssa ja itsenäinen työskentely aloitetaan vasta sitten, kun olet siihen omasta mielestä valmis.

Työssä liikut autolla, joten B-ajokortti on työn kannalta pakollinen. Tarjoamme sinulle yrityksen puolesta auton ja tottakai siihen myös polttoaineet. Mikäli liikut omalla autolla, maksamme sinulle kilometrikorvaukset. Palkka me maksetaan sinulle luonnollisesti myös asiakkaiden välisistä siirtymista.

Miksi hakea meille töihin?

\-Olet illat, viikonloput ja arkipyhät vapaalla. Työ ei siis vaikuta sinun säännöllisiin harrastuksiin tai viikonlopun rientoihin.

\-Tarjoamme sinulle itsenäisen työn, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työaikoihin. Perehdytämme sinut huolella työtehtääviisi emmekä heitä ketään ns. suden suuhun.

\-Kehitämme yrityksen toimintaa kokoajan ja meillä työntekijät pääsee vaikuttamaan yrityksen tulevaisuuteen.

\-Hyvät tekijät meillä palkitaan. Sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella palkkaa ylöspäin, kun toimintatavat on hallussa.

\-Tarjoamme työntekijöille jopa 400€ liikunta, kulttuuri ja hyvinvointirahaa tunneista riippuen.

\-Yrityksellämme on mm. sup-lautoja työntekijöiden vapaassa käytössä sekä muita työsuhde-etuja!

Me olemme nuorekas oululainen yritys, joka täyttää tänä vuonna jo kymmenen vuotta. Uudistamme koko alaa monipuolisten palveluiden- ja toimintamallien kautta. Yritys on kahden oululaisen nuoren perustama ja se näkyy myös meidän työyhteisössä ja toimintatavoissa. Meillä ei oteta työtä koskaan liian vakavasti, vaikka asiakastyö tehdäänkin aina viimesen päälle. Tällä hetkellä työllistämme yhteensä vähän alle viisitoista tyytyväistä työntekijää. Palveluihimme kuuluu tällä hetkellä monipuoliset siivouspalvelut sekä erilaiset kodinhoidolliset työt asiakkaidemme luona. Meillä otetaan työntekijöiden ideat aina huomioon ja uusista ideoista palkitaan. Tässä on sinulle loistava mahdollisuus tulla osaksi yritystä, jossa pääset kehittämään myös uusia palveluita ja ideoita. Innovatiivisuus ja luovuus katsotaan meillä vain positiivisena asiana!

Aiempi kokemus kotisiivouksesta, ikkunanpesuista sekä muuttosiivouksista katsotaan eduksi. Me kuitenkin perehdytämme sinut hyvin työtehtäviin, vaikka sinulla ei olisi aiempaa kokemusta alalta!

Työn aloituksen ajankohta ja tunnit on sovittavissa. Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista työntekijää pidempään työsuhteeseen ja pystymme lisäksi tarjoamaan sinulle kesätöitä, jos pystyt silloin tekemään enemmän tunteja. Teemme valinnan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja aloitamme perehdytyksen heti, kun sopii!:)

Kysy rohkeasti lisätietoja avoimesta työpaikasta vaikka soittamalla tai sähköpostilla. Tyhmiä kysymyksiä ei ole olemassa joten antaa tulla vaan, meitä ei tarvi pelätä ja ei tämä elämä niin vakavaa ole!! :)

Voit lähettää meille vapaamuotoisen hakemuksen ja CV:n sähköpostitse, eerik.peltomaki@arvojes.fi.

Kirjoita meille myös tuntitoiveesi ja aikataulut milloin pystyisit tekemään töitä. Huomioithan, että me emme tee töitä iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työ sopii hyvin myös koulun ohelle, jos sinulla on arkisin vapaapäiviä tai lyhyempiä koulupäiviä!:)

Käy myös tutustumassa meihin somessa: Instagram, Tiktok ja Youtube: @arvojes

jobs.description:
BROLÆGGER / ANLÆGSSTRUKTØR SØGES

Kan du lide at arbejde med belægning, have kontakt med kunderne og aflevere et stykke arbejde, du kan være stolt af?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega hos A/S Karl Jensen.

Vi søger en brolægger eller anlægsstruktør til vores serviceafdeling

Du bliver en del af et hold på 8-10 dygtige kollegaer, som løser mindre og mellemstore anlægs-, belægnings- og kloakopgaver for private, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber.

Du får egen firmabil med værktøj og udstyr og vil typisk arbejde sammen med en lærling eller en kollega. Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver, men du står aldrig alene med udfordringerne. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden.

Vi går op i den sidste finish.

Når vi kører fra en opgave, skal belægningen ligge skarpt, reetableringen være i orden og pladsen være ryddet pænt op.

Kort sagt: Det gør ikke noget, hvis du mestrer kunsten at få det til at se ud, som om vi aldrig har haft en skovl i jorden.

OM JOBBET

Som brolægger eller anlægsstruktør i vores serviceafdeling får du en alsidig hverdag, hvor opgaverne skifter.

Du skal især arbejde med:

• Etablering af nye belægninger
• Reetablering af eksisterende belægninger
• Indkørsler, terrasser, fortove og mindre belægningsopgaver
• Arbejde med minigraver og relevant udstyr
• Jord- og anlægsarbejde
• Kloak- og serviceopgaver efter behov
• Kundekontakt på de enkelte opgaver

VI TILBYDER

• Fuldtidsstilling
• Egen firmabil
• God løn efter kvalifikationer
• Overenskomst med 3F
• Dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer
• Arbejde primært i og omkring Hobro
• Mulighed for kurser og faglig udvikling
• En alsidig hverdag med både belægning, anlæg og kloak
• En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

• Er brolægger, anlægsstruktør eller har solid praktisk erfaring med belægningsarbejde
• Har sans for belægning, reetablering og den færdige finish
• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver
• Trives med mindre og mellemstore projekter
• Har en god og ordentlig kontakt med kunderne
• Kan føre minigraver og bruge relevant udstyr
• Er mødestabil og ordentlig i dit arbejde
• Er en god makker for både kollegaer og lærlinge
• Har interesse for jord, kloak og anlæg
• Kan tale og forstå dansk i det daglige arbejde
• Har kørekort B – gerne B+E
• Har lyst til at lære nyt

VI UDVIKLER DIG

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag.

Har du den rigtige indstilling og lysten til faget, bygger vi gerne videre med oplæring og relevante kurser – eksempelvis kloakkurser, Vejen som arbejdsplads eller andre kurser, der passer til dig og jobbet.

PRAKTISK

Du bliver en del af vores serviceafdeling med 8-10 medarbejdere og arbejder typisk sammen med en lærling eller en kollega.

Opgaverne ligger primært i og omkring Hobro og spænder fra mindre private opgaver til opgaver for virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber.

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du den rette?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Lead engineer - mechanical design m/f (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
Overview:

In this role, the Lead Engineer (Mechanical Design) will actively participate in conceptual and detailed design of NPI (New Product Introduction), redesign and technology programs of Safran Electronics & Defense business unit and will support various Actuation Systems product lines including Power Door Opening System (PDOS), Thrust Reverser Actuation Systems (TRAS) and Highlift Flap and Slat Actuation systems.



Position: Lead Engineer (P2) - Mechanical Design



Primary Responsibilities:



o Understand system requirements, design intent, and comply with applicable design practices, aerospace standards, customer requirements and regulatory requirements.

o Contribute and implement the design and development of engineering solutions taking account of critical constraints for cost, safety, and sustainability.

o Perform trade study involving conflicting demands from engineering functions (stress, reliability, Performance).

o Carry out conceptual design and detailed design (modelling and drafting) for NPI, Technology programs and value engineering

o Apply GD&T and perform tolerance stack-up analysis for components/Sub-systems.

o Provide inputs to improve Processes, tools, methods, and products

o Design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA) and optimize the design for cost reduction, weight reduction, mistake proofing, material selection.

o Perform design failure mode and effects analyses

o Support manufacturing concessions and engineering change requests

o Self-motivated and keen to get involved in new technologies and projects and learn new skills to map out future career path.

o Actively participate in a team environment and work with customers, suppliers, and cross functional teams for product development

o Develop optimized product design by challenging existing design and ideas and by offering innovative ideas.

o Ensure design works are done in time and with the required details and quality

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Content Onboarding
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Content Onboarding team builds the systems that help customers move content into Notion, get started faster, and keep growing reliably over time. The role matters because one of Notion’s core differentiators is replacing multiple tools — and that only becomes real when customers can get their information out of those tools and into Notion with confidence. You’ll partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of our content importers, internal administrative tooling, and compliance workflows like exports.

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Shape the technical and product vision for Notion’s import systems, so customers can pull content from more sources and transform it into a trustworthy system of record.

 - By your 90th day, you’ll have clarified the near-term roadmap and de-risked the most important technical decisions for importers, exports, and internal admin tooling. You’ll connect AI-era and agentic workflow patterns to onboarding and import experiences — using AI to improve product judgment, prototyping, and engineering quality from design through production.

 - By the end of your first year, engineering excellence will be a team norm: reliable systems, clear operational standards, and a shared understanding of what it takes to keep critical workflows running. You will have a steady operating rhythm with HQ while owning a clear north star for the Content Onboarding surface area.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong technical leadership: you can represent the team’s work, hold a high engineering bar, and de-risk decisions through clear processes, delegation, and senior IC partnership.

 - Ability to craft and maintain multi-quarter team strategy, especially where outcomes depend on adjacent product and engineering teams.

 - Experience developing senior engineers, strengthening operating rhythms, and building high-performing engineering teams with durable standards.

 - Distributed-team leadership: you can set direction for a local team while staying tightly coordinated with cross-functional partners across time zones.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Asuntotarkastaja
jobs.description:
Innastutko kiinteistöalasta?

Kiinnostavatko kiinteistöalan monipuoliset tehtävät innastavassa työyhteisössä? Hae meille!

INNA on pohjoismainen asiantuntijapalvelukonserni, ja olemme erikoistuneet asuntojen, kiinteistöjen ja toimitilojen välitykseen sekä hallintaan. Tuotamme asiakkaillemme kokonaisvaltaisia palveluita ja ratkaisuja asumisen ja toimitilasektorin kiinteistöpalveluissa.

INNA toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Tanskassa.Konsernimme palveluksessa on runsaat 800 kiinteistöjohtamisen ammattilaista. Pohjoismainen toimintatapamme tarkoittaa suorapuheisuutta, luotettavaa palvelua, digitaalista edelläkävijyyttä ja jatkuvaa kehittämistä.

Palveluitamme ovat muun muassa toimitilojen ja asuntojen kiinteistöjohtamispalvelut, asuntovuokraus, taloushallintopalvelut, energiatehokkuus- ja ympäristövastuupalvelut sekä arviointipalvelut. Meillä on alan laajin ja monipuolisin palvelukokonaisuus, ja uskomme, että asiantuntemuksella sekä ajantasaisella markkinatiedolla voimme parantaa asiakkaidemme tulosta.

Etsimme nyt Helsinkiin Valimotielle

ASUNTOTARKASTAJAA

Oletko sinä uusi työkaverimme?

Tehtävänäsi on toimia asuntotarkastusten parissa ja vastaat mm.:

* asuinhuoneistojen tarkastuksista vuokralaisvaihtojen yhteydessä

* huoneistoremonttien määrittämisestä sekä suunnittelemisesta ja tilaamisesta tapauskohtaisesti

* huoneistoremonttien laadunvalvonnasta

* asukasneuvonnasta

Työ on liikkuvaa, ja edellyttää siksi ajokorttia sekä omaa autoa.

Onnistut tehtävässä, jos:

Olet kiinnostunut asunnoista, niiden toimivuudesta ja turvallisuudesta. Kiinteistöalan kokemus tai opinnot ovat eduksi tehtävässä. Lisäksi hallitset vuorovaikutuksen niin sanallisesti kuin kirjallisestikin sekä järjestelmäosaamisesi on hyvällä tasolla. Arvostamme myös näyttöjä korjaushankkeista, remonttien teettämisestä ja asiakaspalvelusta. Rakennustekninen osaaminen plussaa. Järjestelmien ketterä käyttö on tärkeää tässä työssä. Myös aikaisempi työkokemus asuntotarkastuksen tehtävistä katsotaan eduksesi.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen, itsenäisen ja vaikuttavan roolin innastavassa työyhteisössä, jossa osaaminen, kehittyminen ja yhdessä tekeminen kulkevat käsi kädessä. Pääset näkemään työsi tulokset konkreettisesti arjessa ja tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen kanssa.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävääsi ja tarjoamme tukea kehittymiseesi tarpeidesi mukaan. Lisäksi käytössäsi on rajaton käyttöoikeus Eduhouseverkkokoulutusalustalle, jonka avulla voit kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Tukenasi on vakaa ja kasvava organisaatio, jossa toimintatapoja ja prosesseja kehitetään aktiivisesti ja rohkeasti.

Meillä työ mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi – tarjoamme joustavan arjen, jossa liukuva työaika ja joustava etätyömahdollisuus tukevat sujuvaa työskentelyä. Arvostamme tiimityötä ja rakennamme yhdessä kannustavaa ilmapiiriä, jossa on helppo kehittyä ja onnistua.

Panostamme hyvinvointiisi kattavilla eduilla, kuten laajalla työterveyshuollolla ja Epassilla, jotta jaksat ja viihdyt työssäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Palkka sijoittuu 2800-3200 euron kuukausitasolle ja määräytyy hakijan kokemuksen perusteella.


Näin pääset työkaveriksemme

Tilaisuutesi innastua alkaa tästä. Haethan tehtävää viimeistään 3.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo rekrytointiprosessin aikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Henri Tunturi henri.tunturi@inna.fi [henri.tunturi@inna.fi]

Työnantajalupauksemme

INNA pääset kehittymään, ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan kiinteistöalan tulevaisuuteen – ja ennen kaikkea innastumaan työstäsi.

Toimintaamme ohjaavat arvot: onnistumme yhdessä, uudistamme rohkeasti ja toimimme vastuullisesti. Ne eivät ole vain sanoja, vaan näkyvät aidosti arjessamme. Meille työyhteisö on paikka, jossa innostus tarttuu.

INNAlla tärkeintä

Tavoitteenamme on olla pohjoismaisen kiinteistöalan edelläkävijä – yritys, joka tunnetaan vahvasta kulttuuristaan, selkeistä arvoistaan ja kyvystään innostaa niin asiakkaita kuin omaa henkilöstöään.

jobs.title: Christmas Operations Coordinator, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Christmas Operations Coordinators for the Christmas season 2026 in Saariselkä.**

The duties focus on handling and organizing the safari programs for charter flight travelers. The coordinators form a team who manage the Christmas Operations as a whole, with the operators daily schedule being its core. This includes, for example, transportation scheduling, cooperation with tour operators, and management of bookings for various safaris with our suppliers. The Christmas Operations Coordinator mainly works as part of a team, but must also be capable of independent work, and if necessary, also acts as a guide.

We expect you to have an active and energetic attitude, a suitable education, and previous work experience within the tourism field in Lapland, as well as a flexible and firm approach to handling tasks. Excellent interpersonal skills are required as you will be guiding other team members in their work. December is a very busy travel month, so we also hope for problem-solving ability and the ability to work under pressure. The work environment is international, so you must have fluent verbal and written English skills. Knowledge of Finnish language is a big advantage in this position. Other language skills and previous experience in guiding work and providing tourism services are considered an advantage.

**In Saariselkä** the work is carried out in two different teams depending on the tour operator. In this role, you act as a key link between the tour operator and the transport company, ensuring smooth cooperation between all parties. You are also responsible for efficiently communicating last-minute changes to subcontractors and partners. The role involves active communication both internally and externally, including communication with subcontractors and the tour operator using various systems. Success in this position requires excellent communication skills, strong IT skills and the ability to understand and manage overall operational processes.

In Saariselkä driving license is considered an advantage.

**We offer you:**

- The support of a professional work team and an interesting job description

- Lapland's natural beautiful surroundings

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in October/November 2026 and last until the beginning/mid of January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade B-C, hourly wage starting at 12,20 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, an EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Mobiililaiteteknikko ja asiakaspalvelija
jobs.description:
**Haluatko mobiililaitteiden huollon ja asiakaspalvelun mestariksi?**

iTapsan Turun myymälä etsii nyt uusia vahvistuksia riveihinsä asiakaspalvelun ja laitehuollon tehtäviin!

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset auttamaan asiakkaitamme arjen laiteongelmissa sekä huoltamaan mobiililaitteita. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, kiinnostunut elektroniikasta ja innokas oppimaan uutta.

**Edellytämme sinulta noin 1-2 vuoden aiempaa kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä**, jotta pääset sujuvasti mukaan työtehtäviin.

Jos sinulla on intoa korjata tekniikkaa, nautit ihmisten auttamisesta ja haluat työpaikan, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

iTapsa on yksi Suomen laitehuoltoalan pioneereista olemme huoltaneet puhelimia, tabletteja ja tietokoneita jo vuodesta 2012.

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Työsi on monipuolinen yhdistelmä teknistä osaamista ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua. Olet tärkeä osa myymälämme arkea ja varmistat, että asiakkaat lähtevät meiltä tyytyväisinä.

Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu:

- Asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja heidän auttamisensa laiteongelmissa

- Puhelinten, tablettien ja tietokoneiden huolto sekä vikadiagnostiikka

- Uudistettujen laitteiden myynti sekä ostoarvioiden tekeminen

- Huoltotöiden kirjaaminen ja hallinta järjestelmissämme

- Myymälän yleisestä viihtyvyydestä ja sujuvasta asiakaskokemuksesta huolehtiminen


**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta. Vaikka sinulla on jo hieman kokemusta alalta, tärkeintä on aito halu kehittyä ja oppia lisää!

Toivomme sinulta:

- Noin 1-2 vuoden kokemusta laitehuollosta ja myymälätyöstä

- Motivaatiota ja oppimishalua: olet valmis kehittämään osaamistasi ja nautit uuden oppimisesta

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja: nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja osaat selittää asioita selkeästi

- Huolellisuutta: käsittelet laitteita vastuullisesti ja tarkasti

- Oma-aloitteisuutta: toimit itsenäisesti ja pidät huolen myymälän sujuvasta arjesta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


**Miksi tulla töihin iTapsalle?**

Meillä et ole vain työntekijä, vaan osa rentoa ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

- **Opit arvokkaita taitoja:** kerrytät osaamista asiakaspalvelusta, myymälän pyörittämisestä, laitehuollosta ja myynnistä

- **Kehityt ammattilaisena:** saat monipuolista työkokemusta teknisestä ja asiakaslähtöisestä työstä

- **Rento työilmapiiri:** työskentelet tiimissä, jossa huumori ja hyvä fiilis kulkevat mukana kiireessäkin

- **Kattava perehdytys:** tuemme sinua alusta asti, kunnes hallitset tehtävät itsenäisesti


**Näin haet meille**

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa, laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen myynti@itapsa.com. Kerro meille kuka olet, miksi haluat iTapsalle ja milloin voisit aloittaa. Muistathan laittaa sähköpostin otsikoksi **"Työhakemus iTapsa Turku"**.

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikat heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 30.9.2026.

Palkkaus määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Faglighed og kreativitet

 

Vi vægter kvalitet højt, bæredygtighed og service står øverst på agendaen. Vi forventer vores personale tager et medansvar og er med til at levere en fantastisk service. Vi søger derfor en kok, som brænder for madlavningskunsten, som har mod på at vise sine ideer frem, og som er interesseret i at bidrage til at skabe et team i verdensklasse. Hvis du kan nikke genkendende til dette, så tror vi på, at dette er det rette sted for dig.

 

 

Kreativ, Serviceminded og fleksibel

 

Det forventes, at vores nye kok har erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen, formår at sætte standarden højt for det produkt, der skal leveres hver dag. Som vores nye kok er du en dygtig håndværker, der brænder for service og som er villig til at gå en ekstra mil for et godt resultat til kunden og for dine kolleger.

Som person er du udadvendt, kunne levere et højt serviceniveau hver eneste dag, når du selv i de travleste perioder formår du at holde hovedet koldt og forblive fokuseret. Du er samarbejdsvillig og motiveres af udfordringer. Du er ambitiøs i din tilgang til jobbet, og du går aldrig på kompromis med kvaliteten af den mad du serverer.

 Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt mandag til fredag

 

Ansøgning

Indsend dit CV, motiveret ansøgning og andre relevante dokumenter via linket 'Ansøg nu' senest d. 4 september 2026.Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning i dag frem for i morgen – det kan være dig, vi leder efter.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Site Manager Martin Patrick Rørsig på mail. Martin.Patrick.Roersig@dk.issworld.com 

 

 Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.



You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

jobs.title: Valuation Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


Job ID: 21500
Date posted: July 23 2026
Category: Real Assets
Job Level: Manager


ABOUT US:

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com  


YOUR FUTURE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead the valuation process for portfolio assets and oversee the preparation and review of valuations for each NAV calculation, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance with applicable valuation standards and internal policies;
Drive the valuation assessment of new investment opportunities, providing independent challenge and expert judgment on pricing assumptions, methodologies and transaction structures;
Perform and oversee detailed financial, operational and market analysis of portfolio assets and the sectors in which they operate, identifying key value drivers, risks and opportunities;
Prepare and review comprehensive valuation reports, presenting valuation conclusions, methodologies, key assumptions and sensitivities to senior management and governance bodies;
Present valuation analyses and recommendations to the Valuation Committee and actively contribute to valuation-related discussions and decision-making processes;
Act as a key point of contact for valuation matters, working closely with Portfolio Management, Fund Onboarding, Risk Management, Operations & Oversight, Finance and other internal stakeholders, as well as external parties including General Partners, investment advisors/managers, auditors, third-party valuation firms, service providers and regulators;
Monitor market developments, industry trends and regulatory changes affecting valuations, ensuring that valuation methodologies remain robust and aligned with best market practices;
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of valuation policies, procedures, controls and governance frameworks across the organization;
Support and mentor junior team members, fostering technical excellence and knowledge sharing within the valuation function.


YOUR PROFILE:

You hold a Master's degree (MA/MSc/MBA or equivalent) in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field;
You have a minimum of 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years of direct valuation experience gained within asset management, advisory, valuation consulting, audit, private markets, or a similar environment;
You have strong knowledge of valuation methodologies applicable to alternative assets, including Private Equity, Real Estate and/or Infrastructure investments;
You possess a solid understanding of financial statements, financial modelling, investment analysis and valuation principles;
You demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and exercise sound professional judgment;
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills and are comfortable presenting complex valuation topics to senior stakeholders and governance committees;
You are able to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders and confidently interact with asset managers, advisers and auditors on technical valuation matters;
You proactively stay informed about market developments, valuation best practices and regulatory requirements, assessing their impact on valuation processes and outcomes;
You have a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment;
You are fluent in English


WHAT WE OFFER:

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.


Our global benefits also include:

Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
Continuous mentoring along your career progression
Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
Plus additional local benefits depending on your location
Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Insurance Specialist SEB (m/f)
jobs.employer: SKANDINAVISKA ENSKILDA BANKEN AB Luxembourg Branch
jobs.description:
Description:


SEB is a leading international financial services group with customer bases among both private individuals and organizations. We are recognized for our expertise and customer-centric approach, which we achieve by listening to our customers, committing to quality and trust, and encouraging an entrepreneurial mindset in everything we do.

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions. We are around 150 employees with more than 20 different nationalities and in the midst of further growth and expansion.


About the role

We are looking for an experienced Insurance Specialist to join our Coverage team in Luxembourg.

In this role, you will act as the central coordinator for insurance-related matters within PWM&FO Luxembourg and serve as the primary point of contact towards insurance companies. You will work closely with Client Executives, Client Service Partners, Wealth Planners, and external insurance providers to ensure seamless execution of insurance transactions and high-quality client service.


Key responsibilities:

Act as the main contact point towards life insurance companies, maintaining strong external relationships
Coordinate and oversee insurance-related transactions, including subscriptions, amendments, and claims
Ensure efficient execution and follow-up of all insurance processes across internal and external stakeholders
Provide expert support to Client Executives and Wealth Planners on life insurance structures and solutions
Ensure all insurance activities comply with regulatory requirements (KYC, AML, cross-border rules)
Maintain and improve process documentation and working procedures, ensuring consistency and efficiency
Monitor documentation quality and ensure that client files remain complete and compliant (“House in Order”)
Identify opportunities to enhance operational processes and client experience
Act as a knowledge hub within the team, sharing expertise on insurance products and market practices


To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

Team player attitude, allowing you to collaborate efficiently cross departments
Flexibility towards work assignments with an ability to quickly adapt to changes
Structured and proactive way of working and ability to manage your time and deliver according to agreed deadlines
Willingness to continuously develop and improve processes and ways of working
Excellent verbal and written language skills in English; other languages are considered as an advantage


Experience & qualifications:

Significant experience (typically 5+ years) in life insurance, preferably within private banking, wealth management, or international insurance providers
Strong understanding of cross-border insurance solutions and regulations
Experience working with international clients and complex structures
University degree in finance, economics, law, or similar


Skills:

Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills
Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities
High level of attention to detail and quality
Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset
Fluency in English; Nordic languages are an advantage


Who you are:

Client-focused and committed to delivering a high level of service
A team player who collaborates effectively across functions and geographies
Driven to improve processes and ways of working
Comfortable working in an international and dynamic environment
Eager to continuously develop your expertise


What we offer:

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

A key specialist role with visibility across the PWM&FO organisation
An international, collaborative environment with strong team spirit
Opportunities for professional growth and specialization
A modern workplace with flat hierarchy and entrepreneurial culture
International and entrepreneurial Scandinavian working environment


Ready to join?

If this position seems to be a good fit for you, please apply by sending your application with your CV and a cover letter in English as soon as possible, but at the latest 21 August 2026.

Please be also informed that candidate selected for this role will need to provide their Criminal Record Certificate and we will also perform a name screening against sanctions list as a part of the background check process. 

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
SENIOR FUND ACCOUNTING OFFICER

Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our New York office.We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life

jobs.title: TEHNIČKI NADZORNIK/TEHNIČKA NADZORNICA FLOTE
jobs.description:
Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • nadzor tehničkog stanja plovila i brodske opreme (dizalica)
  • planiranje i praćenje preventivnog i korektivnog održavanja
  • organizaciju servisa, popravaka, remonta i dokovanja
  • koordinaciju rada vanjskih servisera, izvođača i dobavljača
  • tehničku podršku upraviteljima stroja
  • praćenje kvarova i osiguravanje njihove pravovremene sanacije
  • kontrolu tehničkih izvještaja i dokumentacije s plovila
  • praćenje rokova servisa, pregleda i certifikata tehničke opreme
  • suradnju s klasifikacijskim društvima, registrom i nadležnim tijelima
  • pripremu plovila za tehničke preglede i inspekcije
  • izradu tehničkih specifikacija i zahtjeva za nabavu
  • kontrolu ponuda, troškova održavanja
  • praćenje zaliha rezervnih dijelova i kritične opreme
  • povremene odlaske na plovila i lokacije izvođenja radova
  • sudjelovanje u tehničkom planiranju i razvoju flote

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • tehničko ili pomorsko obrazovanje
  • iskustvo u pomorskom sektoru, brodogradnji, održavanju plovila ili srodnim tehničkim poslovima
  • dobro poznavanje sustava, strojeva i opreme
  • sposobnost samostalnog organiziranja i vođenja tehničkih aktivnosti
  • razvijene organizacijske sposobnosti i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • odgovoran i praktičan pristup rješavanju tehničkih problema
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i tehničke dokumentacije
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • spremnost na povremena službena putovanja i rad na terenu
Prednost imaju kandidati s:
  • iskustvom u svojstvu upravitelja stroja, časnika stroja
  • iskustvom s radnim brodovima, tegljačima, jaružalima, multicat plovilima ili drugim specijaliziranim plovilima
  • iskustvom u organizaciji remonta, dokovanja i većih tehničkih popravaka
  • iskustvom u radu s klasifikacijskim društvima i pomorskim administracijama
  • poznavanjem sustava planiranog održavanja (PMS)
Nudimo:
  • stalni radni odnos
  • aktivno sudjelovanje u upravljanju i razvoju flote
  • dinamično radno okruženje u pomorskom sektoru
  • rad na različitim tehničkim i pomorskim projektima
  • mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja
  • stimulativna primanja u skladu s iskustvom i kvalifikacijama kandidata

jobs.description:

  • Obavlja sve strojobravarske poslove te vodi brigu o tehničkoj ispravnosti postrojenja,strojeva i opreme u društvu
  • Ispituje ispravnost mehaničkih dijelova strojeva i opreme u postrojenjima te poduzima potrebne preventivne mjere

  • završena srednja škola strojarskog usmjerenja – strojobravar, bravar, mehaničar industrijskih strojeva ili drugo odgovarajuće zanimanje

Poslodavac zadržava pravo ne odabrati nijednog kandidata bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke.

jobs.description:

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 10. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò'“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 STRUČNI RADNIK/STRUČNA RADNICA NA TEHNIČKOM ODRŽAVANJU za obavljanje poslova domara/školskog majstora i poslova loženja centralnog grijanja na određeno i puno radno vrijeme (zamjena) TRAŽENI UVJETI: Uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, kandidati moraju zadovoljavati i posebne uvjete sukladno čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i prema Pravilniku o djelokrugu rada tajnika te administrativno–tehničkim i pomoćnim poslovima koji se obavljaju u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine broj 40 /14, 71/25, 74/25-ispravak):
  1. SSS tehničke struke
  2. položen stručni ispit za ložača centralnog grijanja
  3. zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova s posebnim uvjetima rada
  4. da protiv kandidata nije pokrenut kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.
NAPOMENA: Dokaz o posebnoj zdravstvenoj sposobnosti kandidata/kinje za radno mjesto pribavlja se prije sklapanja ugovora o radu sukladno odredbi članka 24., stavka 2. i 3. Zakona o radu (NN 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23); Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV),
  • dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za ložača centralnog grijanja,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent), in Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience

jobs.title: IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d)

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

• Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

• Transparente Kommunikation sowie eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und Rabatte

Jobbeschreibung

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Roggwil suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine teamfähige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Als IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator sind Sie das technische Rückgrat unserer digitalen Infrastruktur und gleichzeitig Motor unserer KI-Transformation. Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint
- Erfahrung mit PowerShell-Skripting oder anderen Automatisierungssprachen
- Verständnis für IT-Security-Prinzipien (MFA, Zero Trust, Endpoint Protection, Backup-Strategien)
- Grundverständnis für APIs, Webhooks und JSON zur Integration von Systemen
- Erfahrung mit oder starkes Interesse an Generativer KI, LLMs, RAG-Konzepten und Prompt-Optimierung
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Adyen oder vergleichbaren SaaS-Plattformen

Persönliche Stärken

- Analytisches Denken und strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit
- Neugier und Innovationsfreude, insbesondere im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten – Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären
- Teamplayer mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zwischen den Standorten Roggwil und Konstanz

Sprachen

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher (C2)
- Englisch gute Kenntnisse (B2) für Dokumentation und internationale Tools/Partner

jobs.title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.
- Üzleti célok elérésének biztosítása
- Üzletünk szabályainak betartatása
- Üzletünk rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása.
- Üzlet napi működésének felügyelete                
- Üzletünkben lévő termékek rendszeres ellenőrzése.
- Raktárkezelés és készletgazdálkodás
- Kapcsolattartás a vevőkkel és partnerekkel
- Ügyfelek igényeinek kielégítése.

AZ ÖN PROFILJA

- Kedves, mosolygós, dinamikus, csapatban szívesen dolgozó munkatársakat keresünk, aki szívesen foglalkozik emberekkel és mindenekelőtt szereti a cipőket,
- több éves kereskedelmi tapasztalat,
- igényes munkavégzés,
- német nyelvtudás előny,
- középfokú végzettség, érettségi

AJÁNLATUNK

- Keresünk rugalmas munkatársat boltvezető helyettesi munkakörbe, Budapesten a Duna Plaza bevásárlóközpontban levő színvonalas cipőüzletünkbe teljes munkaidőben való foglalkoztatással.
- Változatos feladatok egy nemzetközi divatcégnél, amelynek székhelye Ausztriában található.
- Kedves, hozzáértő csapat, amely átfogó betanítást biztosít.

Előnyök üzleteinkben:- szakmai tréningek

- versenyképes alapbér
- béren kívüli juttatás
- teljesítménytől függően 13. havi bér.

Fizetés:- Megegyezés szerint

Töö hõlmab erinevaid põllumajandus- ja loomakasvatustöid, tagades talu sujuva toimimise taluniku puudumisel. Asendustaluniku töö on liikuv, mistõttu saab teenindada mitmeid erinevaid talusid nii elukohajärgses piirkonnas kui ka kaugemal. Vajadusel ööbitakse kohapeal taludes. Teostab õendustoiminguid, sh haavaravi ning osaleb terviseprobleemide ennetamises ja varajases märkamises. Teeb koostööd erihooldusteenusel oleva inimese, tema lähedaste või eestkostja, hoolduspersonali ning pere- ja eriarstidega.

Muud nõuded: Oskus hinnata inimese terviseseisundit ning teostada õendustoiminguid iseseisvalt ja professionaalselt.

Hea digipädevus ja oskus kasutada tervishoiu infosüsteeme ning teisi tehnoloogilisi lahendusi oma töös. Isikuomadused: Empaatiline ja lugupidav suhtumine erivajadustega inimestesse. Ootame Sind, kui oskad oma tööd planeerida ja iseseisvalt teostada, tunned ehitusest rõõmu ning pead oluliseks korralikku ja kvaliteetset lõpptulemust.
