jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

jobs.title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Capacité à s'organiser de ère autonome tout en sachant collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité

Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit

Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant

jobs.description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.  
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.  
Senior Consultant \- Assurance \- Technology Risk  
The opportunity  
Our Consulting business offers a broad range of functional and cross\-country services dedicated to providing high\-value and trusted advice to clients, with a specific focus on business transformation programs.  
Your key responsibilities  
You will gain insights into cutting\-edge IT environments and into our global methodology. Your focus: analysis, evaluation and optimization of processes, structures and systems  
As a member of interdisciplinary specialist teams, you will audit operational IT systems and information portals with regard to internal control and risk and compliance management. This includes migration tests, third party attestation \& certification, IT risk assessments, information security assessments and data analytics/information management  
You will learn about "thought leadership" as a way of addressing today's constantly changing market and challenges. You will expand your expertise with every project alongside our leaders. Furthermore, you will be supported with trainings, courses and learnings in relevant fields  
Skills and attributes for success  
Degree (Bachelor or Master) in Economics or (Business\-) Information Technology is required, relevant certifications (e.g. CISA, CISSP, CISM or CRISC) are an advantage  
A must: 3\-4 years' experience in carrying out IT audits (e.g. at a Big4 company or internal audit department) or in the area of IT risk management / operational risk management, preferably at an international company  
Qualities guaranteed to boost your career at EY: ability to work in a team, determination, commitment and quick comprehension. As a Swiss international company, we require German and English

At EY, we'll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Die DB Cargo AG ist die Güterverkehrstochter der Deutschen Bahn AG. Als europäischer Marktführer im Schienengüterverkehr verfolgen wir konsequent den internationalen Ausbau unseres Netzwerkes. Unsere Dienstleistungen erbringen wir heute mit eigenen Tochtergesellschaften in ganz Europa. Disponent:in in der Einsatzleitstelle 100%

Verantwortlich für das Sicherstellen der Einhaltung der abgegebenen Kundenversprechen im operativen Eisenbahnbetrieb  
Proaktives Überwachen der Züge sowie kunden\-, sicherheits\- und betriebsorientiertes Eingreifen bei Abweichungen  
Verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der Erreichbarkeit und Durchführung der Verkehre rund um die Uhr (24/7 Schichtbetrieb)

jobs.title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
jobs.description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

jobs.title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
jobs.description:
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently  
Your department \- where you make an impact  
The Clinical Research and Development (CR\&D) team in Lachen develops medicines that target complex and life\-threatening conditions in Haematology and Critical Care  
We specialize in clinical development of new as well as already marketed products  
The successful candidate will work closely with CPMs, CTMs, and colleagues across CR\&D in Lachen to support a wide variety of clinical trials  
This position reports to the Global Senior Director CR\&D in Lachen and is a permanent role within the team.  
“Join an international environment with exciting projects and responsibilities — be proactive, contribute, and grow together with a great team”  
\- Dr. Cristina Solomon, Global Vice President CRD Lachen  
Thrive with us  
You help save lives \- Every day is meaningful as we produce life\-saving medicines  
Family values \- Long\-term perspective for employees and relationships  
Be rewarded with market\-related salary and benefits package  
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint  
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization  
Skills development \- We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions  
It´s in our blood  
We live diversity and stand for equal opportunities as an employer! We therefore look forward to receiving your application \- regardless of age, gender, origin, sexual orientation, and religion.  
Please apply in English.  
Do you have any questions? Then get in touch with your contact person.  
Vignau  
Senior Expert Talent \& Acquisition  
Octapharma AG  
Seidenstrasse 2, 8853 Lachen  
T:  
Want to find out more about us?  
Visit our website Octapharma Career and follow us daily on LinkedIn.  
About Octapharma  
Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. We employ more than 11,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 120 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care. With seven R\&D sites and five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Austria, France, Germany, and Sweden, Octapharma also operates over 195 plasma donation centres across Europe and the US. With four decades of experience, we are committed to advancing patient care worldwide. jpid5481217jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

Spa \& Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i)  
ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung  
Eine Ikone der Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Die Reinigung und der Unterhalt der Spa Anlagen (Innen und Aussenbereich)  
Aufräumen, Aufwischen, Desinfizieren und Abstauben der Saunaräumlichkeiten, Umkleidekabinen, Toiletten, Poolanlagen sowie der Behandlungs\- und Fitnessräume  
Betreuen der SPA\-Gäste sowie die Aufsicht im ganzen Spa Bereich  
Auffüllen von Verbrauchmaterialien sowie allgemeine Aufräumarbeiten im Spa

Erfahrungen im Housekeeping oder in der Spa Reinigung setzten wir voraus  
körperlich Belastbar, um auch in sehr warmen Räumen arbeiten zu können (Innenpool, Sauna, Garderobe usw.)  
gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten  
Sie sprechen Deutsch oder Englisch  
Freude im Umgaben mit den Spa Gästen und im Team zu arbeiten  
Bereitschaft für Schicht\- und Wochenendarbeit  
Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.  
Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.

Bei Accelleron kommst du weiter! Aufbauend auf der Erfolgsgeschichte von mehr als 100 Jahren ABB Turbocharging wirst du Teil eines Teams echter Expertinnen und Experten in einem spannenden internationalen Umfeld, die sich gemeinsam für Spitzenleistungen einsetzen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner unterstützen wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden beim Übergang zu nachhaltigen Industrien mit innovativer Technologie, Expertise und intelligenten Lösungen.  
Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion in allen Dimensionen (z. B. Geschlecht, LGBTQ\+, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Alter, Beeinträchtigung, Religion oder andere Merkmale), da wir individuelle Unterschiede begrüssen und feiern.  
Senior Payroll Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover) (m/f/d; 80\-100%; 10 months)  
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine auf 10 Monate befristete Mutterschaftsvertretung, idealerweise mit Start per 1\. November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Sie stellen eine korrekte, gesetzeskonforme und termingerechte Payroll über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle sicher und fungieren als Subject Expert für Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften, HR, Finance und externen Stellen beraten Sie zu payrollrelevanten Themen, treiben Prozessverbesserungen voran und stellen die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Audits sowie die Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie eine umfassende Übergabe durch die aktuelle Stelleninhaberin gewährleisten einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Funktion.  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.  
Betreuung und Durchführung payrollrelevanter Prozesse in Workday, SAP und weiteren angebundenen HR\-Systemen.  
Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.  
Hauptansprechpartner/in für externe Stakeholder (bspw. Sozialversicherungen)  
Bearbeitung und Koordination payrollrelevanter Anfragen und Tickets von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR Business Partnern.

Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

The Executive Assistant is a high-trust, senior-level administrative partner responsible for providing comprehensive executive, operational, and governance support to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), Chief Research & Operations Officer (CROO), and broader People & Culture and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) functions. 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support, acting as a central hub across leadership, ensuring seamless execution of executive priorities, governance processes, internal workflows, and organizational operations. The incumbent is expected to anticipate needs, proactively improve systems, and drive efficiency across tools, processes, and leadership workflows. 

Key areas of responsibility include executive calendar and priority management, cross-functional coordination, governance and compliance support (including DocuSign and approval workflows), onboarding/offboarding governance alignment, financial tracking support, and leadership communications preparation. 

This role requires a high degree of discretion, judgment, organizational maturity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment. In-office attendance is required minimum twice per week, with additional presence as needed based on executive priorities and business needs.

What you will do

Executive & Leadership Support

Financial & Operational Support 

  • Manage executive-level expense tracking, credit card reconciliation, invoice submissions, and purchase order processing  

  • Support budget tracking and reporting accuracy for leadership-related expenditures  

  • Liaise with Finance as required to ensure timely and accurate processing of financial documentation  

 

Office & Operational Management 

  • Oversee office operations coordination, including supplies, vendor coordination, facilities requests, and workplace logistics  

  • Act as primary liaison with building management and internal operations teams for office needs (repairs, access, seating, meeting setup, etc.)

  • Support storytelling and structuring of leadership content for internal and external-facing presentations  


What you have

Experience 

  • 3â6 years of experience in executive support, operations coordination, or senior administrative roles  

  • Experience supporting senior leadership (VP level) 

  • Exposure to governance, compliance workflows, or document approval systems (DocuSign or similar) is an asset  

  • Experience working across cross-functional teams such as HR/P&C, Finance, or Legal is preferred  

Skills & Competencies 

  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)  

  • Strong operational judgment and ability to manage competing priorities in real time  

  • High attention to detail with a systems-thinking mindset  

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills  

  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion  

  • Experience with workflow tools such as SharePoint, Confluence, Monday.com, or similar platforms  

  • Ability to proactively improve processes rather than simply execute tasks 

  • Pleasant âcan doâ attitude, takes steps to work proactively to support 


What's in it for you?
  • Be part of an evolutionary journey in the audience measurement and data space; work on exciting projects, add value & make a positive impact to our Company.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package (Health, Dental, Vision and Personal Spending Account - employer paid premiums).

  • Flexible Work location (on-site offices in Toronto and Montreal, remote â work from home, hybrid as required per role).

  • Continuous learning and development via Percipio, our Learning Management System.

Values

Job Description â Billing Officer

Job Title: Billing Officer

Department: Finance & Accounts

Reporting To: Finance Manager / Accounts Manager

Experience: 2â4 years in billing, invoicing, or accounts-related roles

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Billing Officer will be responsible for managing the company's billing and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of invoices, proper documentation, reconciliation of billing records, and coordination with internal departments and customers. The role requires strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and good knowledge of accounting and billing procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, bills, credit notes, debit notes, and related billing documents.
  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.
  • Assist in preparing billing-related MIS and periodic reports for management.
  • Handle customer queries related to invoices, billing adjustments, credit notes, and payment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, company policies, and internal control procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of financial and customer information.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to billing and receivables.
  • Identify billing errors or process gaps and recommend improvements where required.
  • Perform other finance and accounting duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or a related field.
  • 2â4 years of relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable.
  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and billing procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple invoices and deadlines efficiently.
  • Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ERP/accounting software such as Tally, SAP, Odoo, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of VAT, TDS, and other applicable tax-related billing requirements.
  • Experience in handling high-volume billing operations.
  • Good understanding of sales, inventory, and accounts receivable processes.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Numerical & Analytical Ability
  • Time Management
  • Problem-Solving
  • Communication & Coordination
  • Accountability
  • Integrity & Confidentiality
  • Process Orientation
  • Teamwork

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Billing error and discrepancy rate
  • Timely reconciliation of billing records
  • Resolution time for billing-related issues
  • Accuracy of billing MIS and documentation
  • Compliance with internal billing and financial procedures

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

Who You Are

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions
